programme.desc: A private eye shadows a female serial killer of men all over the U.S. without her knowing as he, strangely enough, occasionally acts as her guardian angel.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
programme.desc: Scott Bakula ("Sibling Rivalry") portrays Harry D’Amour, a private detective visiting Los Angeles on a routine investigation. Harry gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Philip Swan (Kevin J. O’Connor, "The Mummy").

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Wishmaster
programme.desc: From executive producer Wes Craven comes this fantasy-horror cult classic that spawned three sequels. When a jewelry appraiser is given an ancient gem, she unwittingly unleashes an immortal spirit that grants humans wishes in exchange for their souls.

programme.title: Cemetery Man
programme.desc: When a cemetery watchman tasked with dispatching the recently deceased falls in love with a widow, will his lust for life eclipse his bond with death?

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening. As Nick digs into the case, he becomes entangled in a deadly affair involving three intriguing women, each with an unexpected motive for the crime. Catherine Tramell is a fast-living novelist whose fictional murders have a strange way of coming true. Roxy is Catherine's street-wise, provocative girlfriend. Dr. Beth Garner is a police psychologist counseling Nick.

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: A man searches for his missing wife after his car breaks down in the middle of the desert.

programme.title: Puppetmaster 2
programme.desc: The killer puppets return and hunt paranormal researchers in an attempt to collect brain fluid for their master, Andre Toulon.

programme.title: Puppet Master 3: Toulon's Revenge
programme.desc: A puppeteer's ability to bring inanimate objects to life attracts the attention of the Nazis during World War II. Little do they know, he is using the puppets to kill the Nazis who have wronged him.

programme.title: Puppet Master 4
programme.desc: Decapitron is the new head-swapping leader of Toulon's puppets. Each of Decapitron's heads will be put to its ultimate test when Blade and the gang go toe to toe with their most sinister enemy yet.

programme.title: Puppet Master 5
programme.desc: In the darkened Bodega Bay Inn, the greedy Dr. Jennings has come to pilfer Blade, Six Shooter, Jester, Pinhead, Torch, Tunneler and Decapitron to discover the source of their animation.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: Stigmata
programme.desc: A priest from the Vatican is sent to visit a woman who's showing signs of stigmata. The priest comes to find that the lady is truly possessed by something.

programme.title: Pi
programme.desc: A paranoid mathematician searches for a key number that will unlock the universal patterns found in nature. Pushed to his limits, he spirals between brilliance and obsession in this gripping, groundbreaking debut from Darren Aronofsky.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: The undead killer cop returns in this gory sequel, which sees maniac Officer Cordell (Robert Z'Dar, "Tango & Cash") team up with a serial killer to hunt down the criminals who murdered him.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: A journalist becomes the unwanted center of attention for a 14-year-old girl, who proceeds to sabotage his life after he refuses her sexual advances.

programme.title: Waxwork II: Lost in Time
programme.desc: This science fiction thriller picks up right where the original leaves off, with the destruction of the museum. When a disembodied hand kills Sarah's father, she and Mark must journey through time to find proof of Sarah's innocence.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Zombie cop Officer Matt Cordell's (Robert Z'Dar, "Tango & Cash") third ride from beyond the grave has him looking for a girlfriend Ð someone nice, tender and undead.

programme.title: Strangeland
programme.desc: Captain Howdy surfs the internet for prey, and girls begin to disappear after online chats with the predator. A detective takes a personal stake in the case when his own daughter vanishes.

programme.title: Frankenhooker
programme.desc: A medical student sets out to recreate his decapitated fiancée by building her a new body made of Manhattan street prostitutes.

programme.title: Def By Temptation
programme.desc: An evil succubus is preying on libidinous black men in New York City, and all that stands in her way is a minister-in-training, an aspiring actor, and a cop who specializes in cases involving the supernatural.

programme.title: Body Bags
programme.desc: Three short stories in the horror genre. The first about a serial killer. The second about a hair transplant gone wrong. The third about a baseball player.

programme.title: The Last Seduction
programme.desc: A devious sexpot steals her husband's drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Bad Influence
programme.desc: In this Hitchcockian thriller, Rob Lowe stars as Alex, the mysterious drifter who manipulates himself into the drab life of Michael Boll (James Spader), an ambitious young businessman.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges and Tommy Lee Jones team up for this action-filled, edge-of-your-seat thriller about a mad bomber terrorizing Boston. Forest Whitaker and Lloyd Bridges co-star.

programme.title: Snake Eyes (1998)
programme.desc: Set in Atlantic City, an assassination attempt thrusts a detective into a murder case with 14,000 potential suspects and a deadly conspiracy where nothing is what it appears to be.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: F/X 2
programme.desc: Movie special-effects expert Rollie Tyler gets himself into trouble again when he agrees to help a police officer catch a serial killer. With the help of an ex-cop pal and some of his own movie magic, Tyler outwits the bad guys.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

programme.title: The Ambulance
programme.desc: When the girl of his dreams vanishes after a mysterious ambulance whisks her away, a young comic book artist (Eric Roberts) frantically searches for her...and finds unimaginable horror! James Earl Jones, Janine Turner and Red Buttons also star.

programme.title: Blue Steel (1990)
programme.desc: This thriller stars Jamie Lee Curtis as a suspended NYPD officer stalked by an obsessed commodities trader, who threatens everything she holds dear.

programme.title: Bringing Out the Dead
programme.desc: Frank Pierce, a paramedic, is on the brink of madness from too many years of saving and losing lives. One fateful night, Frank meets Mary Burke, the daughter of a man Frank tried to save. Together, Frank and Mary confront the ghosts of the past.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Red Corner
programme.desc: A savvy entertainment lawyer awakes the morning after seducing a beautiful Chinese woman to find her dead and him accused of rape and murder.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: He’s a composite of some 200 personalities, every one a notorious killer. He’s Sid 6.7, a virtual reality creation designed to put L.A. police officers to the test.

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: In a gym bag. That's how three men size up what they've found in the snowy Minnesota woods. They've come across a downed plane with a rotting corpse inside...and over $4 million stuffed inside a duffel bag. Finders, keepers? Maybe.

programme.title: The Soft Kill
programme.desc: A Los Angeles private investigator is framed for the strangulation death of his lover, the wife of an ambitious district attorney.

programme.title: One Eight Seven
programme.desc: When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield, he feels threatened.

programme.title: Jennifer Eight
programme.desc: They are the unidentified victims of an unsolved death spree, women linked by a killer’s gruesome handiwork and by police files giving them the code name “Jennifer.”

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: A thief is betrayed after a well done job in Detroit. Returning to Chicago, he decides on revenge.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: A cash-strapped law student is making easy money as night watchman at the city morgue. But his peaceful graveyard shift becomes a time of terror when a serial killer begins wreaking havoc and leaving behind clues pointing to Martin's guilt!

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Rush (1991)
programme.desc: The harrowing story of two narcotics agents (Jason Patric, Jennifer Jason Leigh) who become horribly addicted to the very substance they are supposed to keep off the streets. Supporting cast includes Sam Elliott.

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: Sizzingly sexy Madonna leads a star-filled cast in this erotic thriller as a woman accused of killing a wealthy, elderly man through her insatiable sexual prowess.

programme.title: Fire In The Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: After a whirlwind romance and rushed marriage, Catherine (Charlotte Gainsbourg, 'I'm Not There') moves into her husband's apartment. As strange things begin to happen, she finds herself questioning her own sanity. With Nastassja Kinski & John Hannah.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Two guys kidnap a rich man's wife and bury her in a box with 24 hours of oxygen. Tough NYPD Detective Maddy and others get the case. Will they reach it in time?

programme.title: Dark Angel: The Ascent
programme.desc: A young demoness yearns to visit the world of man. She ascends from Hell and finds herself on the streets disguised as a human. Her mission now: to punish the evil on Earth.

programme.title: Unforgettable (1996)
programme.desc: A forensics expert is thrust into a heart-stopping adventure when he takes an experimental memory drug in the hopes of discovering his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A graduate student and his girlfriend set out on a cross-country road trip to research a book they are writing on serial killers. Along the way, they pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend who will take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: The Boneyard (1991)
programme.desc: Children turned into zombies wreak havoc in a coroner's building with just a burned-out psychic, an experienced cop and two coroners to stop the madness.

programme.title: Amityville: It's About Time
programme.desc: Jake returns home with an antique clock, intended as a gift to his two teenage children. Sinister incidents begin to transpire around the neighborhood after Jake places the clock on his mantle.

programme.title: Amityville: A New Generation
programme.desc: A photographer is given an old mirror from a homeless person who he photographs on the street. What he doesn't know is that demonic forces project a grisly fate upon the mirror's surface.

programme.title: Scissors
programme.desc: In this intense thriller, after a brutal attack, an emotionally fragile woman is terrified that her assailant will return. She soon finds herself standing on the verge of madness...and someone is more than willing to push her over the edge!

programme.title: Amityville: Dollhouse
programme.desc: A children's dollhouse, which is a miniature of the infamous haunted Long Island house, is given to a young girl where the demonic evil soon comes out to cause more terror.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn II: The Final Sacrifice
programme.desc: The hit film inspired by the short-story by Stephen King spawns a sequel of rural shock and terror. This frightful follow-up has members of a nearby Nebraska town choosing to adopt the surviving adolescents from the previous pot-boiler.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn III: Urban Harvest
programme.desc: In the third installment in the movie series inspired by Stephen King's original short story, a childless couple adopts a pair of orphaned brothers only to discover they're much more than they seem.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn: The Gathering
programme.desc: Somewhere out in the cornfields lurks an unspeakable evil, and a bright young medical student is determined to solve the mystery behind the sinister plague in this fourth chilling chapter of a movie series inspired by Stephen King's short-story.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn V: Fields Of Terror
programme.desc: Six college students take a very wrong turn, and find themselves lost in a strangely deserted rural town ruled by a murderous cult of children controlled by evil forces in the fifth chapter of the popular horror movie franchise.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn 666: Isaac's Return
programme.desc: 19 years ago a child led a cult of kids to murder and fulfill a sinister prophecy. Now Isaac is back, and the strange rituals have returned in this sixth installment of one of the most popular horror movie franchises of all time.

programme.title: The Rage: Carrie 2
programme.desc: Rachel (Emily Bergl) is a high school misfit who gets caught in the middle of a prank orchestrated by a group of jocks...a prank that turns deadly. And when they target her, it triggers a powder-keg of anger, unleashing Rachel's horrifying powers!

programme.title: Dead Again
programme.desc: Oscar® nominee Kenneth Branagh (Henry V) and Oscar ® winner Emma Thompson (Howards End*) give dazzling dual-role performances in this supernatural-tinged romantic murder mystery.

programme.title: TC 2000
programme.desc: Somewhere in an apocalyptic future, where the rich live underground and the poor are left to fend for themselves on the surface by forming gangs, corrupt members of an underground security force plot to destroy the surface.

programme.title: Dr. Giggles
programme.desc: A madman who believes he's a doctor comes to the town where his crazy father was killed, and soon begins murdering people and becoming infatuated with a teenage girl who has a heart condition.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: Four young friends, while taking a shortcut en route to a local boxing match, witness a brutal murder which leaves them running for their lives.

programme.title: Return Of The Living Dead III
programme.desc: A young man uses a secret government chemical and program to reanimate his dead girlfriend, and helps her as she consumes the only thing that will nourish her—human brains.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Gory remake of the Gaston Leroux classic story, only this time, the phantom is not disfigured, but a man who was raised by rats deep under the Paris Opera House.

programme.title: Uncovered
programme.desc: A woman finds a hidden message in a restored painting questioning a knight's death. When her friend is murdered investigating it, a chess game's moves in the painting link to killings from the past that she must solve.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: A couple struggling to conceive visit a miracle doctor as a last hope for having a child. The wife gets pregnant, but after the initial joy comes horror, as she slowly discovers the nightmarish truth behind the doctor's success.

programme.title: Unlawful Entry
programme.desc: A burglar holds a knife to Karen's throat while her husband does nothing. The couple ends up befriending the cop that comes. The friendship ends when the cop beats up the culprit. Karen isn't ready to end it. Things get ugly with the cop.

programme.title: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Teetering on the edge of sanity, volatile literary agent Peter Loew (Nicolas Cage) tries to find purpose in his life through a cutthroat work ethic and a hedonistic nightlife.

programme.title: Witchboard
programme.desc: A woman finds an interest in her friend Brandon's Ouija Board when he brings it by her party.

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: A doctor stimulates a sensory gland in the brain. This allows him to see into "The Beyond". When he sees the inhabitants of this realm they can see him too. They are eager to introduce him to their world and the doctor gets more than he bargained for

programme.title: The Terminator
programme.desc: A cyborg is sent from the future to assassinate a young woman who's destined to give birth to a son who will become the key to saving humanity.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann directs this stylishly photographed action-packed drama that stars James Caan as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman (Tuesday Weld).

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: A Philadelphia sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns out to be a politically motivated murder.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: A morally upright naval hero accepts a position with the Secretary of Defense and his somewhat overzealous assistant. Things become a bit sticky when the Secretary of Defense becomes involved in the murder of a beautiful Washington, D.C. party girl.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.

programme.title: Fade To Black
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Ghoulies
programme.desc: When a college student inherits an old mansion he finds he has also inherited its residents--a bunch of slimy, hairy, fanged creatures who'll do anything for him, even kill.

programme.title: Ghoulies II
programme.desc: The Ghoulies are back in this sequel in which they take over a traveling carnival giving a park full of teenagers a night they'll never forget.

programme.title: The Believers
programme.desc: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult. As the cult's connections to corporate oligarchs emerge, Cal and his family are put at terrible risk.

programme.title: The Wraith
programme.desc: Jake is killed by neighborhood thugs, and returns as a mystical figure (The Wraith) to gain revenge. Starring Charlie Sheen and Randy Quaid.

programme.title: The Mean Season
programme.desc: A newspaper reporter (Kurt Russell) becomes the unwitting ally of a vicious serial killer (Richard Jordan) who contacts the reporter and appoints him his spokesman. As the killer's calls and clues increase, the reporter is lured into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Twin gynecologists take full advantage of the fact that nobody can tell them apart, until their relationship begins to deteriorate over a woman.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: A psycho-killer stalks two New York City women--one a frustrated housewife, the other a street-smart hooker who teams up with the first woman's son to trap the murderer. The film reaches a shocking climax when the slayer's real identity is revealed.

programme.title: Hellraiser
programme.desc: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

programme.title: Hellraiser II: Hellbound
programme.desc: Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Debra Winger and Tom Berenger star in this tense, provocative tale of betrayal about an FBI agent who falls for a murder suspect with a shocking secret. John Heard, John Mahoney, Richard Libertini, Betsy Blair and Ted Levine co-star.

programme.title: Cellar Dweller
programme.desc: Thirty years have passed since the grisly death of a comic book artist. When an ardent devotee of the artist's work moves into his house she is unaware that her imagination has revived the grotesque murderer and that she might be the next victim.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: The summer of 1964... Two FBI agents--one a tight-jawed, by-the-book type, the other an experienced Southern lawman who knows how to handle people--head the government's investigation into the disappearance of three civil rights activists in Mississippi.

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: Under Fire
programme.desc: A political thriller about three journalists on the line in 1979 Managua, Nicaragua (during the Samoza regime), how their lives intertwine and how two of them risk their professionalism by becoming involved in the revolutionary conflict.

programme.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment in Fear (1988)
programme.desc: Injected with human brain cells, a super-intelligent female monkey is enlisted to help a wheelchair-bound quadriplegic get on with his life.

programme.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer: 30th Anniversary Edition
programme.desc: A seemingly mild-mannered drifter introduces an ex-con and his innocent sister into his world of cold-blooded killing in this shocking and thought-provoking plunge into the mind of a murderer.

programme.title: 52 Pick-up
programme.desc: Life is good for Los Angeles entrepreneur Harry Mitchell (Roy Scheider), great business, beautiful home and a gorgeous wife (Ann-Margret).

programme.title: Dolls
programme.desc: The Hartwicke's vast collection of dolls is fun to play with and nice to look at, but beneath the painted faces of their lifelike dolls lie murderous creatures with a vengeance for blood!

programme.title: Ms. 45
programme.desc: Ms. 45 follows a mute garment-district seamstress who ignites her one-woman rampage against NYC's entire male population.

programme.title: Kill Me Again
programme.desc: Private investigator Val Kilmer is looking to score some quick cash. Joanne Whalley-Kilmer is the femme fatale who just wants to disappear. Michael Madsen is her psychotic boyfriend. Fate will bring them all together in this clever, modern-day noir.

programme.title: The Stuff
programme.desc: When a mysterious goo oozes from the earth, it's marketed as the newest dessert sensation. A private detective investigates the sweet treat that's absolutely delicious...and possibly lethal.

programme.title: Crimes Of Passion (1984)
programme.desc: Bobby Grady is married with two children, and his marriage is in crisis. Bobby is invited to work the night shift at a fashion-design studio whose owner believes that his talented, introspective designer Joanna Crane is selling his designs to competitors.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: A young woman stumbles upon a mysterious diary that reveals the secrets of \\"The Three Mothers\\" and unleashes a nightmare world of demonic evil.

programme.title: Criminal Law
programme.desc: Attorney Oldman successfully defends accused killer Kevin Bacon. It is only after proving his client's innocence by discrediting eyewitness, that Oldman discovers Bacon is guilty--and intends to kill again.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: When the townspeople of a small village begin to die in a series of horrible accidents, an inspector arrives to investigate. But when suspicion falls on a local medium who records conversations with the dead, the grisly deaths take on a sinister twist.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: A laid-back American truck driver in South Australia starts to suspect a man driving a green van of killing young women along his route, and proceeds to play a cat-and-mouse game in order to catch him red-handed.

programme.title: Chopping Mall
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Mausoleum
programme.desc: A maxed-out mix of 80s supernatural horror and slasher excess, MAUSOLEUM is a stylish, sleazy, and outrageously gory production, featuring a series of imaginative death scenes orchestrated by effects wizard John Carl Buechler (RE-ANIMATOR, GHOULIES)

programme.title: Deadtime Stories
programme.desc: A babysitting uncle tells his charges three horror stories--about a killer witch, Little Red Riding Hood and a werewolf, and a story about 'Goldi Lox' and the three bears.

programme.title: Southern Comfort (1981)
programme.desc: During a routine exercise, a team of National Guards is threatened by angry and violent locals. Starring Academy Award-winner Keith Carradine and Powers Boothe.

programme.title: Blind Date
programme.desc: Jon Ratcliff (Joseph Bottoms), is blinded in an accident, but given modified sight when an \"optical\" computer chip implanted in his brain allows him to see images in bold outlines. That's when he witnesses a murder by the serial killer.

programme.title: Parents
programme.desc: In this bizarre and very black comedy set in 1950s suburbia, Michael Laemle comes to suspect that his conventional parents have a little secret which they have kept from him.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: This time, the camp set in the deep, dark woods is a camp for troubled youths. The psychotic killer that has roamed the woods and been the topic of many ghost stories, is still lurking about.

programme.title: The Ninth Configuration
programme.desc: A military psychiatrist takes charge of an army mental hospital situated in a secluded castle. Among his many eccentric patients is a troubled astronaut in the midst of an existential crisis.

programme.title: Dark Night Of The Scarecrow
programme.desc: When young Marylee Williams (Tonya Crowe) is found viciously mauled, all hell breaks loose in her small rural town. A gang of bigots pursue a suspect: her mentally challenged friend Bubba Ritter (Larry Drake).

programme.title: Beyond Dream's Door
programme.desc: Ben's nightmares come back to haunt him and his friends in this psychological/supernatural horror film.

programme.title: Night Of The Demons (1988)
programme.desc: On the night of Halloween, 10 teens decide to go to a party at an abandoned funeral parlor. While starting the party, the teens gather around a big mirror to perform a seance...BIG MISTAKE.

programme.title: Maniac Cop
programme.desc: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.

programme.title: The Return of Swamp Thing
programme.desc: NEW HD TRANSFER. Everyone's favorite muck-encrusted plant-man falls in love with Dr. Arcane's sexy daughter and must rescue her from her father's nefarious and murderous plans.

programme.title: Witchtrap
programme.desc: A team of parapsychologists is hired to exorcise the evil spirit of a witch who is haunting an inn.

programme.title: Amityville: The Evil Escapes
programme.desc: The demonic forces that were lurking in Amityville escape to California by inhabiting a lamp. This evil latches onto a little girl living in the home by manifesting itself as her dead father.

programme.title: The Holcroft Covenant
programme.desc: Michael Caine stars in this riveting, political mystery about an ordinary man who is left an extraordinary legacy that soon pulls him into a deadly game of international intrigue and double-cross.

programme.title: Demons
programme.desc: From the minds of Dario Argento and Lamberto Bava comes the horrific Heavy Metal splatter film classic, DEMONS!

programme.title: Demons 2
programme.desc: From the minds of Dario Argento and Lamberto Bava comes DEMONS 2, the sequel to the surprise horror hit, DEMONS! There's a scary movie on television and the residents of a luxury high-rise building have their eyes glued to their sets.

programme.title: City Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: The Seven Gates Of Hell have been torn open, and in three days the dead shall rise and walk the earth. As a reporter and a psychic race to close the portals of the damned, they encounter a seething nightmare of unspeakable evil.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
