programme.title: Return Of The Living Dead: Rave To The Grave
programme.desc: A college student creates a drug called Z and sells it on campus, inadvertently resurrecting the living dead, who wreak havoc at a Halloween rave.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn: Genesis
programme.desc: An update of the horror classic that follows a couple who take a cross-country road trip to work out their marital issues and end up falling victim to a cult of killer children in an abandoned Nebraska town.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn: Revelation
programme.desc: In the seventh sinister installment of the popular horror movie franchise, a woman digs deep into her past and uncovers a dark secret. A demonic force wants her dead and will stop at nothing until his legacy of terror is complete.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn: Runaway
programme.desc: An evil cult of children who kill, stalks a woman and her son.

programme.title: Amityville II: The Possession
programme.desc: An Italian-American family move into a house built on an ancient Indian burial ground. The oldest son is possessed by an evil spirit, and is forced to murder his family. The family's priest feels responsible, and tries to save the possessed boy's soul.

programme.title: Amityville Exorcism
programme.desc: A family awakens the vengeful spirit of a killer, who now possesses their daughter. A priest must try to save the family and exorcize the demon that threatens to destroy them all.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: Dark Circles
programme.desc: From the go-to name in Horror and the creators of America’s #1 Horror Festival comes the terrifying story of a family that’s been pushed beyond their limits.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

programme.title: Wicker Park
programme.desc: What if the woman you loved disappeared without a word? How far would you go to find her again? Josh Hartnett, Diane Kruger, Rose Byrne and Matthew Lillard star in this intense neo-noir where love turns to obsession and no one is who they seem.

programme.title: Original Sin
programme.desc: A thriller about the dangerous and sometimes lethal power of love and passion. Luis and Julia are bound together by fierce love and desire. Luis and Julia adventure takes them across the landscape of Cuba, into obsession, eroticism, and perhaps murder

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Architect Ray Reardon lives in a glittery dream world of upscale success. On the rebound from a recent divorce, Ray meets Lena Mathers and falls in love - but his dream turns to a nightmare as Lena leads him to the edge.

programme.title: Passion
programme.desc: The rivalry between the manipulative boss of an advertising agency and her talented protégée escalates from stealing credit to public humiliation to murder.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: The author of 32 best-selling romance books takes her accountant away from his frumpy wife. And when this overweight suburban wife discovers what's been going on, she wreaks malicious and delicious revenge...

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: An entrepreneur hires Sonny as his mechanic but soon Sonny begins an affair with his employer’s wife. The illicit couple concoct a perfect murder but how far are they willing to go to cover it?

programme.title: Birthday Girl
programme.desc: A lonely bank employee, John Buckingham (Ben Chaplin), meets Nadia (Nicole Kidman) through a Russian mail-order bride service. Soon, the sudden arrival of Nadia's gregarious cousins makes John realize that he's in over his head.

programme.title: Tabloid
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Errol Morris tells a twisted true tale of love, abduction, cloned dogs, and Mormons in bondage ripped from the headlines of 1970s tabloids.

programme.title: Into The Abyss
programme.desc: From legendary filmmaker Werner Herzog comes a riveting exploration of a horrible crime that probes the human psyche and explores why people kill.

programme.title: Cocaine Cowboys 2
programme.desc: The sequel follows cocaine dealer Charles Crosby beginning in 1991 on the inner-city streets of Oakland, California. The story of Griselda Blanco is presented in greater depth.

programme.title: How to Make Money Selling Drugs
programme.desc: Want to make millions in a $400 billion global industry? Find out why no one is winning the war on drugs in this provocative investigation, featuring Russell Simmons, Susan Sarandon, David Simon (creator of "The Wire"), and 50 Cent.

programme.title: The Jeffrey Dahmer Files
programme.desc: A dark and disturbing exploration of America's most infamous serial killer, Jeffrey Dahmer, as seen through the eyes of the arresting officer and his next door neighbor.

programme.title: The Dog (2013)
programme.desc: An intimate portrait of John Wojtowicz, the inspiration behind Al Pacino's character in Sidney Lumet's Oscar-nominated drama "Dog Day Afternoon."

programme.title: The Trials Of Darryl Hunt
programme.desc: A feature documentary about a brutal rape/murder case and a wrongly convicted man, Darryl Hunt, who spent nearly twenty years in prison for a crime he did not commit. Both a social justice story and a personally driven narrative.

programme.title: The Witness
programme.desc: The name Kitty Genovese became synonymous with urban apathy after The New York Times printed an article stating that she was stabbed to death during an attack that lasted more than half an hour — while 38 witnesses did nothing.

programme.title: Manson
programme.desc: Featuring the first ever in-depth interview with Linda Kasabian, high-end drama and rare archive, Manson chronicles the final days in 1969 leading up to America's notorious Tate/La Bianca murders.

programme.title: Manson's Missing Victims
programme.desc: Featuring interviews with former family members, detectives, and prosecutors, as well as rare archive and forensics, we follow Paul and Buster in their search for hidden graves and buried secrets.

programme.title: The Seventh Fire
programme.desc: Terrence Malick presents this haunting and visually arresting nonfiction film about the Native American gang crisis.

programme.title: Motown Mafia
programme.desc: Eddie 'The Fat Man' Jackson and Courtney 'The Field Marshal' Brown were labeled 'Kingpins' in an era where their names reigned supreme in Detroit.

programme.title: Jay Sebring....Cutting To The Truth
programme.desc: Follows the life of artist, designer, and entrepreneur Jay Sebring, who was murdered alongside Sharon Tate by followers of Charles Manson.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: Public Enemy Number One sheds light on the politics behind the war on drugs from Nixon to today, with first of its kind insight from U.S. Drug Czars, and the founders of the “Just Say No” movement.

programme.title: When Liberty Burns
programme.desc: An in-depth analysis on the 40th Anniversary of the life and untimely death of Arthur Lee McDuffie at the hands of Miami Dade police officers as well as the infrastructural development of the Miami area during the Jim Crow era.

programme.title: Climate for Murder
programme.desc: The murder of a gay man on a public bus stuns the city of Montreal, but it's only a sign of things to come during a violent summer. Brutal acts on members of the gay community go largely unsolved.

programme.title: The Family I Had
programme.desc: In this poignant documentary, a mother recalls how her brilliant teenage son shattered their idyllic family with a horribly violent and shocking act.

programme.title: 1275 Days
programme.desc: After a botched home invasion, 15-year-old Blake finds himself facing a virtual life prison sentence for Felony Murder. Soon after, a David-and-Goliath uphill battle ensues in Elkhart, Indiana.

programme.title: The Frank Matthews Story
programme.desc: Frank Matthews came to New York from the Tobacco country of North Carolina in the mid-'60s. By 1970, he was the biggest black drug kingpin in the U.S.

programme.title: Killing Jimmy Hoffa
programme.desc: Jimmy Hoffa was one of America's most powerful men. He fought the Kennedy's, made deals with the Mafia, and controlled 2 million union members. Then he disappeared.

programme.title: American Dope White Powder Black Power
programme.desc: Slavery had been over 100 years before large amounts of capital flowed into Black America for the first time- and it came from illegal drugs.

programme.title: Is This El Chapo? (2014)
programme.desc: This documentary probes the truth behind the 2014 arrest of Joaquin "El Chapo" Guzman, the world's most notorious drug lord.

programme.title: Crips And Bloods: Made In America (2008)
programme.desc: In Made In America, renowned documentarian Stacy Peralta blends gripping archival footage and photos with in-depth interviews of current and former gang members, historians, and experts, documenting the emergence of the Bloods and the Crips.

programme.title: Murderous Minds - H.H. Holmes
programme.desc: Herman Webster Mudgett, better known as Dr. Henry Howard Holmes or H. H. Holmes, was an American serial killer. While he confessed to 27 murders, he was convicted and sentenced to death for only one murder.

programme.title: Murderous Minds - Bonnie and Clyde
programme.desc: Due to their glamorization in fiction, people are often unaware of the dark reality of Bonnie and Clyde. Far from being a loved-up couple, they were in fact cold-blooded murderers who stopped at nothing.

programme.title: Murderous Minds - The Iceman
programme.desc: With almost 200 admitted murders, Richard Kuklinski, The Iceman, was a mafia hitman for hire and worked with all the New York and New Jersey crime families.

programme.title: Murderous Minds - Jim Jones
programme.desc: Jim Jones was an American cult leader, preacher, and self-professed faith healer. He launched the Peoples Temple in Indiana during the 1950s.

programme.title: Long Island Railroad Massacre
programme.desc: On December 7, 1993 a crazed gunman shot twenty-five people on the LIRR, killing six. This is the worst crime in New York history prior to the 9-11 attacks.

programme.title: Whitey: United States of America V. James J. Bulger
programme.desc: From Academy Award®-nominated director Joe Berlinger, WHITEY: UNITED STATES OF AMERICA V. JAMES J. BULGER is a sweeping and revelatory documentary film that follows the trial of the infamous gangster James “Whitey” Bulger.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: 'Horror Film Director Found Slain, Buried Under Floor,' screamed the 1995 headlines read around the world. But the truth behind the wild life of Al Adamson and his grisly death reveals perhaps the most bizarre career in Hollywood history.

programme.title: Mr. Untouchable
programme.desc: This is the true-life story of a junkie turned multimillionaire drug lord. With the first hand testimony of the Godfather himself, Nicky Barnes, who was the most powerful black drug kingpin in New York City history.

programme.title: Narco Cultura (2014)
programme.desc: Narco Cultura (Spanish, English subtitles) takes viewers behind the scenes of narcocorridos, the most explosive and violent music subculture in America.

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects’ fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up and begins cooperating with authorities.

programme.title: Elvis & The Memphis Mafia
programme.desc: Elvis Presley had a select group of friends he entrusted with his life. Through never seen before interviews, this documentary will explore Elvis’ life through the eyes of The Memphis Mafia, from the highs…To the lows.

programme.title: Murders of Hollywood
programme.desc: Sensational and shocking stories from Hollywood are not always fiction. Beyond anything a screenwriter could imagine, and with cast of famous stars and celebrities, this documentary goes behind the scenes to explore the real-life stories of murders in ...

programme.title: Lady You Shot Me
programme.desc: Uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Sam Cooke, an influential African American at the height of his career as a musician and producer, shot dead in a seedy motel, as linked to greed and corruption within the music industry.

programme.title: Excellent Cadavers
programme.desc: The story of the biggest anti-mafia trial in history and the people who made it possible.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: In the late 1990’s, New England is hit by a crime wave, netting millions for a gang of sophisticated thieves. Though the FBI suspects the gang is based in Charlestown, Massachusetts, nobody in the quiet Boston will talk to police or the FBI.

programme.title: Love and Terror On the Howling Plains of Nowhere
programme.desc: Author Poe Ballantine investigates the disappearance of a brilliant mathematics professor, who then is found tied to a tree and burned beyond recognition.

programme.title: Valentine Road (2014)
programme.desc: Valentine Road is a feature documentary examining the emotionally devastating earthquake and powerful aftershock that occurred when 14-year-old Brandon McInerney fatally shot 15-year-old Lawrence King during first period English class in the 8th grade.

programme.title: The Patent Scam
programme.desc: The corruption runs deeper than you'd ever think. A multi-billion dollar industry you've never heard of. This is the world Patent Trolls thrive in: created for them by the U.S. Patent system.

programme.title: Bloodsworth An Innocent Man (2016)
programme.desc: Charged. Convicted. Sentenced to death. Innocent. The remarkable true story of the 1st death row inmate exonerated by DNA in the US.

programme.title: Deep Web
programme.desc: Deep Web gives the inside story of one of the most important and riveting digital crime sagas of the century -- the arrest of Ross William Ulbricht, the convicted 30-year-old entrepreneur accused to be 'Dread Pirate Roberts.'

programme.title: Tales from the Organ Trade
programme.desc: A gritty and unflinching descent into the shadowy world of black-market organ trafficking: the street-level brokers, the rogue surgeons, the impoverished men and women who are willing to sacrifice a slice of their own bodies for a quick payday.

programme.title: Beyond Boundaries
programme.desc: Hollywood media mogul Harvey Weinstein becomes a catalyst for the #MeToo Movement. Contains testimonials from those who knew him well such as Hillary Clinton, Emma Thompson, Heather Kerr, Ashley Judd, Rose McGowan, Uma Thurman, and more!

programme.title: JFK: The Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Veteran Police Detective Colin McLaren spent four years on the forensic cold-case investigation of JFK's assassination. What he had, and other investigators did not, was modern technology and access to all the evidence, facts and eyewitness testimony.

programme.title: When Claude Got Shot
programme.desc: Three strangers' lives become entwined by a weekend of gun violence.

programme.title: Mourning Son
programme.desc: Dave Navarro was 15 when his mother was brutally murdered. Now over 30 years later, he confronts the events that changed his life forever.

programme.title: The House on Sweet and Seventh
programme.desc: This chilling and heartbreaking documentary looks back on the 1998 murder of Barbara and Gordon Erickstad in Bismarck, North Dakota.

programme.title: ¿Dónde Están?
programme.desc: Desde 1993, cientos de mujeres han desaparecido de la ciudad fronteriza de Juárez, MX, justo al otro lado del río Grande de El Paso, TX. El aclamado cineasta Charlie Minn se adentra en estos misteriosos crímenes sin resolver que han hundido a Juárez.

programme.title: Mugshots: Robert Durst - Mogul in Murder Mystery
programme.desc: Robert Durst was the scion of a multi-millionaire real estate family, but was always a bit of an eccentric. He is suspected of killing three people.

programme.title: The UnPerfect Crime
programme.desc: The employees of a North Carolina armored car company fantasized about it all the time: what would it take to steal millions of dollars stashed in the company vault? But for one such employee, the dream became a reality...

programme.title: Angel of Death
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar always preferred the graveyard shift at Glendale Adventist Medical Center, where he worked as a respiratory therapist. It was during the late hours of the night, when Saldivar would inject his patients with a drug.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of the American Mafia in Las Vegas
programme.desc: The Rise and Fall of the American Mafia in Las Vegas is a 90-minute documentary film by Mark W. Curran. It tells the story of how the mob came to control Las Vegas through corruption, greed, and murder.

programme.title: The Boneyard (2000)
programme.desc: The discovery of a secret concrete bunker in the California Mountains launches a massive investigation into the bizarre world of two men obsessed with kidnapping, sexual enslavement and murder.

programme.title: The Hydra
programme.desc: “The Hydra” is about the rise of ecstasy and other synthetic drugs in Europe after the collapse of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s. The film tells the extraordinary covert operation to bring down the drug cartels.

programme.title: Escape From Death Row
programme.desc: Mecklenburg Penitentiary's Death Row is considered "escape proof". The men housed there are serial murderers and rapists. But on a cold spring night in 1984, six of them got out....

programme.title: Dangerous Company
programme.desc: The life of an international drug trafficker is seedy and extremely dangerous, and exactly the kind of life a couple of Kentucky bluebloods decided to lead. They decided to team up to form “The Company.”

programme.title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Sir Trevor McDonald presents this documentary which explores the extraordinary pursuit of serial killer Christopher Halliwell by detective Steve Fulcher.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Thieves
programme.desc: An exclusive inside take on the biggest heist in British history - The Great Train Robbery. This film reveals the inside man for the first time.

programme.title: Fatal Distraction
programme.desc: Inspired by the Pulitzer Prize-winning article in the Washington Post, Fatal Distraction tells the untold story of the high-profile Georgia murder trial of Justin Ross Harris following the hot car death of his toddler son in 2014.

programme.title: 10 Most Evil Serial Killers (2015)
programme.desc: Explore the dark and twisted world of the Top Ten Victorian Serial Killers. From evil gangs with their hearts set on vengeance to sick and twisted doctors who used their knowledge to take numerous lives, the world of the serial killer knows no bounds.

programme.title: The Diary Of Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Step by painstaking step, the diary is analyzed, verified, and questioned; experts pit their knowledge against the information in the diary.

programme.title: The Ballymurphy Precedent
programme.desc: Told through witness testimony, forensic investigation, innovative reconstruction techniques and powerful, engaging storytelling, this documentary tells of the killings of ten innocent Catholics in August 1971 in Belfast, Northern Ireland.

programme.title: Witch Hunt in Salem
programme.desc: In 1692, at a time when Europe has largely overcome the witch craze, dozens of people are accused of sorcery and executed in Salem.

programme.title: Jonestown: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Using survivor testimony and dramatic reenactments, this documentary tracks the build-up to a horrific doomsday.

programme.title: Danny Greene: The Rise and Fall of the Irishman
programme.desc: A documentary on the life and death of Cleveland's legendary gangster and his battle with the Italian Mob. This documentary spotlight's the gangster whose life was famously extinguished by a car bomb in Lyndhurst parking lot.

programme.title: We Stand Corrected: Dannemora
programme.desc: We Stand Corrected: Dannemora examines the causes and effects of the 2015 escape from Clinton Correctional Facility in New York. Told from those on the inside, it's an alternate narrative to that which was told by the media.

programme.title: PreCrime
programme.desc: Science fiction turns into disturbing fact as forecasting softwares, algorithms and databases quickly become the new fortune-tellers for future crimes, driving us to ask: how much are we willing to abandon for the sake of security?

programme.title: The Worst Crime
programme.desc: Johnny Johnson was charged with the abduction and murder of 6-year-old Cassandra Williamson. During the capital murder trial, a juror described the killing as the worst possible crime. Does the worst possible crime warrant the worst possible punishment?

programme.title: Real Fake
programme.desc: An investigative documentary about Elmyr de Hory, one of history’s most notorious art forgers who is alleged to have painted thousands of fakes but never convicted. The film re-opens the criminal case, examining his art, life and crimes.

programme.title: G-Dog (2015)
programme.desc: G-Dog tells the entertaining, hilarious and unlikely story of how a white Jesuit priest became an expert in gang lives and transformed the lives of thousands of Latino, Asian, and African American gang members.

programme.title: The Guardians
programme.desc: An investigative documentary that examines the systemic abuse of elderly people in Las Vegas, Nevada exposing a cautionary tale where some of our society’s most vulnerable citizens are robbed of their life savings and freedom.

programme.title: Miracle Fishing: Kidnapped Abroad
programme.desc: The story of a father's kidnapping as told through the 1994 video diaries of his son, the film's Director Miles Hargrove.

programme.title: Arctic Manhunt Hunt for the Mad Trapper
programme.desc: In 1931, a stranger appeared out of nowhere in the Canadian Arctic. Months later, the North's biggest manhunt was launched to find the elusive murderer and thief. The fugitive's unknown identity died with him, never to be discovered until now.

programme.title: The Sunshine Makers
programme.desc: A real-life "Breaking Bad" for the psychedelic set, "The Sunshine Makers" reveals the story of Nicholas Sand and Tim Scully, the unlikely duo at the heart of the 1960s American drug counterculture.

programme.title: Barely Legal
programme.desc: A plant, a medicine, a drug? Illegal for decades for many confusing reasons, the most glaring being systematic racism, with cannabis, we are undoubtedly still stuck in a rut today in most of the United States.

programme.title: The Krays: The Myth Behind the Legend
programme.desc: Ronnie and Reggie Kray remain two of the most infamous criminals in British history. Legends to many, their fame was built on a fearsome reputation and almost mythical celebrity-like status, but who were the real Kray twins?

programme.title: Method of Murder
programme.desc: Guns, lions, illusions, and shallow graves all presented by British author Jacky Rom who jets off to LA and Las Vegas to investigate murder weapons, deception, and body disposal methods, to help inspire her latest crime vel.

programme.title: Double Murder
programme.desc: On June 1, 2005, police were called to a house in Luton, where they made the grim discovery of two Polish brothers who had been brutally murdered.

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

programme.title: Amy Fisher: Kill For Me
programme.desc: Amy Fisher was arrested for shooting Mary Jo Buttafuoco and said that it was an accident.

programme.title: Aaron Hernandez: Life Inside
programme.desc: A look at the friendship between former NFL player Aaron Hernandez and Sheriff Thomas Hodgson.

programme.title: The Dating Game Killer: The Lost Victims
programme.desc: Authorities estimate that Rodney Alcala may have killed up to 130 young girls and women.

programme.title: Preppy Killer: My Friend The Murderer
programme.desc: Socialite and friend Margo Manhattan gives the real story on Robert Chambers.

programme.title: Steven Avery: Confessions of a Killer
programme.desc: For the first time, Karl Wernecke reveals secrets that Steven Avery told him while behind bars.

programme.title: Drew Peterson: Killer-In-Law
programme.desc: Norma Peterson, Neil Schori and Stacy's pastor examine the Peterson story and other famous cases.

programme.title: Green River Killer: I Met My Sister's Killer
programme.desc: The sister of one of a serial killer's victims confronts him in prison, hoping for answers.

programme.title: Affluenza Teen: The Jailhouse Sessions
programme.desc: Ethan Couch was convicted of killing four people and seriously injuring two.

programme.title: Cropsey (2010)
programme.desc: Filmmakers uncover a reality that is more terrifying than any urban legend.

programme.title: The Lie: The Murder of Grace Millane
programme.desc: The raw and confronting exploration of the Grace Millane missing person case and murder trial.

programme.title: The Krays: Gangsters Behind Bars
programme.desc: Featuring exclusive interviews, this film provides a personal and horrifying portrait of the Krays behind bars.

programme.title: The True Story of John Dillinger
programme.desc: Michael Mann directed his latest movie Public Enemies, with Johnny Depp as the famous gangster John Dillinger.

programme.title: Nandor Fodor and the Talking Mongoose
programme.desc: Simon Pegg, Minnie Driver, and Christopher Lloyd star in this wildly entertaining adventure when a paranormal psychologist investigates claims of a talking animal.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

programme.title: Burning
programme.desc: Hailed by critics as one of the best films of the year, BURNING is a searing romantic thriller about a young man whose suspicions spin out of control when the free-spirited woman he loves disappears.

programme.title: Under the Silver Lake
programme.desc: When his beautiful, mysterious neighbor disappears without a trace, Sam (Andrew Garfield) tries to find the parties responsible, unraveling a string of strange crimes, unsolved murders, & bizarre coincidences in his East L.A. neighborhood.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra-marital affair.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Perfume: The Story of a Murderer
programme.desc: In 18th-century France lived Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, who was born with a great sense of smell. But as his gift becomes an obsession, he strives to create the most intoxicating perfume in the world by murdering young women to capture their essence.

programme.title: Death On The Nile
programme.desc: As Hercule Poirot enjoys a luxurious cruise down the Nile, a newlywed heiress is found murdered on board. Can Poirot identify the killer before the ship reaches the end of its journey?

programme.title: Appointment With Death
programme.desc: Super-sleuth Hercule Poirot becomes friendly with a young psychiatrist, Sarah King, while on a cruise. Sarah becomes infatuated with another passenger, Raymond Boynton, who is totally dominated by his mother, and she discourages any notions of romance.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: When a plague of bizarre, puzzling murders grip London, young Holmes and his new found friend Watson find themselves unwittingly entangled in the dark mystery.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Sherlock: A Case of Evil
programme.desc: This tale focuses on the young 20-something Sherlock Holmes. Sherlock is in pursuit of the evil Moriarty and apparently shoots him to death, but his body cannot be found as he falls in a sewer.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and The Secret Weapon (in Color)
programme.desc: Kidnappers of the inventor of a new wartime bombsight threaten to sell the invention to the Nazis. In Color!

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Prelude to Murder (in Color)
programme.desc: A trio of music boxes contains the hidden secret to riches, and a group of criminals will kill for them. In Vibrant Color!

programme.title: The Vanishing of Sidney Hall
programme.desc: An enigmatic detective (Kyle Chandler) goes on a cross-country search for a once-prominent author (Logan Lerman), who has mysteriously disappeared after a string of dangerous arsons have targeted his celebrated, controversial first novel.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: Adam is a glum professor who has grown disinterested by his ordinary life. When he discovers a man who appears to be his double, the lives of the identical men become bizarrely, hauntingly intertwined. In the end, only one man can survive.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: Homicide
programme.desc: A Jewish homicide detective investigates a seemingly minor murder and falls in with a Zionist group as a result.

programme.title: Spinning Man
programme.desc: When a female college student goes missing, a popular professor is the prime suspect. Suddenly, the questions he faces aren’t merely academic – they’re a matter of life and death.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Jaded detective, Travis Hurley (Simon Baker), investigates a 20-year old outback cold case murder.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night (1967)
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

programme.title: Gorky Park
programme.desc: Three mutilated bodies are found in Moscow's Gorky Park, and it's up to Russian police officer Arkady Renko to find the maniacal killer. From the best-selling mystery novel by Martin Cruz Smith.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Under the inimitable direction of Robert Altman, Elliot Gould stars as the laid-back, legendary private eye Philip Marlowe investigating a mysterious murder. Also stars Sterling Hayden and Nina Van Pallandt.

programme.title: The Name of the Rose
programme.desc: In 1327, an enlightened friar and his young apprentice investigate a series of mysterious deaths at an abbey, risking the wrath of a powerful Inquisitor. Television adaptation of Umberto Eco's novel 'The Name of the Rose'.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep
programme.desc: A woman wakes up every day, remembering nothing as a result of a traumatic accident in her past. One day, new terrifying truths emerge that force her to question everyone around her.

programme.title: The Limehouse Golem
programme.desc: With the Limehouse Golem serial killer on the loose, Inspector Kildare must rely on help from a troubled witness to bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: After Life
programme.desc: After a horrific car accident, Anna (Christina Ricci) wakes up to find the funeral director (Liam Neeson) preparing her body for her funeral.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: As an actress begins to adopt the persona of her character in a film, her world becomes nightmarish and surreal.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Ten Little Indians
programme.desc: This classic whodunit by mystery maven Agatha Christie is played out in a remote African safari bush camp, where a diverse group of intriguing characters fall victim, one by one, to an unknown, unseen assailant.

programme.title: Mulholland Falls
programme.desc: Four tough, no-nonsense and very crooked cops investigate the murder of a young woman, When they discover she was romantically linked to their boss and a prominent U.S. Army General, they try to cover up the murder.

programme.title: The Alphabet Killer
programme.desc: A detective investigates a series of murders of young girls, grappling with paranoia and a deteriorating mental state in this gripping thriller.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution (1958)
programme.desc: Tyrone Power, Marlene Dietrich, and Charles Laughton star in this exceptional courtroom Drama about a young man on trial for a wealthy widow's murder after he suspiciously profits from her will.

programme.title: Cutter's Way
programme.desc: This intriguing film features John Heard as a boozy, belligerent Vietnam vet who seeks passionate revenge on a murderer after his aimless friend (Jeff Bridges) is falsely accused of the crime.

programme.title: The Private Life Of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: When a beautiful woman claims that her husband has disappeared, the investigation takes Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to Scotland, where they uncover a plot involving a clandestine society, Her Majesty's Secret Service... and the Loch Ness Monster!

programme.title: In The Electric Mist
programme.desc: While on an investigation into a series of grisly murders, veteran detective Dave Robicheaux navigates his way through the Louisiana bayou and the dark, sultry world of New Orleans mobster.

programme.title: Sorted
programme.desc: After the mysterious drowning death of his brother, Carl Dawson (Matthew Rhys) heads to London to investigate. Teaming up with his brother's beautiful girlfriend (Sienna Guillory), Carl delves into the heart of London's wild, drug-crazed club scene.

programme.title: Strangerland
programme.desc: A couple finds its dull life rocked after their two teenagers disappear into the desert, sparking disturbing rumors of their past. Starring Nicole Kidman, Joseph Fiennes, Hugo Weaving.

programme.title: Beast (2018)
programme.desc: A troubled woman living in an isolated community finds herself pulled between the control of her oppressive family and the allure of a secretive outsider suspected of a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: Louder Than Bombs
programme.desc: LOUDER THAN BOMBS explores the death of a famous photographer (Isabelle Huppert), and how her husband (Gabriel Byrne) and sons, (Jesse Eisenberg and Devin Druid) cope while unraveling the truth behind the mysterious accident that claimed her life.

programme.title: The Reckoning
programme.desc: After his partner is murdered, a detective must track down two teenage runaways whose video footage contains the identity of the killer. Featuring Luke Hemsworth.

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: Unable to solve a series of homicides, the FBI enlists a retired consultant with psychic powers. Is he a match for the extraordinary powers of the vicious murderer on a mission?

programme.title: The Scent of Rain & Lightning
programme.desc: A young woman investigates the murder of her parents.

programme.title: Coherence
programme.desc: In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

programme.title: Slam Dance
programme.desc: A cartoonist and painter (Tom Hulce) must dig through the underbelly of the L.A. club scene when his ex-girlfriend (Virginia Madsen) is found dead and he is framed for the murder.

programme.title: Frankie & Alice
programme.desc: A go-go dancer struggles with a split personality.

programme.title: Manhattan Night
programme.desc: When an alluring widow asks a journalist to solve the mysterious death of her filmmaker husband, the inquiry draws him into a dangerous world of adultery, blackmail, and murder.

programme.title: The Falling
programme.desc: It's 1969 at a strict English girls' school where charismatic Abbie and intense and troubled Lydia are best friends. After a tragedy occurs at the school, a mysterious fainting epidemic breaks out, threatening the stability of all involved.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: The police don’t believe her, so a woman (Amanda Seyfried) sets out alone to track the serial killer she escaped from in the past and who she now believes has abducted her sister.

programme.title: The Cat's Meow
programme.desc: In 1924, media mogul William Randolph Hearst gathered some of the world's best known personalities for a trip of his yacht that resulted in a still-unsolved, hushed-up murder.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: An uptight female psychiatrist attempts to intercede with a con man on behalf of one of her patients, a compulsive gambler who owes him several thousand dollars. She is sucked into a world of mirrors where nothing is what it seems.

programme.title: Trouble Is My Business
programme.desc: Detective Roland Drake falls for two sisters from the Montemar family. One woman is dead and the other wants to kill him. Passion, murder, and betrayal. Just another day at the office.

programme.title: The Vanished
programme.desc: A family vacation takes a terrifying turn when a couple's young daughter disappears without a trace. As the list of suspects grows, the search for the truth leads to a shocking revelation.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Xavier Quinn is the police chief of a tiny Caribbean island. He is on good terms with all. When a prominent businessman is murdered, Quinn, like everyone else, believes that the killer is Maubee--a local folk hero and Quinn's childhood friend.

programme.title: The White Orchid
programme.desc: A shy investigator assumes the identity of a small-town murder victim in order to solve her gruesome death.

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Ten Little Indians
programme.desc: Ten people are invited to a hotel in the Iranian desert, only to find that an unseen person is killing them one by one. Could one of them be the killer?

programme.title: The 39 Steps (1935)
programme.desc: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage Agent. But when the Agent is killed, and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring which is trying to steal top secret information.

programme.title: Here Before
programme.desc: Xia Tian is on the verge of a major discovery: time travel. When her son is kidnapped and killed, she desperately sends herself back in time, where she discovers multiple versions of her future self.

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: The disappearance of a little girl in a gritty Boston neighborhood pair two private detectives with the police in this riveting, multi-layered mystery.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: When an inventor turns up dead, a mysterious man (Peter Dinklage) steals his latest invention: a device able to extract, record and play a person’s memories.

programme.title: Child 44
programme.desc: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: While traveling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

programme.title: Night Train (2009)
programme.desc: While on a night train, three strangers discover a corpse and a box of diamonds. At first, the three scheme to ditch the body and split the fortune - until their greed and paranoia pits them against each other.

programme.title: Flesh And Bone
programme.desc: A figure from the past awakens a memory as deep and dark as a grave: a family history written in cold blood.

programme.title: Lies We Tell
programme.desc: In an isolated manor, an orphaned heiress must fight her guardian for her inheritance - and her life.

programme.title: 12 Angry Men
programme.desc: Eleven jurors are convinced that the defendant is guilty of murder. The twelfth has no doubt of his innocence. How can this one man steer the others toward the same conclusion? Henry Fonda and Lee J. Cobb lead the all-star cast in this classic!

programme.title: Pay the Ghost
programme.desc: One year after his young son disappeared during a Halloween carnival, Mike Lawford (Nicolas Cage) will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery and find his son.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes (1938)
programme.desc: While travelling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Ordeal By Innocence
programme.desc: Back from a long trip, Dr. Calgary seeks to return an item left in his car by a young hitchhiker – Jack Argyle. Except Jack was executed for a murder, committed while in the doctor’s car. Calgary can clear Jack’s name. So...why is no one interested?

programme.title: The Shortcut
programme.desc: Two brothers take a shortcut that is part of their hometown legend, due to the disappearance of young kids years before. Before long, they discover the reason why it's so rarely used.

programme.title: Curse of the Jade Scorpion
programme.desc: CW Briggs is a veteran insurance investigator and Betty Ann Fitzgerald is a new employee. One night, the office goes to a magic show and the two get hypnotized for the magician's own schemes. Will they end up investigating themselves?

programme.title: Secrets in the Water
programme.desc: When Mia's body washes ashore, her mother, Laura, enlists the help of Mia's best friend to figure out who killed her daughter. Together, they narrow down the suspects. But further investigation uncovers a new piece of evidence that changes everything.

programme.title: New Best Friend
programme.desc: A North Carolina sheriff investigates the near-fatal drug overdose of an underachieving college girl, and uncovers many sordid details of her life before and during her descent into drugs and debauchery.

programme.title: Nancy
programme.desc: Nancy becomes increasingly convinced she was kidnapped as a child. When she meets a couple whose daughter went missing thirty years ago, reasonable doubts give way to willful belief.

programme.title: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves is a defense attorney trying to clear a teen in the brutal stabbing of his father. As more evidence comes to light, the whole truth seems darker than ever.

programme.title: Always Shine
programme.desc: Best friends Anna & Beth take a weekend trip to Big Sur, hopeful to re-establish a bond broken by years of competition & jealousy. Tensions mount, leading to an unexpected yet inevitable confrontation, changing both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Revealed - Jack the Ripper: Tabloid Killer
programme.desc: Thanks to his gruesome deeds and chilling nickname, ‘Jack the Ripper’ is the most famous serial killer in history. And he was certainly the first to cause a media sensation when he terrorised the streets of East London back in 1888.

programme.title: The Madeleine McCann Case
programme.desc: It is every parents worst nightmare. Their daughter, only three years of age, taken from her bed.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Rose West
programme.desc: A look into the psychology of one of Britains most notorious serial killers, Rose West.

programme.title: Killer Doctor: The Harold Shipman Case
programme.desc: Known as 'doctor death', Shipman was a general practitioner operating in Hyde, greater Manchester. From police negligence, to manipulation, Shipman was able to murder over 200 victims, hiding under a soft, caring demeanor.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in London. We delve into the psychology of Dennis to try and understand what turned him so cruel.

programme.title: Psychopaths: Killing Spree Couples
programme.desc: What creates a Psychopathic Killer? Are they natural born killers or is society somehow to blame? For these psychopathic couples murder is just a game.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Brain
programme.desc: A billionaire, intent on destroying Communism by starting a world war, is close to achieving his goal with the help of the world's largest, and most powerful, computer. Secret Agent Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is the only man who can stop him!

programme.title: Duel at Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: This dazzling film noir from Stanley Kubrick is about a struggling New York boxer (Jamie Smith), whose life is imperiled when he protects a nightclub dancer (Irene Kane) from her gangster boss.

programme.title: The Killing
programme.desc: With fascinating detail, Stanley Kubrick lays bare the intricate inner-planning of a racetrack heist by a deadly mastermind (Sterling Hayden) and his crew. Co-stars Coleen Gray.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in the relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: A London tourist gets entangled in espionage in this Hitchcock Classic

programme.title: No Way To Treat A Lady
programme.desc: A crafty serial killer plays a game of cat-and-mouse with a harried police detective trying to track him down.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard undercover detective is on the trail of a saboteur who is part of a plot to set off a bomb in London. But when the detective's cover is blown, the plot begins to unravel.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: A British Couple on holiday in Switzerland become embroiled in dangerous political intrigue.

programme.title: Targets
programme.desc: Elderly horror-film star who, while making a personal appearance at a drive-in theater, confronts a psychotic Vietnam veteran who's turned into a mass-murdering sniper.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.desc: When bigoted ex-con Earl Slater agrees to carry out a heist with a disgraced former cop and his cohorts – one of whom is Black – tensions mount as the job comes together, until Earl’s seething hatred erupts, risking the heist...and their lives!

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself. John Barrymore stars in this silent horror classic featuring a brand-new score by Michael Richard Plowman.

programme.title: The Wrong Teacher
programme.desc: A teacher's affair with a younger man turns out to be a new student with dangerous consequences.

programme.title: Sorry, Wrong Number
programme.desc: Leona is confined to her bed. One night, whilst waiting for he husband to return home, she picks up the phone and accidentally overhears a conversation between two men planning a murder.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck veteran lands a job as a chauffeur to a sadistic millionaire.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Charlie is out of jail and on the make with a plan for the heist of the century. Aided by top criminal mastermind Mr Bridger, Charlie sets off with a team of villains and to lift $4,000,000 from under the noses of the Turin Polizei.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: In Stanley Kramer's cinema classic, screen legends Sidney Poitier and Tony Curtis star as two convicts on the run from a Southern work gang who are bound together by an unbreakable iron chain and separated by an unbridled hatred for each other.

programme.title: After The Fox
programme.desc: Pretending to be a movie director, an Italian crook known as The Fox (Peter Sellers) cons local villagers and the police into smuggling into Rome the loot from a $3 million Cairo bullion robbery...as part of the film script!

programme.title: The Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world-renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas, and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A boring man is dragged into lust by a mysterious femme fatale.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Peter Ustinov won an Oscar for Best Supporting Actor in this lighthearted thriller about five thieves (including Melina Mercouri, Maximilian Schell, and Robert Morley) who undertake an absolutely impossible grand theft in Istanbul.

programme.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
programme.desc: As a small-time hood, Eddie is about to go back to jail. In order to escape this fate, he deals information on stolen guns to the feds. Simultaneously he is supplying arms to his bank robbing/kidnapping hoodlum chums.

programme.title: Convict's Code (1939)
programme.desc: Dave Tyler (Robert Kent) is being released from prison after serving three years for a crime he claims he didn't commit.

programme.title: Dick Tracy Vs. Cueball
programme.desc: A braided cord is his only clue as Tracy (Conway) searches desperately for a gang of jewel thieves.

programme.title: Stand-In

programme.title: The Cry Baby Killer
programme.desc: A teenage boy panics and takes hostages when he thinks he's committed murder. Jack Nicholson's film debut as the juvenile delinquent.

programme.title: The Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Bogart plays an escaped con who has nothing to lose. March is a suburban Everyman who has everything to lose - his family is held hostage by Bogart.

programme.title: I Walk Alone
programme.desc: After taking the rap for his partner, a mobster is released from prison to find his former partner entranched in a swank night club with no intention of sharing the riches.

programme.title: Grand Slam
programme.desc: A quiet schoolteacher recruits an elite team of international criminals for the ultimate diamond caper at the frenzied peak of Carnival.

programme.title: Danger Diabolik
programme.desc: The suave thief called Diabolik can’t get enough of life’s good – or glittery – things. Not when there are currency shipments to steal from under the noses of government officials and priceless jewels to lift from the boudoirs of the rich.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A small-time mob boss feeds dope to high school girls hungry for kicks.

programme.title: The Children Act
programme.desc: Judge Fiona May (Emma Thompson) must race against the clock to determine the fate of a teenage boy (Fionn Whitehead) in need of a life-saving blood transfusion, stretching her life and her fractured marriage to the breaking point.

programme.title: Inherit The Wind
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy and Fredric March go toe-to-toe in this powerful recreation of a titanic courtroom battle in which an attorney faces off against a fundamentalist in a Tennessee town where a teacher has been brought to trial for teaching Darwinism.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “para-lawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about an 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Judgment At Nuremberg
programme.desc: Judge Daniel Haywood (Spencer Tracy) presides over the trial of four German jurists accused of 'legalizing' Nazi atrocities. But mounting political pressure for leniency forces Haywood into making the most difficult decision of his career.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Desmond Doyle, who after losing his job and watching his wife leave with another man, has his children taken away by an arcane custody law. Doyle cleans up his act and wages an unlikely legal battle to regain custody.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, a low level gangster named Jackie DiNorscio defends himself in court in what became the longest criminal trial in American judicial history.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Successful big city lawyer Casey McKay travels to a small rural town where he reluctantly agrees to defend his no-good ex-brother-in-law for murder, but in the midst of fighting for his client's life. Casey finds himself in a fight for what he loves.

programme.title: Conflict of Interest
programme.desc: A successful attorney's past begins to haunt her when a man she prosecutes could be her long lost son.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: An attorney investigates a malpractice case against her physician husband and discovers that he had an affair with his nurse, and that the patient's death may have been a murder planned and executed by the two of them.

programme.title: Nothing But The Truth
programme.desc: Washington DC political journalist Rachel Armstrong writes an explosive story about a government scandal in which she reveals the name of a covert CIA agent.

programme.title: Percy vs Goliath
programme.desc: Academy Award(r) Winner(tm) Christopher Walken, Zach Braff and Christina Ricci star in the true story of a small-town farmer's relentless fight against one of the largest agricultural corporations, a court case that makes its way up to the Supreme Court.

programme.title: Denial
programme.desc: Acclaimed writer and historian Deborah E. Lipstadt must battle for historical truth to prove the Holocaust actually occurred when David Irving, a renowned denier, sues her for libel.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Winner of 6 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and based on the hit Broadway musical, Chicago is a dazzling spectacle cheered by audiences and critics alike, where crimes of passion make way for legends to those seeking the spotlight.

programme.title: Undue Influence
programme.desc: A defense attorney promises his dying wife that he will help her sister win a custody battle against her ex-husband. But when a murder takes place, and he tries to investigate, he finds himself caught in a complex web of infidelities and homicide.

programme.title: Trial By Jury (1994)
programme.desc: Valerie is a juror in the trial of a mob boss. When her young son's life is threatened, she has no option other than to see that justice isn't done.

programme.title: Too Close to Home
programme.desc: Starring Judith Light and Rick Schroder. A woman obsessed with her adult son, angered by the idea of him leaving her and his marriage to a beautiful nurse, does everything in her power to prevent his independence.

programme.title: Night Falls On Manhattan (1997)
programme.desc: A newly elected District Attorney finds himself in the middle of a police corruption investigation that may involve his father and his partner.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Chris "Slapshot" Pratt, whose once-bright future has been dimmed by a severe head injury, is a night janitor at a bank. Lonely and frustrated, he falls prey to a con man and agrees to help rob the bank where he works.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Stone
programme.desc: Academy-Award®-winner Robert De Niro and Academy-Award®-nominee Edward Norton deliver powerful performances as a seasoned corrections official and a scheming inmate whose lives become dangerously intertwined in this thought-provoking drama.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: A hitman tries to retire, but a beautiful thief may change his plans.

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed global hit film is a true story of crime and redemption set in one of the most notorious slums: Rio de Janeiro's "City of God."

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After being released from prison, Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) takes a job with his powerfully influential Uncle Frank (James Caan). Leo soon finds himself unwittingly drawn into a world of sabotage, high-stakes payoffs, and even murder.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Accident Man
programme.desc: Mike is a tough hitman, who makes his hits look like accidents or suicide. He's in a gang of hitmen, each with his own style. When his loved ex is killed, Mike looks for those responsible.

programme.title: Requiem for a Dream

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: James Caan and Robert Duvall star in Sam Peckinpah's tense, action-packed thriller that explores savagery and betrayal in the murky world of killers-for-hire.

programme.title: Femme Fatale (2002)
programme.desc: After Laure pulls of an audacious jewel heist at the 2001 Cannes Film Festival, she decides to turn a new leaf — but it's not long before her past comes back to haunt her. An intense thriller starring Rebecca Romijn and Antonio Banderas.

programme.title: Harry Brown
programme.desc: An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.

programme.title: Killshot
programme.desc: An experienced hitman and his unhinged young partner target a blue-collar couple who have entered Witness Protection after witnessing an extortion scam gone wrong. Based on the novel by Elmore Leonard.

programme.title: The Corrupted
programme.desc: Liam McDonagh (Sam Claflin), an ex-con attempting to live a peaceful life is thrust into action when his brother becomes entangled in a dangerous web of corruption. Liam must risk it all to save his family.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: When safe cracker Nick decides it's time to settle down with his girlfriend Diane and stick to his legitimate business, running a jazz nightclub, his friend and partner Max has other plans.

programme.title: Secuestro Express
programme.desc: Young couple Carla (Maestro) and Martin (Leroux) are abducted by three men and spend a terrifying night in Caracas as they wait for Carla's father (Blades) to hand over the ransom.

programme.title: Sin City: A Dame To Kill For
