programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish 3
programme.desc: In this high-voltage thriller, Charles Bronson sets out to avenge the murder of an old friend who met his demise at the hands of a New York street hoodlum.

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka (1988)
programme.desc: This ultra-hip Comedy in the tradition of The Naked Gun and Airplane stars Keenan Ivory Wayans in an Action Adventure filled with screwball gags and side-splitting one-liners.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: The lives of a group of teenagers are thrown into a moral spin when one murders his girlfriend. Faced with the brutal reality of death, each must decide whether to turn their friend in to the police.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: A mobster's wife hates her lifestyle but gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed--if the Long Island mob and the FBI let her.

programme.title: 10 To Midnight
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays a tough L.A. cop whose daughter is stalked by a cunning sex-killer in this riveting police thriller that offers a first-rate cast including Wilford Brimley.

programme.title: The Presidio
programme.desc: Lt. Col. Caldwell and Police Inspector Jay Austin don’t like each other. Not even a little bit. That’s because Caldwell helped run Austin out of the military police a few years back. They are forced to team up to solve a brutal murder.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: A career Army sergeant is assigned to take a prisoner from Berlin to Washington, D.C. When his prisoner escapes, he finds himself in the middle of a conspiracy whose masterminds want him out of the way.

programme.title: The Pope Of Greenwich Village
programme.desc: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A reforming ex-gangster tries to reconcile with his estranged policeman brother, but the ties to his former gang are difficult to break.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow III [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A man travels from China to Vietnam, on the brink of war with America, to retrieve his uncle and cousin but find complications when he falls in love with a female gangster with a dangerous ex.

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck journalist tells his editor that he has an exclusive interview with a Times Square pimp in order to get an assignment. He then fabricates a story identical to that of an infamous pimp wanted by the police for murder.

programme.title: True Confessions
programme.desc: Two of the finest actors of our time, Robert De Niro and Robert Duvall, star in this must-see tale of two brothers set on a collision course as the result of a brutal murder in 1940s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Eight Million Ways to Die
programme.desc: Crime drama based on the novel by Lawrence Block. An ex-Sheriff embarks on an unrelenting mission to avenge the death of a young prostitute at the hands of a ruthless pimp. How far will he go to see justice served?

programme.title: The Exterminator
programme.desc: A man's best friend is killed on the streets of New York City. The man (Robert Ginty) then transforms into a violent killer, turning New York City into a great war zone, and Christopher George is the only one to stop him.

programme.title: The Evil That Men Do
programme.desc: A professional killer comes out of retirement to investigate and avenge the brutal murder of an old friend.

programme.title: Patty Hearst
programme.desc: Patty Hearst's own story of her kidnapping.

programme.title: Trouble In Mind
programme.desc: In the fictional Rain City, ex-cop Hawk has just been released from prison after serving hard time. Meanwhile, a young down-on-his-luck father, Coop, and his radiant wife, Georgia, head toward the city with their new baby in search of a new life.

programme.title: How To Beat The High Cost Of Living
programme.desc: A caper comedy about three suburban housewives who, in order to beat inflation and subsidize their alimony checks, plot to steal $1 million from a large plastic ball which is displayed in a local shopping center.

programme.title: Atlantic City
programme.desc: For Lou, 40 years a bodyguard-boyfriend to aging beauty queen Grace, his numbers-running sideline escalates to mob involvement. A drug-related slaying leaves him with a small fortune.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: Certain Fury
programme.desc: In this remake of The Defiant Ones, sex worker Scarlet (Tatum O'Neal, Paper Moon) and petty criminal Tracy (Irene Cara, Fame) escape incarceration, fleeing both cops and drug dealers in the process. Featuring Peter Fonda.

programme.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
programme.desc: International superstar Charles Bronson is a vice squad veteran forced to battle his own racial prejudices when he's assigned to track down a young Japanese girl enslaved by a vicious child prostitution ring.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: Rob Lowe and Meg Tilly star in this psychological drama about a wealthy young woman who becomes tangled in a web of passion, deceit and heart-stopping suspense after her stepfather wants her killed.

programme.title: In the Line of Duty: The FBI Murders
programme.desc: In this tense crime drama based on a true 1985 story, two maniacal killers terrorize the citizens of Miami, Florida until the FBI tracks them down and confronts them in the most violent shootout in FBI history.

programme.title: Messenger Of Death
programme.desc: Could a feud between brothers lead to the massacre of an entire family? Charles Bronson travels to a Colorado to investigate and finds a plot of greed and religious zealotry. But can he solve the murders before he receives his own deadly message?

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Game of Death
programme.desc: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: Anthony Quinn and Anthony Franciosa portray New York cops in this fierce thriller about a deadly robbery investigation on the mean streets of Harlem.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

programme.title: The Bank Shot
programme.desc: Fresh from his recent jailbreak, criminal mastermind George C. Scott is already plotting his next bank heist. This time he's thinking big...he's not just taking the loot, he's stealing the whole bank in a film brimming with imaginative silliness.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: The brutal assault at the hands of a racist cop will inform the life of Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson, Hammer), who will grow up to become the reigning head of Harlem’s black mafia in Black Caesar.

programme.title: Black Mama, White Mama
programme.desc: A prostitute (Pam Grier) and a revolutionary (Margaret Markov) escape from a Philippine woman's prison. Disguised as nuns and chained together, they head into the jungle, pursued by local police, and a small-time kingpin enlisted to bring them back.

programme.title: Bobbie Jo And The Outlaw
programme.desc: A stunning carhop who wants to be a country singer and her sweetheart who dreams he's Billy the Kid become involved in robbery and murder.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In a role that powered him to stardom, Charles Bronson is an underworld executioner who turns murder into an art form in this ultimate crime chiller.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian 'Armored Bandit,' who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: The Domino Principle
programme.desc: A Vietnam War veteran, imprisoned for murder, is offered his freedom if he accepts to undertake a contract killing for a shady organization.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Isaac Hayes is a bounty hunter who is after a strong-armed pimp who has skipped bail. In the hunt, the pimp is killed but his girlfriend takes a contract out on Hayes.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: A blaxploitation film about a woman whose drug-dealing brother ratted on her undercover narcotics-agent boyfriend to the mob and she, in turn, poses as a call girl to infiltrate the mobsters who butchered him.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: Pam Grier stars as Coffy, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Coffy uses her sex appeal and an assortment of weapons to rid the streets of society's scum in this cult classic.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and-tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Fred Williamson stars a boxer on the rise who is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success. His moral dilemma hits close to home when the life of his girlfriend (Vonetta McGee) is put in jeopardy.

programme.title: Busting
programme.desc: Elliott Gould and Robert Blake star in this comedy/drama about vice officers, assigned to the mean streets of L.A., who wage a war against crooked cops on the force.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: The dangerous world of international heroin trafficking is exposed in this elaborate and suspenseful crime thriller which reprises Sidney Poitier's role as Lt. Virgil Tibbs.

programme.title: Black Mamba
programme.desc: When Kyiera Stone is killed by corrupt cops, angels reincarnate her as an assassin charged with destroying those who killed her and her friends.

programme.title: The Offence
programme.desc: Sean Connery delivers a devastatingly desperate performance as Detective-Sergeant Johnson, whose 20 years of handling murder, rape, and other violent cases culminate in a deadly loss of control during a routine interrogation. Ian Bannen co-stars.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery, Donald Sutherland, and Lesley-Anne Down star in this true-life action thriller, based on director/screenwriter Michael Crichton's best-selling novel, about a daring gold heist that shocked Victorian society.

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: A fast-paced dynamo about two Harlem cops (Godfrey Cambridge and Raymond St. Jacques) assigned to thwart a charismatic preacher's attempt to extort money from neighborhood locals.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Sequel to Black Ceasar with Fred Williamson starring again as the underworld king of Harlem, the leader of a black syndicate who works his rackets like Robin Hood, doing continuous battle with dishonest politicians, corrupt police, and even his sidekick.

programme.title: Hit!
programme.desc: U.S. agent Nick Allen (Billy Dee Williams) has his own idea about how to fight a war on drugs: go to the source...and cut the big-time traffickers down. Embittered over the drug-related death of his teenage daughter, Nick sets out to do just that.

programme.title: Sheba, Baby
programme.desc: Pam Grier ("Foxy Brown") plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye based in Chicago who is called back to her Louisville, Kentucky, hometown to stop the local mob boss (D’Urville Martin, "Black Caesar") from moving in on her father’s loan business.

programme.title: The Big Racket
programme.desc: Inspector Nico Palmieri is a tough police detective tearing apart Rome to bust a ruthless protection racket. But when these violent thugs expand their empire into drugs, rape, and murder, Nico throws away the rulebook to unleash his own brand of justice.

programme.title: The Outside Man
programme.desc: After fulfilling a contract killing in L.A., a French hit man (Jean-Louis Trintignant) becomes the target in a murderous game of cat-and-mouse.

programme.title: Bugsy Malone
programme.desc: Set in 1929 New York City, Bugsy Malone captures a flashy world of would-be hoodlums, showgirls, and dreamers - all played by child actors!

programme.title: Joe (1970)
programme.desc: Anti-hippie Joe (Peter Boyle) finds a kindred spirit in Bill Compton (Dennis Patrick) who boasts that he killed a drug-dealing hippie (Patrick McDermott). When a news report confirms the incident, vigilante justice is set in motion.

programme.title: The Amsterdam Kill
programme.desc: Ex-DEA agent Quinlan enters a labyrinth of deception and death as he tries to destroy a powerful Amsterdam-based drug cartel named 'Juliana'.

programme.title: Winter Kills
programme.desc: The younger brother of an assassinated US President is led down a rabbit hole of conspiracies and dead ends after learning of a man claiming to be the real shooter.

programme.title: The Big Sleep
programme.desc: A grizzled American private detective in England investigates a complicated case of blackmail turned murder involving a rich but honest elderly general, his two loose socialite daughters, a pornographer and a gangster.

programme.title: Conduct Unbecoming
programme.desc: At a British Regimental party in Colonial India, the widow of Captain Scarlett is assaulted in the garden, and she accuses one of the newly arrived junior Lieutenants of the crime.

programme.title: Guns Akimbo
programme.desc: A guy relies on his newly acquired gladiator skills to save his ex-girlfriend from kidnappers.

programme.title: In The Mix
programme.desc: All's fair in love and gangster warfare when Darrell (Usher), New York’s hottest DJ, saves a mob boss's (Chazz Palminteri) life and is rewarded with a gig protecting his beautiful daughter.

programme.title: American Animals
programme.desc: The unbelievable but true story of four young men who brazenly attempt to execute one of the most audacious art heists in U.S. history.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Lots of laughs and a great camaraderie is the recipe for two street-wise cops that have decided to quit the force and open a bar.

programme.title: 8 Heads in a Duffel Bag
programme.desc: All gangster Tommy Spinelli wants to do is deliver his carry-on duffel bag to his boss. Unfortunately, the bag is switched with a Mexican-bound medical student...who has no idea that the bag contains the severed heads of eight Los Angeles gangsters!

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Alexander Skarsgård and Michael Peña star as two struggling, corrupt cops who are on the take, roughing up criminals and wreaking havoc throughout the city in this action-packed, hilarious, crime caper.

programme.title: The Con Is On
programme.desc: This stylish, star-studded caper comedy stars Uma Thurman and Tim Roth as a con-artist couple cooking up a jewel-theft scam in LA to pay off a sexy, deadly British gangster.

programme.title: Miami Blues
programme.desc: An ex-con (Alec Baldwin) tiptoes on the borderline of psychotic behavior, playing cops and robbers on both sides of the law. He robs and kills one minute and poses as a cop the next in this thriller with a comic edge.

programme.title: Four Rooms
programme.desc: It is New Year's Eve at Hotel Mon Signor. Ted, the bellhop, is working his first night on the job, and the hotel's very unusual guests are about to place him in some outrageously funny predicaments. It's a wild night with a sizzling all-star cast.

programme.title: Envy
programme.desc: A man becomes increasingly jealous of his friend's newfound success.

programme.title: Buffalo '66
programme.desc: Billy Brown just got out of jail. Now he's going to serve some real time. He's going home.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Deep inside the most secure bank in America, three desperate women from very different worlds cook up the most unlikely heist of the century: Smuggle out millions of dollars in worn-out currency headed for a Federal Reserve shredder every day.

programme.title: Freaky Deaky
programme.desc: Set in 1974, a pair of 60s radicals rely on their bomb-making skills to become capitalists.

programme.title: Kill Your Friends
programme.desc: A coldblooded British talent scout (Nicolas Hoult) hunts for the last Megahit of London's Britpop music scene. Fueled by drugs, alcohol, and greed, he plans to eliminate the competition by any merciless (and murderous) means necessary.

programme.title: Curdled
programme.desc: A young woman obsessed with violent crimes becomes an employee of the Post-Forensic Cleaning Service. William Baldwin, Angela Jones, Lois Chiles, Barry Corbin, Daisy Fuentes and Kelly Preston star in this dark comic thriller.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Depp, Paltrow, and McGregor star in this globe-trotting comedy about an unlikely team recruited to find a stolen, priceless painting.

programme.title: Stark Raving Mad
programme.desc: A crook quietly plots his revenge against the boss who murdered his brother while working for him.

programme.title: Jimmy Hollywood
programme.desc: A failing actor living in crime infested Los Angeles, frustrated with his career, decides to take the law into his own hands, and becomes the leader of a mock-vigilante group that videotapes criminals and turns them over to the police.

programme.title: Queenpins
programme.desc: A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.

programme.title: Destiny Turns On The Radio
programme.desc: An escaped bank robber returns to Vegas to retrieve his girl and his loot, only to find both have been taken. Enter Johnny Destiny, a gambler whose control over the odds just may make things turn out okay.

programme.title: Happily
programme.desc: A happily married couple (Joel McHale and Kerry Bishé) discover their friends are resentful of their lustful relationship. When a visit from a mysterious stranger leads to a dead body, they begin to question the loyalty of their so-called friends.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Foul Play
programme.desc: Beware of the Dwarf, whispers the hitchhiker to the beautiful librarian as he dies through a screening of This Gun Is Mine. Suddenly, Hawn is propelled into a world of wild chases and deadly encounters with an assortment of weird characters.

programme.title: The Matador
programme.desc: A globetrotting hitman and a salesman form an unlikely relationship after meeting at a hotel bar in Mexico City.

programme.title: Dead Man on Campus (1998)
programme.desc: Josh is the studious type, Cooper's has a slacker lifestyle that rubs off on Josh and soon has both in danger of flunking out. But there's a catch: a clause in the schools charter awards A's to students who suffer the trauma of a roommate's suicide.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: To work off his tarnished driving record, a hip taxi driver must chauffeur a loser police inspector on the trail of German bank robbers.

programme.title: The Pink Panther (1964)
programme.desc: In this riotously funny farce, Peter Sellers introduced the world to Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case, who is out to stop the notorious Phantom (David Niven) from stealing the priceless Pink Panther diamond!

programme.title: Girl Walks Into a Bar
programme.desc: A dentist (Zachary Quinto) teams up with a feisty would-be assassin (Carla Gugino) to put the final touches on the plan to kill his wife.

programme.title: Confessions of a Dangerous Mind
programme.desc: While a maverick creator of America's favorite game shows gains notoriety for his smash TV hits, he navigates into a shadowy world of danger as a covert government operative. George Clooney directs this incredible stranger-than-fiction story.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: The south of France. Two rival con men -- one is suave and sophisticated, the other is a third-rate American hustler -- make a wager.

programme.title: Buffalo Soldiers
programme.desc: A criminal subculture operates among U.S. soldiers stationed in West Germany just before the fall of the Berlin wall in this comedy starring Joaquin Phoenix, Anna Paquin, and Ed Harris.

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Peter Sellers and Elke Sommer star in this successful sequel to The Pink Panther in which Inspector Clouseau tries to prove a beautiful parlor maid is innocent of killing her chauffer lover.

programme.title: The Return of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: The hilarious, accidentally brilliant Inspector Clouseau once again takes on his archenemy, the insane Dreyfus, as he plots to control the world.

programme.title: Pink Panther Strikes Again
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Dreyfus (Herbert Lom) is finally driven mad by Inspector Clouseau's (Peter Sellers) incompetence and commandeers a doomsday device along with a demand for Clouseau’s death. Are 26 hired assassins a match for Clouseau's dumb luck?

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead. However, the very much alive Inspector travels to Hong Kong to investigate a dangerous drug lord (Robert Webber). Dyan Cannon and Herbert Lom also star.

programme.title: Trail of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: This tribute to the late Peter Sellers contains unused scenes from the previous Pink Panther films interspersed with new footage and features a great comedic cast.

programme.title: Bullets Over Broadway
programme.desc: Struggling 1920s playwright David, failing to secure financing for his latest work, reluctantly makes a deal with mob boss Nick: a Broadway debut with the chance to direct, as long as Nick's girlfriend, Olive, plays one of the lead roles.

programme.title: Curse of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Inspector Clouseau is missing and the Pink Panther (David Niven) is hot on his trail in this wildly funny laugh-fest that offers plenty of slapstick humor and a myriad of stars including Joanna Lumley, Herbert Lom and Robert Wagner.

programme.title: Son Of The Pink Panther
programme.desc: Blake Edwards directs this romantic high-adventure that has Inspector Clouseau's illegitimate (and alarmingly similar!) son (Roberto Benigni) botching a mission to rescue a kidnapped princess (Debrah Farentino).

programme.title: Friends and Romans
programme.desc: Set in a predominantly Italian-American neighborhood in Staten Island,a classic comedy farce that follows Nick DeMaio, a frustrated actor who is determined to rise above the typecasting that perpetually finds him playing the role of Mobster Number 3.

programme.title: Say My Name
programme.desc: When a one-night stand gets interrupted by a robbery, two complete strangers must help each other navigate the seedy underbelly of a Welsh island to recover their stolen property.

programme.title: Lay the Favorite
programme.desc: Beth Raymer (Rebecca Hall) leaves her dancing job at a Florida strip club to become a Las Vegas cocktail waitress.

programme.title: Pawn Shop Chronicles
programme.desc: A missing wedding ring incites a wild-goose chase involving meth addicts, skinheads, and an Elvis impersonator in this action-packed, all-star comedy.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programme.desc: Steve makes a questionable alliance to save his beloved pet.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, and Kevin Bacon bring to life this super-entertaining action fantasy about a regular joe turned homegrown masked avenger.

programme.title: Holiday Hold-Up
programme.desc: After losing their jobs right before Christmas, six disgruntled restaurant employees hatch plots to rob their boss's high stakes poker game . . .not knowing everyone has a plan for payback.

programme.title: Get The Girl
programme.desc: A wealthy young man is conned into staging a fake kidnapping, allowing him to be seen as a hero and win the affection of a girl he's madly in love with.

programme.title: Me and the Mob (1982)
programme.desc: Jimmy Corona is a struggling writer who takes a job with the mob to make ends meet. His wise guy uncle takes him under his wing but then hes nabbed by the cops to rat out his shady associates. Features a young Sandra Bullock as Jimmy's sexy girlfriend.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Whoopi Goldberg stars as a witty, street-smart L.A. narcotics cop who goes undercover to investigate a poisoned drug shipment in this explosive, romantic action-comedy. Co-stars Sam Elliott.

programme.title: The Mule
programme.desc: After a trip to Thailand, a first-time drug mule finds himself in police custody, with his stomach crammed with narcotics. Now, he has to endure seven sphincter-clenching days to convince them of his innocence. Will nature take its course?

programme.title: City Of Love
programme.desc: 1 driver, 1 city, 1 date, 1 miracle and 2 deaths in 66 suspenseful rides.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: So Undercover
programme.desc: A tough, street-smart private eye is hired by the FBI to go undercover in a college sorority.

programme.title: The Dog Problem
programme.desc: When Solo, the writer of one book, runs out of money for therapy, his therapist suggests getting a dog. Problems arise.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: Oscar winners Al Pacino, Christopher Walken, and Alan Arkin star in this action-comedy about retired gangsters who reunite for one last epic night.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Fired from his job and dumped by his fiancee, banker David Walsh turns to his best friend, an inept con artist, for support. Soon, heartbreak becomes the least of David's worries. Starring Matt Dillon, Steve Zahn and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Compromising Positions
programme.desc: An ex-newspaper woman who is now a suburban housewife can't resist getting involved in an investigation of the murder of a philandering dentist who had been having affairs with several of her neighbors.

programme.title: Picking Up The Pieces
programme.desc: A small New Mexican village discovers a severed hand that is considered a miracle of God, when it actually belongs to a murdered spouse with a husband in search of it.

programme.title: Lie Hard
programme.desc: To impress his girlfriend's wealthy parents, a pathological liar borrows $4 million from a crime syndicate to purchase a mansion. Unfortunately for him, all debts need to be paid back…

programme.title: Burn
programme.desc: Melinda is a lonely gas station attendant who is overshadowed by her co-worker Sheila. When the gas station is held at gunpoint, Melinda finds an opportunity to make a connection with the robber.

programme.title: The Death of Dick Long
programme.desc: In small-town Alabama, Zeke & Earl scramble to cover up the unlikely (and, in most states, highly illegal) events that led to their friend's death, as they try to dodge their families, the cops, and one horrified medical examiner.

programme.title: Don Q
programme.desc: A man's belief that he is a powerful mafia boss is put to the test when a ruthless ex-con returns, sparking a turf war.

programme.title: National Lampoon's - The Don's Analyst
programme.desc: A harried mobster seeks psychiatric help when his family--and the family business--begin driving him crazy.

programme.title: The Con Artist (2010)
programme.desc: A notorious car thief endeavors to reinvent himself as an emerging artist after being paroled from prison, only to find that his former handler isn't willing to let him go without a fight.

programme.title: Sumotherhood
programme.desc: This British crime comedy sees two hapless friends run into trouble after an attempted bank robbery goes wrong.

programme.title: Let's Kill Ward's Wife
programme.desc: Everyone wants Ward’s wife dead. But when murderous fantasies get real, Ward and his pals (Donald Faison, Scott Foley, Patrick Wilson, Amy Acker, Nicolette Sheridan)have new problems, like dumping a body and getting away with murder.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: Retired couple Arthur and Martha take up bank robbery after their pensions are cut, refusing to accept the injustice of their circumstances.

programme.title: Montana Amazon Redux

Allison heads to the ranch and meets Hank and his adorable Grandma Stella, who have been running the place together for years. As Allison gets closer to Annabelle’s life, she also becomes a lot closer to Hank. Sparks fly and there are surprises around every corner…

programme.title: Love on Your Doorstep
programme.desc: A talented TV host show profiles a local florist with a groundbreaking same-day-delivery florist service and a long-running flower competition for a chance to land her show.

programme.title: Love by Accident
programme.desc: While on a road trip, Daphne and her godmother Fran get into an accident. Wanting to keep Fran off the road, Daphne enlists their mechanic, Matthew, as her fake boyfriend. But soon, their fake relationship will not be so fake after all.

programme.title: Love in Full Swing
programme.desc: Becks, an aspiring romance columnist, decides to help her best friend Casey as he goes back home in search of his first love. As they start their journey to win back Cassie's first love, they both discover more about each other than they thought they knew. With their friendship on the line, Becks now faces a dilemma: help Casey or risk opening her heart to the love of a lifetime.

programme.title: Heart of the Manor
programme.desc: Before her sister's wedding, real estate agent Lisa is in competition with handsome developer Matthew who wants to buy her family's historic estate. But could he hold the key to Liz's heart?

programme.title: A Town Called Love
programme.desc: Emma needs to prove herself to her boss Jenna. But when she butts heads with the mayor's son on a mission to scout out a town called Love, she decides to impersonate Jenna to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: When a wealthy couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, TAYLOR and BEN, to compete for the job. As they compete for the gig and playfully sabotage each other's efforts but are growing closer together than they realise.

programme.title: Baking Up Love
programme.desc: Morton Pumpkin Co.'s CEO marks the town's 200th anniversary with a bake-off. The favorite to win, the town sweetheart, faces a challenge when her niece stays over, making victory seem elusive.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: Allie and Marily are rivals in the small town of Meadow Ridge, their bakeries across the street from each other. Their rivalry intensifies when the Royal Prince of Samavia rolls into town looking for a royal baker for his brother’s coronation. When Allie and the Royal Prince hit it off, it seems he might be in the market for more than just a terrific cake. But will the sneaky Marilyn let Allie get it all: the gig and the prince? Of course not.

programme.title: A Missed Connection
programme.desc: After finding a spark with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper, but never hears from her – then, 5 years later, they're seated next to each other on a plane heading to the same wedding – hers.

programme.title: With Love, Your Sweetly Salted
programme.desc: Anonymous critic Alison goes viral for trashing a restaurant. Her editor insists she goes undercover as a prep cook for the chef she maligned, but as they bond she risks her identity being revealed.

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: When a young coffee shop owner is threatened with repossession she must take a chance with life and love as she fights to save her business.

programme.title: Meet Me at The Christmas Train Parade
programme.desc: When Charlotte’s son Benny learns about the old tradition of the Christmas train parade, he persuades her to try and reignite the Christmas magic that brought together their community and the neighbouring towns. They enlist the help of Benny’s teacher, but just as Charlotte thinks she might be falling for him, she finds out that he’s been harbouring secrets related to why the parade ended in the first place.

programme.title: Finding Love in Saint Lucia
programme.desc: INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS - An Ornithologist and a Journalist partner up to save an endangered bird species in the jungle of Santa Lucia. They immediately fall in love with the nature, and in the process, they'll also fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Team Bride
programme.desc: Hannah runs a side business making bespoke wedding dresses when she's not busy with her day job at a bridal salon. Her operation is soon threatened, however, when Will, heir to the bridal empire, comes in looking to revamp the brand.

programme.title: Been There All Along
programme.desc: After her public breakup, Charley, the founder of a dating app is near bankruptcy and must team up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

programme.title: A Priceless Love
programme.desc: After realizing one of the items in her store is actually an antique teapot worth $80K, Rose finds herself in the sights of Joe, an antique broker. He's determined to buy the teapot from Rose, but she refuses to sell until she can find the original owner.

programme.title: Sweet on You
programme.desc: Small-town pie shop owner Kate encounters city boy Drew, who has arrived to build tract homes that would run straight through her business. Until Drew soon finds his heart trapped between his family's wishes and a chance at love.

programme.title: A Valentine's Date
programme.desc: Starring Elisa Donovan, Brad Rowe, and Tom Skerritt. A working mother is forced to return to a life she left behind in Texas when her daughter's father files for joint custody.

programme.title: A Bestselling Kind of Love
programme.desc: Nora's first novel shoots to the top of the bestsellers list but is terrified of speaking in front of crowds to promote her book, so her literary agent hires Daniel, a public speaking coach, to help Nora overcome her fears, which is easier said than done.

programme.title: A Match in Manhattan
programme.desc: When Celeste loses her job as a teacher, her boss puts her forward for an au pair job with a NY Property Tycoon. As she struggles with the children, can Celeste win over Richard and his children so she can keep her job, or maybe love has other plans...

programme.title: Love at the Bootcamp
programme.desc: When a scattered marketing exec is tasked with helping an unpopular small-town bootcamp turn its image around, she finds that the strict, regimented ways of its owner might just be the perfect 'fit' for love.

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: Donovan Turner is a smart, independent woman in her late twenties operating a hip café in a small town. She’s also looking for Mr. Right. However, when her café faces foreclosure, Donavan’s business and love life are turned upside down.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords' majestic and dramatic landscapes are just the tip of the iceberg.

programme.title: High Life: Forest Canopy
programme.desc: The trees' canopy holds its biggest animal diversity.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water provides a haven; it can be a nursery, a migration stop, a larder and a home.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: There are few places more magical than a forest where enchantment can be found at every turn.

programme.title: Rainforest Home
programme.desc: Rainforests, the richest habitats on earth, teem with millions of dramatic plants and animals.

programme.title: Bucket List Europe
programme.desc: Europe has a staggering diversity of natural wilderness teeming with wildlife.

programme.title: Bucket List Australia
programme.desc: Exploring Australia's widely varied landscapes and weird and wonderful wildlife.

programme.title: Bucket List Africa
programme.desc: Africa, from mountains to marshland, deserts to coastlines, and grasslands to jungles.

programme.title: Bucket List South America
programme.desc: South America is home to record-breaking mountain ranges and massive rainforests.

programme.title: Breakfast At Tiffany's
programme.desc: Holly is a deliciously eccentric New York City playgirl determined to marry a Brazilian millionaire. George Peppard plays her next-door neighbour, a writer who is “sponsored” by a wealthy Patricia Neal. Guessing who’s the right man for Holly is easy.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine, and Fred MacMurray are superb in this tale of love and ambition in the world of big business that went on to garner a Best Picture Oscar.

programme.title: Irma La Douce
programme.desc: Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

programme.title: Love Affair
programme.desc: A French playboy and an American nightclub singer fall in love aboard a ship

programme.title: The Quiet Man
programme.desc: An American ex-boxer returns to Ireland to win the hand of a spirited young woman. He is confronted by local customs and the woman's belligerent brother. Set in the verdant Irish countryside, this film has beautiful scenery and local charm.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Audrey Hepburn's portrayal of a modern-day princess, rebelling against the royal obligations, who explores Rome on her own. This romantic comedy ranks as one of the most enjoyable films of all times.

programme.title: That Touch of Mink
programme.desc: Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.

programme.title: His Girl Friday
programme.desc: A newspaper editor uses every trick in the book to keep his ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying.

programme.title: Donovan's Reef
programme.desc: Acclaimed director John Ford and screen legend John Wayne team up for what would be their final collaboration in this boisterous, rowdy South Seas escapade.

programme.title: Houseboat
programme.desc: This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

programme.title: Paint Your Wagon
programme.desc: A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife...

programme.title: The Umbrellas Of Cherbourg
programme.desc: A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.

programme.title: The Sterile Cuckoo
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, an eccentric girl forces a college love affair with a reluctant student. Nominated for 2 Academy Awards including Best Song "Come Saturday Morning."

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: Beach Blanket Bingo
programme.desc: When a publicity stunt to promote the singing career of Sugar Kane (Linda Evans) balloons out of control, Frankie (Frankie Avalon), Dee Dee (Annette Funicello), and the gang are pulled into the ensuing comic adventures.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: Burl Ives earned a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his portrayal of a family patriarch involved in a bitter land feud in this explosive western drama that also features a sumptuous musical score.

programme.title: Bikini Beach
programme.desc: There are big waves crashing at Bikini Beach! The beach is close to becoming a retirement village. And a British pop star comes between Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon). Will it all be resolved by the end of summer vacation?

programme.title: Fitzwilly
programme.desc: It’s handmaiden-to-footservant combat when secretary Barbara Feldon attempts to scuttle butler Dick Van Dyke right out of the heist business in this spirited comedy that also stars John McGiver, Norman Fell, Sam Waterston and Edith Evans.

programme.title: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: In their very first screen pairing, Walter Matthau (who would win a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his performance) and Jack Lemmon portray a crooked lawyer and his TV cameraman brother-in-law in this madcap tale of greed and recouping lost love.

programme.title: The Rose Tattoo
programme.desc: A neighborhood is disturbed when truck driver Rosario is killed by police. One day, his wife learns of Rosario's affair, and a new carefree, handsome Italian truck driver enters her life.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: The Seven Year Itch
programme.desc: With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditsy blond (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above his catches his eye.

programme.title: A Scandal in Paris
programme.desc: Born in a French prison in 1775, François Eugène Vidocq becomes a professional thief and is later appointed chief of Parisian police.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

programme.title: Marty
programme.desc: Ernest Borgnine won a Best Actor Oscar for his role as a Bronx butcher who gives up on love, until he meets an equally lonely school teacher in this charming story that garnered a total of four Oscars including Best Picture.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

programme.title: War and Peace
programme.desc: The personal stories of many characters, love affairs and philosophies are woven throughout this massive and intricate tapestry of Russia during Napoleon's invasion at the turn of the 19th century.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

programme.title: The Miracle Of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: After marrying a soldier during a wild night on the town, a small-town girl suffers amnesia and can't remember anything about the man she married.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

programme.title: The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Katharine Hepburn garnered an Oscar nomination as the "plain yet magnetically beautiful" tomboy rancher, with Burt Lancaster brilliantly cast in the role of the smooth-talking con man.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: Owen Waterbury, a bestselling novelist, recruits aspiring writer Stephanie 'Steve' Gaylord as his latest of many secretaries.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: A young ballet dancer is torn between the man she loves and her pursuit to become a prima ballerina.

programme.title: Pot O' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band who constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater, all while winning the heart of the beautiful Molly!

programme.title: Nigel Slater's 12 Tastes of Christmas
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shares the flavors that for him make Christmas a truly delicious season and shows us how to cook for both entertaining and self-indulgence.

programme.title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2014 Special
programme.desc: Christmas is coming and Kirstie home and crafting inspiration for the festive period.

programme.title: Kirstie's Crafty Christmas
programme.desc: Kirstie shows how fast crafts can beat the clock. Her home-made delights include mince pie popcorn with pine tree syrup, a velvet Christmas cheesecake, a contemporary neon star, dramatic Christmas crowns, and traditional gifts.

programme.title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2020
programme.desc: Catherine Fulvio, shows us how to make a selection of delicious, seasonal treats in this episode celebrating the culinary traditions of Christmas.

programme.title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2021
programme.desc: Catherine Fulvio, shows us how to make a selection of delicious, seasonal treats in this episode celebrating the culinary traditions of Christmas.

programme.title: Mariah Carey's Merriest Christmas
programme.desc: This festive holiday special features Mariah Carey herself - along with friends Babyface, Kelsey Grammer, Billy Gardell as Santa, and cast from A Christmas Melody sharing songs, stories, and holiday cheer.

programme.title: Andrea Bocelli: A Bocelli Family Christmas
programme.desc: A Bocelli Family Christmas captures the wonder and music of the holidays with a mix of classic carols and original songs from the Bocelli family's brand new multi-generational album. It's a magical Christmas special for the whole family.

programme.title: The Honeymooners Specials: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: The Honeymooners return for their final series of long-lost specials – in color!

programme.title: A Lionel Christmas
programme.desc: Heartwarming stories from Lionel collectors and layout builders from all over the country remembering the golden age of toy trains, and the holiday excitement of watching Lionel trains puffing smoke and gliding around ovals of three-rail track.

programme.title: A Lionel Christmas 2
programme.desc: See a behind-the-scenes look at Lionel on the NBC Today Show, the magnificent Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center, and the Lionel retail store that was across from Radio City Music Hall. Visit the spectacular displays at the Gaylord Hotel in Dallas.

programme.title: Christmas Train Spectacular
programme.desc: Five amazing Christmas train displays, all with sparkling lights, glistening snow, trains zipping around Christmas villages - and marvelous stories that will tug at your heart, train buff or not.

programme.title: Toy Train Christmas Memories
programme.desc: All aboard for a joyous Christmas ride to a land filled with toy trains, tiny lights, wrapped presents, and the wonder of Christmas. We feature three dazzling Christmas layouts with Lionel, MTH, and G gauge trains dashing about Dept. 56 Villages.

programme.title: Nutcracker: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The colorful holiday classic is finally brought to the big screen, designed by famed children's story author and artist Maurice Sendak, and written for the first time to be as close as possible to the original story.

programme.title: Cbeebies Christmas Show 2019: Hansel & Gretel
programme.desc: Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm tale, this exciting adventure follows brother and sister Hansel and Gretel as they journey deep into the magical woods to rescue their lost parents.

programme.title: The Honeymooners: The Christmas Special
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, Ralph Kramden's latest get-rich scheme risks his and Alice's life savings -- and trusting pal Ed Norton's holiday bonus -- on the lottery. The gamble also places Alice's mother's Social Security check in jeopardy.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: The story of a young couple who cross social barriers, marry and ultimately face the greatest crisis of all.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Italian director Franco Zeffirelli stunned the screen world when he cast two young unknowns to portray the star-crossed lovers in Romeo & Juliet, but it was a gamble that resulted in one of the most popular motion pictures of all time.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage garnered a Best Actor Oscar for his hauntingly disturbing portrayal of a suicidal alcoholic who falls for a compassionate Las Vegas prostitute (Elisabeth Shue) in one of the year's most critically acclaimed films.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: After providing inspiration to Will Shakespeare, his case of writer's block cured, and a taste for romance rekindled by the mysterious Lady Viola. Gwyneth Paltrow, Joseph Fiennes, Ben Affleck, and Dame Judi Dench star in this Best Picture winner.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Hollywood 1927. George Valentin is a very successful silent movie star, but the arrival of talking pictures could mark the end of his career.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: The French Lieutenant's Woman
programme.desc: Film actors Anna (Meryl Streep) and Mike (Jeremy Irons) portray movie characters who have a short but passionate affair in 19th century England. During the shooting of the film, the two actors have a relationship that parallels that of their characters.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Man in the Moon
programme.desc: The heartwarming coming-of-age film set in the 1950s stars Reese Witherspoon as a 14-year-old girl who gets her first difficult lesson in love.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet (2013)
programme.desc: Adapted by Julian Fellowes (Downtown Abbey) from the play by William Shakespeare.

programme.title: Untamed Heart
programme.desc: Two of today's hottest young actors, Christian Slater and Marisa Tomei, star in this tender romance about lonely souls destined to find one another. Co-starring Rosie Perez.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë’s superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: True story of the lifelong romance between novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Emily Brontë’s timeless tale of love and passion comes alive in this stirring film version starring Juliette Binoche and Ralph Fiennes.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Two people scarred by grief find happiness in each other. Robert Pattinson (the TWILIGHT films) and Emilie de Ravin star in this deeply romantic story with a stunning ending.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Griffin and Phoenix is a poignantly funny love story about two people who face a seemingly insurmountable obstacle that may stand between them and a last chance at love.

programme.title: Days of Heaven
programme.desc: A story of love and murder told through the jaded voice of a child and expressive images of nature. Bill, a fugitive from the slums of Chicago, finds himself pitted against a shy, rich Texan for the love of Abby.

programme.title: The Great Gatsby (1974)
programme.desc: Robert Redford stars as Jay Gatsby, who had once loved beautiful, spoiled Daisy Buchanan (Mia Farrow), then lost her to a rich boy. But now Gatsby is mysteriously wealthy...and ready to risk everything to woo Daisy back.

programme.title: Code 46
programme.desc: In the near future, an insurance investigator (Tim Robbins) assigned to track down and dismantle a passport forgery ring falls for the ringleader (Samantha Morton), leading to further complications when a secret (a Code 46 violation) is revealed.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, and Shannen Doherty star in this cruelly hilarious dark comedy, which became one of the biggest cult classics of the `80s.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Lovely And Amazing
programme.desc: Self-esteem and insecurity are at the heart of this comedy about the relationship between a mother and her three confused daughters.

programme.title: Mermaids
programme.desc: A sexy and unpredictable single mother of two is a source of constant embarrassment to her confused 15-year-old daughter, who's trying to deal with her own sexual awakening.

programme.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
programme.desc: Two girlfriends on a summer holiday in Spain became enamored with the same painter, fully unaware that his ex-wife, with whom he still has a tempestuous relationship, is about to re-enter the picture.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: I.Q.
programme.desc: All the world knows about Einstein the scientific genius. But what about Einstein the matchmaker? I.Q. puts this notion to the test and comes up with winning results in this “fun, warmhearted romantic comedy” that has critics and audiences cheering.

programme.title: At First Sight
programme.desc: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

programme.title: Carrington
programme.desc: The true story of the relationship between the English painter Dora Carrington (Emma Thompson) and writer Lytton Strachey (Jonathan Pryce). Between 1915 and 1932, they experimented with a way of life beyond conventional standards.

programme.title: Rob Roy
programme.desc: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange battle evil landowners among the breathtaking landscapes of the majestic Scottish Highlands in this riveting adventure of courage, love and uncompromising honor.

programme.title: Stanley & Iris
programme.desc: Jane Fonda and Robert De Niro star in a touching story of two people who escape their own private prisons -- he can't read, she's still grieving for her dead husband -- to explore a tender relationship.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1998)
programme.desc: Mistreated foundling Heathcliff and his stepsister Catherine fall in love, but when she marries a wealthy man, he becomes obsessed with getting revenge, even well into the next generation.

programme.title: Moonlight and Valentino
programme.desc: A woman in her 30s loses her husband but gains a closer kinship with a group of friends and family. Rebecca Trager Lott (Elizabeth Perkins) is a professor whose husband has died in a traffic accident. She finds it difficult to put her life back on track, and the personality quirks displayed by her companions (Whoopi Goldberg, Gwyneth Paltrow, Kathleen Turner) tend to complicate matters. But the distraction provided by a handsome house painter (Jon Bon Jovi) is just what the women need.

programme.title: Guinevere
programme.desc: Awkward young Harper Sloane was always the odd one out, until she draws the attention of a brilliant older photographer. He soon opens her world to possibilities she'd never imagined, and Harper comes out of her shell realizing her full potential.

programme.title: Playing By Heart
programme.desc: From a married couple about to renew their vows, to a career-focused woman pursued by a charming stranger, to a young couple who meet in the L.A. club scene, it's a sexy romantic comedy about modern couples coming together in funny, unexpected ways!

programme.title: She's So Lovely
programme.desc: John Travolta joins Sean Penn and Robin Wright in this funny, hip and emotionally supercharged movie about a woman whose passion for two totally opposite men sets up an outrageously explosive love triangle.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple-A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

programme.title: Caveman
programme.desc: Leader of a rag-tag group of cavemen, Atouk has his work cut out for him when he sets his sights on the voluptuous cavewoman Lana (Barbara Bach). Trouble is…Lana belongs to Tonda (John Matuszak) the leader of a clan of “superior” cavemen.

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

programme.title: Modern Girls
programme.desc: Three young ladies who are looking for love realize that their friendship is more important than romance.

programme.title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
