programme.desc: One of the most popular live stand-up comedians of recent years, Al Murray has starred in his own major TV series and his Pub Landlord show consistently packs out major west end venues. Guaranteed laughs, but definitely not for the faint-hearted.

programme.title: Al Murray Live - And a Glass of Wine for the Lady
programme.desc: Comedian Al Murray is back with a second installment of the 'Pub Landlord' live show, in which outrageous barroom banter and pub philosophy are the order of the day.

programme.title: Lewis Black - Black to the Future
programme.desc: Recorded live in NYC, a passionate performer who is a more pissed-off optimist than a mean-spirited curmudgeon.

programme.title: Al Murray Live - Barrel of Fun
programme.desc: The Guv tackles all the current topics; from global warming and a PC-world gone mad, to debt and the financial crisis - whilst dispensing his knowledge on the ultimate fail-safe chat-up lines and, ahem,... erectile dysfunction.

programme.title: Al Murray Live - The Only Way is Epic
programme.desc: Broken Britain may be staring into the bottom of an empty pint glass, but don't lose hope Al Murray The Pub Landlord is back to fill it up again, with a brand new stand-up show of epic proportions.

programme.title: Chonda Pierce Presents: Stand Up for Families - Family Is Forever and Ever, Amen
programme.desc: Join Christian comedian Chonda Pierce, the "Queen of Clean", as she hosts Part 2 of her hilarious stand up comedy special aimed at families; featuring some of her favorite comedians joining her onstage!

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Man In A Suit
programme.desc: Recorded during his 40-night sell-out run at the Leicester Square Theatre and part of his highly anticipated 2014 tour, Frank delivers this critically acclaimed and hilarious show in his usual witty and hugely entertaining style.

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Live From Birmingham's National Indoor Arena
programme.desc: Frank Skinner returned to live stand-up in 2007 with his fifth sell-out tour of the UK, a decade since he played his last major live gig.

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The London Palladium
programme.desc: The Perrier award-winning star of BBC Two's "Fantasy Football League" and BBC One's "The Frank Skinner Show" performs live and uncensored stand-up comedy to a sell-out audience at the London Palladium.

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Birmingham Hippodrome
programme.desc: Featuring all the original and exclusive material and was filmed at the Birmingham Hippodrome during a 100-date tour which earned an entry into the Guinness Book of Records for the World's Biggest Solo Comedy Performance at London's Battersea Power Station.

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Apollo
programme.desc: Frank Skinner performs previously unrecorded, uncensored, stand-up comedy material that could never be shown on TV. This performance was filmed at London's Apollo Theatre on September 4th, 1994.

programme.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Bloomsbury
programme.desc: Frank Skinner made his television debut in 1988. After five minutes of stand-up, the station received 131 calls from outraged viewers. Here he is, live and uncensored, performing the act that won him the 1991 Perrier Award for Comedy.

programme.title: The Aristocrats
programme.desc: One hundred superstar comedians tell the same very, VERY dirty, filthy joke--one shared privately by comics since Vaudeville.

programme.title: You Laugh But It's True
programme.desc: In the world of stand-up comedy in South Africa, Trevor Noah uses his experiences during Apartheid to prepare for the biggest show of his life.

programme.title: DeMarcus Cousins Boogies Comedy Slam
programme.desc: Demarcus Cousin's comedy slam hosted by Mike Epps.

programme.title: Al Madrigal: Shrimpin' Ain't Easy
programme.desc: Former 'Daily Show with Jon Stewart' correspondent Al Madrigal applies his comedic insight to relatable topics like cilantro politics, anger management, family, fatherhood, and an unbelievable tale of seafood revenge in this stand-up comedy special.

programme.title: Fired!
programme.desc: Annabelle Gurwitch's first-person take on getting the axe.

programme.title: Comic Relief: The Latest (2008)
programme.desc: This collection includes uncensored performances from COMIC RELIEF 2006, which helped raise funds for Hurricane Katrina victims and animal rescue operations. Join Billy, Whoopi, Robin and the rest of the greatest comedians on Earth.

programme.title: Cut'n It Up Chicago
programme.desc: A great night of stand-up featuring tv stars Rodney Perry (Dirty South), Alex Thomas (Abbott Elementary), Sonja D, Lil’ Rel Howery (Carmichael Show), Marcus Combs, Shang and Pierre

programme.title: Dana Gould: Let Me Put My Thoughts in You (2009)
programme.desc: Stand-Up comedian Dana Gould performs his one-hour comedy special at Chicago's famed Second City theatre.

programme.title: Mark Ellis: Dog Stepfather
programme.desc: Comedian Mark Ellis hits up Chicago, IL to film his full-length comedy special, Dog Stepfather. In his very first standup special, Mark covers a lot of pressing topics.

programme.title: Greg Davies - Firing Cheeseballs at a Dog
programme.desc: Greg Davies' hotly anticipated debut stand-up show was a critically lauded sell-out smash hit at the 2010 Edinburgh festival, picking up a prestigious nomination for the Fosters Comedy Award.

programme.title: George Burns In Concert
programme.desc: This 1982 concert shows the great George Burns at his absolute funniest, as he entertains a live audience.

programme.title: Paul Mooney: Analyzing White America (2006)
programme.desc: Paul Mooney is angry, fearless and very funny. Here he takes direct aim at racism and White America and hits his targets with dead-on accuracy and humor.

programme.title: Jeffrey Ross: No Offense (2008)
programme.desc: Respected and feared as a result of his show-stopping performances at the Comedy Central Roasts, the Roastmaster General, Jeffrey Ross returns to his home state for this 2008 special.

programme.title: Greg Davies - Back Of My Mum's Head
programme.desc: Stung by his mother's suggestion that he is 'not normal' Greg puts everyone under the microscope in a petty quest to discover if anyone actually is. To be clear, as an educational tool this show is worthless. It is funny though.

programme.title: Russell Howard - Wonderbox
programme.desc: The popular 'Mock the Week' panelist performs live in front of his home crowd in Bristol as part of his 2014 sell-out 'Wonderbox' tour. Russell performs his juvenile brand of social commentary and discusses the joy to be found in everyday experiences.

programme.title: Russell Howard - Right Here Right Now
programme.desc: Russell Howard is back in 2011 with his third sell-out tour Right Here, Right Now. The star of Russell Howard's Good News and Mock The Week never fails to entertain with his trademark mix of eloquent gags and deft storytelling.

programme.title: Russell Howard - Live at the Bloomsbury
programme.desc: Russell Howard recorded live at The Bloomsbury Theatre, London, performing his stand-up show "Adventures".

programme.title: Russell Howard - Dingledodies
programme.desc: Recorded at Brighton Dome as part of his twice extended sell-out Dingledodies tour (which played to over 125,000 people), the show sees the star of Mock the Week (BBC Two) and Russell Howard's Good News (BBC Three) share his observations on life

programme.title: It Started As A Joke
programme.desc: IT STARTED AS A JOKE is a feature documentary that chronicles the decade-long run of the Eugene Mirman Comedy Festival, and reminds us of the healing properties of comedy - even in the most challenging of life's circumstances.

programme.title: Mo'Nique: One Night Stand
programme.desc: Known for her sassy attitude and outrageous humor, Oscar winner Mo'Nique takes her side-splitting act to the stage in this hilarious stand-up comedy special.

programme.title: Here Comedy Presents Kate Clinton
programme.desc: No topic is too taboo to conquer in this stand-up performance from comedienne Kate Clinton, offering her riotous take on feminism, lesbianism, and life.

programme.title: Lee Mack - Going Out
programme.desc: Lee Mack, star of BBC comedy shows 'Not Going Out' and 'Would I Lie To You?', delivers his high-energy banter and sharp one-liners to venues across the country on his 'Going Out Live' tour.

programme.title: Lee Mack - Live at the Bloomsbury
programme.desc: Recorded live at the Bloomsbury Theatre, Lee's relentless determination to have fun is marvelously infectious and leaves his audience exhausted by laughter.

programme.title: Lee Mack - Hit the Road Mack
programme.desc: Lee Mack, star of BBC comedy shows 'Not Going Out' and 'Would I Lie To You?', delivers his high-energy banter and sharp one-liners to the audience of the London Hammersmith Apollo, filmed over seven nights of shows.

programme.title: Al Murray Live - One Man One Guvnor
programme.desc: The Pub Landlord is back to save the nation, in this, his latest stand-up extravaganza, because he knows what the country really needs right now is some bloke waving a pint around offering common-sense solutions.

programme.title: King Creole
programme.desc: Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

programme.title: Girls! Girls! Girls!
programme.desc: Elvis plays a charter-boat skipper who helps tourists land the big ones. Of course, plenty of beautiful girls want to land Elvis. But there’s something Elvis likes almost as much as romance–a boat!

programme.title: Roustabout
programme.desc: Elvis is a karate-chopping biker who’s hired as a carnival Roustabout. At first he just provides muscle and a diversion for the beautiful carny girls. Then he picks up a guitar and gets the midway rockin’.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

programme.title: Elvis: Part One
programme.desc: A chronicle of the life of Elvis Presley, from his humble beginnings to his rise to international stardom.

programme.title: Elvis: Part Two
programme.desc: A chronicle of the life of Elvis Presley, from his humble beginnings to his rise to international stardom.

programme.title: Elvis Presley: From The Beginning To The End
programme.desc: A warm, moving and sensitive tribute and a comprehensive and detailed biography of Elvis' life.

programme.title: Elvis Thru The Years
programme.desc: The life of Elvis Presley through rare film footage, press conferences, behind-the-scenes, and news clips. A truly unique look back at the King.

programme.title: Elvis Home Movies
programme.desc: This film features what is believed to be the oldest known home movie footage of Elvis Presley to date.

programme.title: Elvis Presley: The Last 24 Hours
programme.desc: The last 24 hours in the life of Elvis are counted down.

programme.title: Mean Girls (2024)
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school, when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: Camp
programme.desc: A comedy about a summer camp for young actors and performers

programme.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968)
programme.desc: A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

programme.title: Funny Face
programme.desc: Paris, the City of Light, shines even brighter when Audrey Hepburn and Fred Astaire team up for the only time and bring their luminous starpower to this exquisite musical featuring songs by George and Ira Gershwin.

programme.title: Oklahoma!
programme.desc: In Oklahoma, several farmers, cowboys and a traveling salesman compete for the romantic favors of various local ladies.

programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying (1967)
programme.desc: This hilarious musical stars Robert Morse as a charming and scheming window washer who climbs to the top of the corporate ladder by way of a self-help book.

programme.title: Fear of a Black Hat
programme.desc: A mockumentary chronicling the rise and fall of NWH, a not particularly talented--or particularly bright but always controversial--hip-hop group.

programme.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
programme.desc: Zero Mostel, Buster Keaton, Phil Silvers, and an all-star cast scam their way through this boisterous romp amidst gorgeous girls, mistaken identities, stunning surprises, cunning disguises, and great Sondheim songs.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: Urban ghetto kids from the South Bronx find creative outlets in painting graffiti, breakdancing, rapping, and developing new disco D.J. routines.

programme.title: Steppin
programme.desc: College students prepare to enter a step-dance competition that features a big money prize. Sororities and fraternities battle to recruit the best talent to help them win.

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: An uplifting comedy about an unlikely group of people who find friendship and hope when they step out to participate in a weekly dance class run by a former Broadway dancer/singer.

programme.title: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Reefer Madness
programme.desc: This freaky musical is a parody of an actual, dead serious anti-marihuana propaganda film from 1936, trying to convince the American public that just one drag of pot forever and irrevocably turns average high school kids into hopeless drug addicts.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: A sparkling fantasy of music, magic and romance, Rodgers & Hammerstein’s Cinderella captivates from overture to finale with a delightful score and stunning flittering performances from an all-star cast. Cinderella will waltz into the hearts of families.

programme.title: Drama Drama
programme.desc: The most unlikely pairing of teen-age girls end up bonding to form the pop group Drama Drama, and make a stand against bullying in their high school.

programme.title: Valley Girl (2020)
programme.desc: In this musical adaptation of the hit 1983 film that changed American teenage life forever, Julie (Jessica Rothe) is the ultimate ‘80s Valley Girl, whose world is rocked when she falls hard for Randy (Josh Whitehouse), a punk rocker from Hollywood!

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.

programme.title: The Commitments
programme.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte, an unemployed Dublin boy, decides to put together a soul band made up entirely of the Irish working class.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: The beat doesn't slow down in this slammin' sequel to "Breakin'.'" This fly follow-up finds our poppin' and lockin' trio Kelly, Ozone and Turbo trying to rescue a community center facing demolition at the hands of a greedy real-estate developer.

programme.title: Starstruck
programme.desc: A Sydney teen tries to make it as a rock singer, with help from her odd 14-year-old cousin.

programme.title: Passing Strange
programme.desc: Director Spike Lee's passionate adaptation of the thrilling Broadway musical about a young bohemian who experiences sex, drugs, and rock and roll on his journey to selfhood.

programme.title: The Fantasticks
programme.desc: A charm-drenched period-piece musical based on the Broadway smash, "The Fantasticks" tells the story of a pair of potential young lovers (Jean Louisa Kelly, Joey McIntyre) whose romance is assisted/derailed by the machinations of their fathers.

programme.title: Cannibal! The Musical
programme.desc: The sole survivor of an ill-fated mining expedition tells how his taste for gold was replaced by that of human flesh.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: The fishermen of Cornwall are signed to Universal Records and achieve a top ten hit with their debut album of Sea Shanties.

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: To save his family's shoe business from imminent bankruptcy, young Charlie Price turns to an unlikely new creative consultant: a fabulous drag queen whose creative style and wild designs are a breath of fresh air in the stuffy old factory.

programme.title: Hearts Beat Loud
programme.desc: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

programme.title: Damn Yankees
programme.desc: A frustrated fan of the hopeless Washington Senators makes a pact with the Devil to help the baseball team win the pennant. Gwen Verdon is a total delight as Lola, the temptress used by the devil (Ray Walston) to lure Joe Hardy (Tab Hunter).

programme.title: Kid Millions
programme.desc: A musical comedy about a Brooklyn boy (Eddie Cantor) who inherits a fortune from his archaeologist father, but must go to Egypt to claim it.

programme.title: 24 Hour Party People
programme.desc: Graphically depicting the music and dance heritage of Manchester from the late 70s to the early 90s, the movie documents the vibrancy that made Manchester the place in the world that you would most like to be.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Muscle Beach Party
programme.desc: Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello and the gang are back together in the 2nd of American International's Beach Party films and this time the beach is overrun by muscle men and their obnoxious trainer.

programme.title: A Chorus Line
programme.desc: After narrowing down hundreds of Broadway hopefuls, choreographer Zach (Michael Douglas) leads a select group of dancers on an audition that could change their lives forever in this stunning adaptation of the hit Broadway musical.

programme.title: Wild Style
programme.desc: Universally hailed as the first hip-hop movie, WILD STYLE captures New York's 1981 hip-hop culture and several prominent figures including Busy Bee Starski, Fab Five Freddy, The Cold Crush Brothers, and one of the godfathers of hip-hop, Grandmaster Flash.

programme.title: Flower Drum Song
programme.desc: A young woman arrives in San Francisco's Chinatown from Hong Kong with the intention of marrying a rakish nightclub owner, unaware he is involved with one of his singers.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

programme.title: Romance & Cigarettes
programme.desc: Musical set in Bensonhurst, N.Y. In it, a two-timing husband must choose between his mistress and his beleaguered wife.

programme.title: To The Beat!
programme.desc: While twins Mia and Mackie form separate tap and jazz dance teams to compete against each other in a contest, their neighbor and nemesis, Avery, uses her charm and resources to get the upper hand in the competition.

programme.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
programme.desc: An epidemic of organ failures devastates the planet, and those who cannot afford their treatments are hunted by Repo Men in this unique production that modernizes the rock opera genre.

programme.title: 200 Motels
programme.desc: The great Frank Zappa's outrageous psychedelic precursor to today's music videos features The Mothers of Invention wreaking havoc in a typical American town. Ringo Starr narrates.

programme.title: Sarafina!
programme.desc: A story of the courage and spirit of the children of South Africa's townships in their resistance to apartheid.

programme.title: At War With The Army with Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis
programme.desc: When former business & nightclub partners Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis enlist in the U.S. Army, (in their first starring film ) they have different ambitions. Martin wants to see action rather than the drudgery of his current post.

programme.title: Carnegie Hall
programme.desc: A mother wants her son to grow up to be a pianist and to play at Carnegie Hall.

programme.title: Beyond The Lights
programme.desc: The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

programme.title: Road to Bali
programme.desc: Hope and Crosby play a pair of Vaudeville performers in competition for Dorothy Lamour, pursuing her to the South Seas island of Bali, where they must content with all sorts of jungle dangers

programme.title: Hans Christian Andersen
programme.desc: The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tales."

programme.title: Lucky Stiff
programme.desc: Based on the hit Off-Broadway musical. A young, down-and-out British shoe salesman (Dominic Marsh) learns that he’s inherited $6 million from an American uncle. However, in order to get the money, he must take his uncle‘s corpse on a wild, parties-and-g...

programme.title: Saturday Church
programme.desc: A 14 year-old-boy, struggling with gender identity and religion, begins to use fantasy to escape his life in the inner city and find his passion in the process.

programme.title: Little Voice
programme.desc: In an inspirational story about a painfully shy young woman and how the power of music leads her to an amazing transformation!

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Light bio-pic of American Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern, featuring renditions of the famous songs from his musical plays by contemporary stage artists, including a condensed production of his most famous: 'Showboat'.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: Mary Martin takes on the role of Peter Pan, the boy who refuses to grow up, in this made-for-TV family special. Together with sidekick Tinker Bell, Peter Pan visits the bedroom of Wendy, Michael, and John Darling.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Gambling hall owner relocates from New Orleans to Chicago and entertains his patrons with hot jazz by Louis Armstrong, Billie Holiday, Woody Herman, and others.

programme.title: God Help the Girl
programme.desc: A feel-good comedy musical romance written and directed by Stuart Murdoch of Belle and Sebastian which tells the story of Eve (Emily Browning) who is low on self-esteem but high on fantasy, especially when it comes to music.

programme.title: Oklahoma! (1999)
programme.desc: Cowboy Curly McClain tries to win the heart of a girl in a singing and dancing extravaganza.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, a couple turns all their fights into songs and starts a band with their neighbor.

programme.title: Top Secret!
programme.desc: Top Secret! Pits American rock star Nick Rivers against the dreaded East German High Command. It's a race against time as Nick teams up with Hillary Flammond to find her father.

programme.title: The Slipper And The Rose: The Story of Cinderella (1976)
programme.desc: Prince Edward wants to marry for love, but the King and court of the kingdom of Euphrania are anxious for the prince to wed no matter what.

programme.title: Hendrix (2000)
programme.desc: On stage, Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) electrified audiences with his powerful guitar playing and mesmerizing performances. But behind the scenes -- fueled by a dark haze of drugs and alcohol -- this rising star was on a crash course with destiny.

programme.title: My Name Is Myeisha
programme.desc: A hip-hop musical fantasia, My Name Is Myeisha chronicles the life of a young black woman in California's Inland Empire. My Name Is Myeisha is a profoundly moving story of self-discovery and the moments that make us who we are.

programme.title: The Bells Of St Mary's
programme.desc: At a big city Catholic school, Father O'Malley and Sister Benedict indulge in friendly rivalry, and succeed in extending the school through the gift of a building.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends: One And All
programme.desc: Following the success of their first album, the Fisherman's Friends struggle to adjust to their new-found fame and work towards a second album.

programme.title: The Stork Club
programme.desc: A hat-check girl saves the life of a drowning man. The man decides to repay her by anonymously giving her a bank account, a luxury apartment and an account at a department store. When her boyfriend returns from overseas, he thinks she is a kept woman.

programme.title: The Duke Is Tops
programme.desc: A theatrical producer sacrifices his own career to boost the fortunes of a gifted young performer in this musical gem from 1938. Lena Horne makes her feature film debut as Ethel Andrews, the aspiring singer, and belts out such tunes as ‘I Know You Remember’ and ‘Don’t Let Our Love Song Turn Into A Blues’. Also, look for such Depression-era entertainers as Ralph Cooper and the Harlemania Orchestra, the Basin Street Boys, and “Rubberneck” Holmes!

programme.title: Something to Sing About (1937)
programme.desc: Something to Sing About is the high-spirited account of Terry Rooney (James Cagney), a popular band leader with an offer to work in Hollywood. But nothing is ever easy in show business; Rooney learns that being famous is just as troublesome as being unknown. This colorful, comical film was directed by Victor Schertzinger (The Road to Zanzibar) who also wrote the movie's many songs. The movie also features a superb supporting cast which includes William Frawley (I Love Lucy) and Dwight Fry (Dracula).

programme.title: This is the Army (1943)
programme.desc: In WWI, dancer Jerry Jones stages an all-soldier show on Broadway, called Yip Yip Yaphank. Wounded in the war, he becomes a producer.

programme.title: LOVE'S LABOUR'S LOST
programme.desc: The King of Navarre and his best friends have sworn off love in the pursuit of intellectual enlightenment. But when the Princess of France and her beautiful attendants arrive for a diplomatic visit, their high-minded plans turn completely upside down

programme.title: Royal Wedding (1951)
programme.desc: Brother and sister dance team Tom and Ellen Bowen (Fred Astaire and Jane Powell) are on their way to England when Ellen strikes up a shipboard romance with Lord John Brindale (Peter Lawford). Meanwhile, confirmed bachelor Tom grows smitten with dancer Anne Ashmond (Sarah Churchill). Will romance break up the act? This also happens to be the movie where Astaire dances on the ceiling, an act accomplished by building a set inside a revolving barrel, or “squirrel cage”, and mounting the cameraman to an ironing board which could be rotated along with the room.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time they’re trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who don’t like competition.

programme.title: Glorifying the American Girl
programme.desc: Mary Eaton stars in this feature about the rise of a showgirl. This early talkie includes cameos by many top names of the day. Listen for period hits like 'Bye Bye Blackbird' and 'Baby Face.' This movie is like a time machine and will take you back!

programme.title: Swing (1999)
programme.desc: When Martin gets out of prison, the guards warn him to get a job or end up back in jail. Martin decides to start his own band. The band is a smashing success until the police find out that it was backed with stolen money.

programme.title: Jacques Brel is Alive and Well and Living in Paris
programme.desc: Eschewing conventional narrative, Mort Shuman and Eric Blau's beloved 35-song stage revue is transformed into an infectious movie musical.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical trip down memory lane.

programme.title: Rise Up
programme.desc: Jamaica – the island that gave birth to the worldwide phenomenon of Reggae. In a society of plentiful talent but scarce opportunity, three distinct and courageous artists fight to rise up from obscurity and write themselves into the pages of history.

programme.title: Aria
programme.desc: 10 of the world's greatest directors were commissioned to create short pieces based on the world's greatest opera music. Erotic, demented, funny, poignant, extravagant, and outrageous, the result is breathtaking and totally unique.

programme.title: They Got Me Covered
programme.desc: Fired by his editor for incompetence, idiotic reporter Robert Kittredge sees a chance at redeeming himself when he accidentally uncovers a network of Nazi spies in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: City Of Rock
programme.desc: In this zany musical comedy from acclaimed director Da Peng, a small-town musician plans a benefit concert to save his town’s beloved Rock Park from redevelopment by a corporate real estate agent.

programme.title: Stage Door Canteen
programme.desc: A young soldier on a pass in New York City finds entertainment and romance when he visits the famed Stage Door Canteen, where famous stars appear and host servicemen during the war. The sensational cast includes Katherine Hepburn, Helen Hayes, Gracie Fields, Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy, Harpo Marx, Gypsy Rose Lee, Ethel Merman, and the always outrageous Tallulah Bankhead. The rollicking comedy directed by two-time Oscar winner Frank Borzage also features great music from some of the top band leaders of the day, including Benny Goodman, Count Basie, and Xavier Cougat!

programme.title: Poser
programme.desc: Local indie music podcaster Lennon Gates finds herself spiraling down a path of dark obsession when she befriends the striking performer Bobbi Kitten who coaxes her to find her voice. Lennon does..and creates an identity not wholly her own.

programme.title: Shirley Temple Babes in Toyland
programme.desc: Babes in Toyland recounts a young boy and girl's series of adventures after running away from their wicked uncle Barnaby. They find themselves in a magical toyland. Restored and in Color!

programme.title: ZZ Top: Live at Montreux 2013
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances.

programme.title: Jimi Plays Monterey

programme.title: Blades of Glory

programme.title: I Love You, Man

programme.title: Without A Paddle

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2

programme.title: Heartlands

programme.title: Fanboys

programme.title: It Runs In The Family

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: Cook Off
programme.desc: Amateur chefs from around the country compete for a million-dollar prize in the ultimate food fight.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

programme.title: Good Fences

programme.title: Imagine That (2009)
programme.desc: What if your daughter's imagination was the secret to your success? When a businessman finds his financial kingdom slipping, he turns to his daughter and her fantasy world for help.

programme.title: Mean Girls 2

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Witless Protection
programme.desc: When a small-town sheriff (Larry the Cable Guy) witnesses what he believes to be an attempted kidnapping, his effort to save the beautiful damsel in distress sets him down a wild path of comic mishap.

programme.title: Last Vegas
programme.desc: Four lifelong best friends head to Las Vegas with a plan to stop acting their age and relive their glory days. Upon arriving, they quickly realize that the decades have transformed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they never imagined.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Joel (Paul Rudd) and Molly (Amy Poehler) fall in and out of love in this hilarious spoof on a romantic comedy from the director of WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER and ROLE MODELS.

programme.title: Hesher
programme.desc: A young boy has lost his mother and is losing touch with his father.

programme.title: Young Adult
programme.desc: Oscar®-winner Charlize Theron stars as Mavis Gary, former prom queen turned young adult novelist, who returns home to win back her high school sweetheart.

programme.title: The Weather Man
programme.desc: Popular Chicago weatherman Dave Spritz (Nicolas Cage) has a shot at the big time when a national morning television show calls him for an audition.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

programme.title: Love Wrecked
programme.desc: A teenager saves the life of her favorite rockstar and takes him to a nearby island and tells him that they are castaways.

programme.title: Coffee And Cigarettes
programme.desc: A series of vignettes that all have coffee and cigarettes in common.

programme.title: Drillbit Taylor
programme.desc: Two bullied high school students place an ad for a bodyguard in a magazine and receive a response from a homeless veteran.

programme.title: Undertaking Betty
programme.desc: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Disaster Movie

programme.title: School for Scoundrels (2006)
programme.desc: A young guy short on luck enrolls in a class to build confidence to help win over the girl of his dreams, which becomes complicated when his teacher has the same agenda.

programme.title: Happy Go Lucky
programme.desc: A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.

programme.title: Mister Lonely
programme.desc: M. Jackson impersonator moves to a commune of impersonators.

programme.title: Bart Got a Room
programme.desc: While Danny's father and mother independently search for love, Danny is on his own desperate quest to find a prom date.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: From visionary director Tim Burton (EDWARD SCISSORHANDS) comes the outrageous true story of one of the most extensive art frauds in the 20th century. Starring Christoph Waltz and Amy Adams.

programme.title: Duplex
programme.desc: Young and vibrant New Yorkers Alex and Nancy have just found the perfect place to settle down and share a bright future: the bottom half of a beautiful old duplex. But their new home comes with a permanent fixture they didn't expect.

programme.title: The Cobbler
programme.desc: Max Simkin has had enough of working in his little New York shoe repair shop where he quietly envies people with more interesting lives.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: When a woman drives a car into the river to her death, everyone in town becomes a suspect.

programme.title: Son of Rambow

Will Proudfoot (Bill Milner) is looking for an escape from his family’s stifling home life when he encounters Lee Carter (Will Poulter), the school bully. Armed with a video camera and a copy of Rambo: First Blood, Lee plans to make cinematic history by filming his own action-packed video epic. Together, these two newfound friends-turned-budding-filmmakers quickly discover that their imaginative – and sometimes mishap-filled – cinematic adventure has begun to take on a life of its own! Entertaining, uplifting, and brimming with nostalgia, Son of Rambow “makes you feel like a kid again” (Ethan Alter, Giant Magazine).

programme.title: W.
programme.desc: Controversial filmmaker Oliver Stone takes on the life and presidency of George W. Bush, capturing the alleged notorious moments in his life.

programme.title: The Trip to Spain
programme.desc: Comedians Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon continue their hit series with a hilarious culinary road trip through Spain, featuring breathtaking locales and to-die-for cuisine.

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: From the hilarious adventure by Oscar Wilde comes this tale of two dashing young bachelors and the outrageous deceptions they find themselves in over love, starring Reese Witherspoon, Colin Firth, and Rupert Everett.

programme.title: The Trip to Italy
programme.desc: Comedians Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon reunite for a tour of Italy's finest food, hotels and women in this hilarious sequel to their 2009 hit.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail

programme.title: Monty Python Live at the Hollywood Bowl

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.

programme.title: Absolutely Anything
programme.desc: In this hilarious sci-fi comedy, space aliens (voiced by the Monty Python team) bestow extraordinary powers upon an ordinary man (Simon Pegg) to determine the fate of our planet!

programme.title: She Is Love

programme.title: Cuban Fury

programme.title: Death at a Funeral
programme.desc: When Daniel's father dies, it is up to him to arrange the funeral. On this painful morning, Daniel prepares to welcome his father's friends and relatives. But preserving the dignity inherent in such circumstances will be a hard task.

programme.title: The Knack...And How To Get It
programme.desc: Sophisticated Tolen has a monopoly on womanizing while the awkward Colin desperately wants a piece of it. When Colin falls for an innocent girl, it's not long before Tolen moves in for the kill. Can Colin get The Knack and beat Tolen at his own game?

programme.title: Philomena
programme.desc: Academy Award®-Winner Judi Dench stars as Philomena, a woman who alongside a grumpy reporter (Steve Coogan) journeys to America to find the child she put up for adoption so many years ago.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: GONE GIRL's Rosamund Pike stars with David Tennant and Billy Connolly in this heart-warming story about one family's hilarious journey through an unforgettable vacation.

programme.title: Boogie Woogie
programme.desc: Heather Graham and Gillian Anderson star in this sexy comedy about the lying, cheating, and backstabbing behind the glamorous facade of the art world.

programme.title: The Hippopotamus
programme.desc: Based on the Best-Selling Comedy Novel by Stephen Fry.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: After ten years absence Toni, Chris's best friend, suddenly reappears in London to bring chaos and doubt into Chris's calm, tranquil, slightly boring, predictable life.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and Di
programme.desc: When Bridget Jones-type Janet wins the trip of a lifetime, she's convinced by her best friend to pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is, in the hope of finding love.

programme.title: The Nan Movie

programme.title: Superbob

programme.title: 8 Minutes Idle

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Schemers

programme.title: La Cha Cha

programme.title: Jabberwocky
programme.desc: A young peasant, with no interest in adventure or fortune, is mistaken as the kingdom's only hope when a horrible monster threatens the countryside.

programme.title: Room At The Top (1959)

programme.title: Not the Messiah: He's a Very Naughty Boy
programme.desc: A comic oratorio inspired by Monty Python's Life of Brian (1979) filmed at its only European performance at the Royal Albert Hall in October 2009 to celebrate forty years of Monty Python.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream (1996)
programme.desc: The adventures of four young lovers, a group of amateur actors and their interactions with fairies come to light in a moonlit forest.

programme.title: Three Day Millionaire
programme.desc: A rollicking black comedy straight from the rain-soaked British fish docks of Grimsby, which follows a thrill-seeking young fisherman and his pals looking to party hard for three days straight before all goes wrong.

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: In a staid English seaside town after the Second World War, young Lynda grows up with her widowed father and younger sister. She eventually becomes pregnant by an acquaintance of her father.

programme.title: Reuniting the Rubins
programme.desc: Lenny Rubins, (Timothy Spall - The King's Speech) an up-tight lawyer, has to put his dream retirement on hold when his ailing mother (Honor Blackman - Goldfinger) emotionally blackmails him into reuniting his estranged children for a Jewish holiday.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: A selfish man plans to sell his family's priceless wine collection in order to finance a mining investment.

programme.title: Popcorn
programme.desc: Too insecure to approach the girl of his dreams, Danny takes a job at the local multiplex where she works.

programme.title: The Rachel Papers
programme.desc: This charming, witty teen comedy follows a young genius (Dexter Fletcher) as he allows his raging hormones, high intellect -- and desktop computer -- to ensnare him in the most unsolvable of all equations: love! Ione Skye and James Spader also star.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: At a home for retired opera singers, the annual concert to celebrate Verdi is disrupted by the arrival of Jean (Maggie Smith), an eternal diva and the former wife of one of the residents.

programme.title: Submarine
programme.desc: 15-year-old Oliver Tate (Craig Roberts) has two objectives: lose his virginity before his next birthday, and smother the flame between his mother and an ex-lover.

programme.title: Saving Grace
programme.desc: A small-town English widow, facing financial troubles after her husband's suicide, turns to agriculture of an illegal kind.

programme.title: Me and Mrs. Jones
programme.desc: A top tabloid journalist poses as a political fundraiser to get dirt on the PM, but things take a turn when the two begin to fall for one another.

programme.title: The Art of Love
programme.desc: Two lonely souls, aging sex toy influencer Adam and middle-aged train worker Eva, are thrown together on a secret project to banish loneliness forever.

programme.title: Bernard and the Genie

programme.title: Two Men Went To War

programme.title: Gold

programme.title: The Problem with People
programme.desc: When dying wishes reunite distant cousins Barry (NYC) and Ciáran (Ireland), they face decades of family grudges—with laughs, sheep, scenic landscapes, and hopeful steps toward peace.

programme.title: The Acid House
programme.desc: Three twisted tales of abuse, drugs, displaced personalities, and insect life by Scottish writer Irvine Welsh.

programme.title: The Million Pound Note
programme.desc: As part of a bet, two aristocrats offer a penniless American a loan, without telling him that the amount is 1,000,000 in the form of a single banknote.

programme.title: Restless
programme.desc: Nicky, a solitary care worker, is forced into paranoia when loud, party‑obsessed neighbors invade her peace. As sleepless nights wear on, her descent into obsession becomes a pulse‑pounding showdown of sanity vs. noise.

programme.title: A Bit of Tom Jones?
programme.desc: Henry teams up with his slightly dodgy best friend Teddy, and together the two head off on an insane journey.

programme.title: Joe and Casper Hit the Road
programme.desc: Caspar Lee and Joe Sugg decided to go outside... 7 days, 1000 miles, 1 brain cell.

programme.title: The New Statesman: Who Shot Alan B'Stard
programme.desc: Following an attempt on his life, B'Stard (Rik Mayall) returns and helps reinstate capital punishment. Tables turn, however, when he is pinned for a murder he didn't commit.

programme.title: Mallrats
programme.desc: Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)

Desperate for her affections, Klump invents a DNA-altering drug that temporarily transforms him into the slender, testosterone-overloaded jerk, Buddy Love. It's not long before both egos begin to compete for dominance and Carla's attention in this comedy starring Dave Chapelle and Oscar nominee James Coburn. Murphy brilliantly plays the entire "big-boned" Klump clan, thanks to Rick Baker's Oscar-winning special effects makeup.

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Outspoken Amanda and quietly refined Alyssa swap identities in a plan to bring Roger (Alyssa's father) and Diana (Amanda's social worker) closer together.

programme.title: Wayne's World

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne (Mike Myers) now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Bio-Dome
programme.desc: In this outrageous Comedy, five brave scientists are forced to face life forms more perplexing, more terrifying, more annoying than anything they've ever encountered: Pauly Shore and Stephen Baldwin.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
programme.desc: A small town prepares for the homecoming of superstar Roxy Carmichael, as does a young outsider, who believes Roxy is her mother.

programme.title: Milk Money

programme.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert

programme.title: S.F.W.

programme.title: Larger Than Life
programme.desc: Bill Murray and Janeane Garofalo star in this heartwarming, madcap comedy about a son whose life changes forever when he inherits a live circus elephant. Jeremy Piven, Matthew McConaughey, Linda Fiorentino and Pat Hingle co-star.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury

programme.title: Deconstructing Harry
programme.desc: Suffering from writer's block and eagerly awaiting his writing award, Harry Block remembers events from his past and scenes from his best-selling books as characters, real and fictional, come back to haunt him.

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: Neil Simon's The Odd Couple II
programme.desc: The times may have changed, but thankfully not the traits that make ex-roomies Felix Ungar (Lemmon) and Oscar Madison (Matthau) the all-time perfect mismatch.

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: A mischievous and obnoxious 10-year-old boy makes life pure hell for his bachelor uncle while his parents are in Hawaii.

programme.title: Outside Providence
programme.desc: After crashing into a police car, Timothy Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is packed off to prep school - where he's out of place, outclassed and seriously outnumbered. Alec Baldwin co-stars.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Macaulay Culkin is a clever kid out to reform his small-time crook father (Ted Danson) in this exuberantly zany and heartwarming comedy for the whole family.

programme.title: Necessary Roughness
programme.desc: The Texas State Armadillos are fourth down and nowhere-to-go after a corruption scandal nearly ends the football program. Now upstanding coach Ed Gennero (Hector Elizondo) must put together a brand-new team.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: The Real Blonde
programme.desc: Joe and Mary have been living together in Manhattan for six years. Joe is an actor, who has no agent and no thesping credits, but whose ambitions are very high.

programme.title: Glory Daze
programme.desc: With college graduation pending, the old gang tries to avoid the inevitability of breaking up and going forward with their lives.

programme.title: Kids In The Hall: Brain Candy
programme.desc: A pharmaceutical scientist creates a pill that makes people remember their happiest memory, and although it's successful, it has unfortunate side effects.

programme.title: Almost an Angel

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie

programme.title: Mighty Aphrodite
programme.desc: When he discovers his adopted son is a genius, a New York sportswriter seeks out the boy's birth mother: a ditzy porn star and prostitute.

programme.title: Trees Lounge
programme.desc: A man drifting through time desperately searches for some meaning to his life.

programme.title: Unhook the Stars

programme.title: Article 99

programme.title: The Super

programme.title: Flirting with Disaster
programme.desc: From the director of AMERICAN HUSTLE and SILVER LININGS PLAYBOOK comes this clever comedy with an all-star cast that examines dysfunctions of modern family life.

programme.title: Stuart Saves His Family

programme.title: The Favor
