programme.title: Madhouse (1990)
programme.desc: Meet Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) Bannister. Once they had it all. A happy marriage. Glamorous jobs. A house to call their own. It was the perfect life. Until a problem came along that was impossible to live with: houseguests!

programme.title: Dear God
programme.desc: Special delivery for comedy fans! Greg Kinnear ( Auto Focus) stars in and Garry Marshall ( Pretty Woman) directs this spirit-lifter about a money-scamming con artist who goes from no-good to doing good.

programme.title: Happy, Texas
programme.desc: Two escaped convicts are mistaken as consultants to a local beauty pageant in the town of Happy, Texas, and masquerade as the couple orchestrating the pageant. The two quickly meet with outrageously unpredictable consequences!

programme.title: Alone in the Woods
programme.desc: Two dopey kidnappers get more than they bargained for when a super-smart ten-year-old gets separated from his parents, uncovers their plot, and swings into action!

programme.title: Breakfast Of Champions
programme.desc: A rich car dealer is losing his mind. His son lives in the bomb shelter. His suicidal wife has an affair with his transvestite sales manager.

programme.title: Shadows and Fog
programme.desc: A timid clerk is drafted by a vigilant comittee to help capture a Jack the Ripper-style murderer who's been terrorizing the city at night.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Favorite Deadly Sins
programme.desc: Three vignettes: Anger spotlights a foul man; Greed, a sleazy producer; and Lust, a wayward husband.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: My X-Girlfriend's Wedding Reception
programme.desc: The bride's ex-boyfriend is a part of a band of musical misfits at an Italian-Jewish wedding.

programme.title: Funny About Love
programme.desc: NYC cartoonist Duffy meets the bad cappuccino maker, chef Meg, and falls in love. She moves in with him, marries him - but they have problems having a baby.

programme.title: All Tied Up
programme.desc: Ladies' man Brian has found true love with Linda, but before popping the big question, he can't resist one last fling. When Linda finds out, she and her roommate formulate a plan for revenge.

programme.title: Beach Babes from Beyond
programme.desc: An intergalactic babe borrows her dad's T-bird ship to do a little planet hopping with her two friends, but they run out of fuel unexpectedly and must land on Earth. They land on the California coast and run into some guys.

programme.title: Used People
programme.desc: At her husband's funeral, Pearl (Shirley MacLaine), Jewish mother of two divorced and antagonistic daughters, meets an old Italian friend (Marcello Mastroianni) of her husband, whose advice years previously had stopped the husband leaving home.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit
programme.desc: What would you do to share a sun-splashed week in the Caribbean with someone special? Battle a pirate?...A hurricane?...A hijacking goon squad? Prep-schooler Dan Bartlett does all that and more when he takes off in Hot Pursuit of his girlfriend.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: Spaceballs
programme.desc: Space hero Lone Starr (Bill Pullman) and his half-canine buddy Barf (John Candy) are on a mission in their flying Winnebago to save Princess Vespa (Daphne Zuniga) from the clutches of Dark Helmet (Rick Moranis) in Mel Brooks' inspired sci-fi spoof!

programme.title: Easy Money
programme.desc: In order to collect a $10-million inheritance, a working-class slob has one year to give up all of his bad habits...drinking, overeating, smoking and gambling.

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: Con man Kevin Lennihan, framed in a jewel smuggling, tries for an insanity plea, and is sent to a hospital for review, where he is confused for a doctor and takes over the hospital when a major storm hits.

programme.title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
programme.desc: Buckaroo Banzai is a rock-star/brain-surgeon/comic-book-hero/samurai who along with his group, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, must stop evil creatures from the 8th dimension (all named John) who are trying to conquer our dimension.

programme.title: Erik the Viking
programme.desc: A Monty Pythonesque farce about a Viking who grows dissatisfied with his barbaric way of life, and decides to set out to find the mythical Asgard--where the Norse gods dwell.

programme.title: Back to School
programme.desc: Rodney Dangerfield plays self-made millionaire Thornton Mellon, owner of a chain of tall and fat clothing stores, who, after divorcing his philandering wife, enrolls in college to keep his son from dropping out.

programme.title: The Couch Trip
programme.desc: When asylum inmate John Burns (Dan Ackroyd) intercepts a call and impersonates his doctor, he agrees to be the host of a radio advice show and is soon spreading his offbeat psychobabble to ultra-trendy Angelenos in this outrageous comedy!

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: The manager of a small-time UHF station which has the lowest ratings in the country inadvertently hits it big with his strange programming ideas to keep Channel 62 from going down the tubes.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: The Heavenly Kid
programme.desc: Thou Shalt Be Cool with this totally awesome 80s classic when a helpless nerd (Jason Gedrick) gets divine intervention from a hip guardian angel (Lewis Smith) straight from the 1960s! Jane Kaczmarek, Nancy Valen and Richard Mulligan also star.

programme.title: Crimewave
programme.desc: In a nod to film noir, a businessman hires two inept hitmen to kill his partner. But the businessman's dim-witted wife witnesses the crime and becomes their next target... along with the nerd framed for the murder. Sam Raimi directs this zany comedy.

programme.title: La Cage Aux Folles II
programme.desc: Michel Serrault and Ugo Tognazzi return in this zany espionage caper that has the two targeted by murderous enemy agents in an unforgettable cross-country journey.

programme.title: The Ratings Game
programme.desc: A New Jersey trucker creates a hit TV show with help from his girlfriend in the ratings business.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: A Midsummer Nights Sex Comedy (1982)
programme.desc: The story revolves around a weekend party at the home of Andrew Hobbs, a Wall Street broker and eccentric inventor, and his wife Adrian. The guests of honor are Ariel and Leopold, Andrew's cousin and a famed academic.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: J.C. has inherited a baby girl. An adoption falls through and the child becomes very attached to J.C., who keeps the baby. The child's mischief leads to J.C. losing her job and her boyfriend, but lead her to invent an applesauce recipe for children.

programme.title: Zelig
programme.desc: Leonard Zelig's neurotic insecurity forces him to mimic whomever he's with. Treated by Dr. Eudora Fletcher, Zelig is cured. But when misdeeds from his past resurface, Zelig is on the run, and Eudora must search the world over to find and save him.

programme.title: Mr. Mom
programme.desc: Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high-paying position at an advertising agency.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: A wealthy woman hires a carpenter to work on her yacht. When the carpenter is left unpaid, Joanna, sets sail. The following day, Joanna's fished out of the sea after falling overboard and diagnosed with amnesia.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: Going Overboard
programme.desc: A struggling young comedian takes a menial job on a cruise ship where he hopes for his big chance to make it in the world of cruise ship comedy.

programme.title: High School U.S.A.
programme.desc: Senior J.J. Manners navigates the cliques and rivalries that high school entails, all while pursuing Beth Franklin, who happens to be the girlfriend of the quarterback and class president.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Rustlers' Rhapsody
programme.desc: The Wild West goes wacko when the Greatest Fast-Drawin', Silver-Spurred, Geetar Playin', Singing Cowboy movie matinee idol Rex O'Herlihan hits the saddle in Rustlers' Rhapsody, a cockeyed, affectionate send-up of the '40s B-movie Western.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney (George Segal) is a straight-laced and successful executive whose world is turned upside-down when he discovers the seventeen-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington, in his feature film debut).

programme.title: Beyond Therapy
programme.desc: From acclaimed director Robert Altman comes this unconventional comedy about what happens when unconventional characters cross paths with their unconventional therapists.

programme.title: Memories Of Me
programme.desc: Abe (Alan King) is king of the Hollywood extras. His son Abbie (Billy Crystal) is a respected heart surgeon who's felt like a bit player in his father's life. After a health scare, Abbie heads to Hollywood in an effort to mend some family ties.

programme.title: Girls Just Want To Have Fun
programme.desc: Janey is new in town and soon meets Lynne, who shares her passion for dancing in general and Dance TV in particular.

programme.title: 18 Again!
programme.desc: In this fantasy comedy, an outcast teenager (Charlie Schlatter) accidentally switches bodies with his 81-year-old bachelor grandfather (George Burns).

programme.title: Crimes and Misdemeanors
programme.desc: An esteemed ophthalmologist (Martin Landau) contemplates the murder of his mistress (Anjelica Huston) and a struggling documentary filmmaker (Woody Allen) who considers selling out by making a documentary about a Hollywood jackass (Alan Alda).

programme.title: Salvation! Have You Said Your Prayers Today?
programme.desc: In this prophetic satire by Beth B, a sex-obsessed TV minister finds an evangelical rock star in the making (Exene Cervenka of the punk band X).

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: A disgruntled CIA agent quits after office politics confine him to a desk job. He heads to Europe, where he links up with a former lover. All goes smoothly until the CIA agent writes a tell-all autobiography.

programme.title: The Wrong Guys
programme.desc: Cub Scout Pack 18 organizes a 25-year reunion to relive their fond boyhood memories, and five old friends quickly discover that what little they had once known about wilderness survival has dwindled to nothing.

programme.title: High Season
programme.desc: A satire about a beautiful English photographer (Bisset) stranded on an idyllic Greek island with neither money nor inspiration, and the motley assembly of characters who surround her during the tourist season.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: The Out of Towners
programme.desc: The top candidate for a prestigious promotion at his company’s corporate headquarters in New York City, George, accompanied by his wife Gwen is all set to take a bite out of The Big Apple.

programme.title: Lenny
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman magnificently captures the complexities and contradictions of the legendary comedian Lenny Bruce's mercurial character.

programme.title: The End
programme.desc: When Sonny (Burt Reynolds) is diagnosed with a fatal disease, he swallows a bottle of pills to end it all! Instead, he ends up in a loony bin beside the demented Marlon (Dom DeLuise) who is eager to help Sonny succeed...one madcap attempt at a time!

programme.title: Love and Death
programme.desc: Woody Allen invades the spirit of Tolstoy in this hilarious spoof of 18th Century Russia, when Napoleon is preoccupied with perfecting his pastry and before Wellington markets his beef.

programme.title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
programme.desc: Woody Allen heads up an amazing cast including Gene Wilder, Tony Randall and Lynn Redgrave, in several hysterical vignettes that spoof the unorthodox joys of sex.

programme.title: Bananas
programme.desc: Woody Allen's humor is at his wild and bizarre best in this story of a "weird-gadget" tester who, after being jilted by his girlfriend (Louise Lasser), ends up as president of a tiny country where absurdity reigns.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: A sentimental tale of an elderly Jewish tailor (Zero Mostel) who has lost his faith in God and himself. Enter a Jewish angel (Harry Belafonte), on probation, who must earn his wings by convincing the tailor that life does have meaning.

programme.title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
programme.desc: Series of short, highly irreverent, and quite often tasteless skits.

programme.title: The Bad News Bears (1976)
programme.desc: A major surprise as one of 1976's top-grossing films. THE BAD NEWS BEARS is a movie about children that is refreshing, utterly believable, and quite cleverly funny.

programme.title: Bad News Bears in Breaking Training (1977)
programme.desc: The story picks up the Bears career a year after their infamous second-place finish in the North Valley League. Faced with a chance to play the Houston Toros for a shot at the Japanese champs, they devise a way to get Texas to play at the famed Astrodome.

programme.title: Bad News Bears Go To Japan (1978)
programme.desc: Caught in a clash of cultures and ready to wreak more havoc on Japan than Godzilla, the Bad News Bears are back this time the Bears are spirited off to Tokyo by a slick and sleazy con artist who sees in the team a perfect peg for a get-rich-quick scheme.

programme.title: Stay Hungry
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges and Sally Field star in this quirky, sensitive drama about a wealthy Southern bachelor who learns that money and charm have their limitations. Arnold Schwarzenegger also appears.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: A small-time talent agent discovers an amazing boxing kangaroo and figures to use it as his stepping-stone into the big time.

programme.title: Hardware Wars
programme.desc: The original Star Wars Parody from 1978!

programme.title: Arnold's Wrecking Company
programme.desc: A student tries pot for the first time, loves it and decides to distribute it in a big business kind of way. Soon he has the police and the mafia on his tail.

programme.title: La Cage Aux Folles
programme.desc: One of the most successful comedies of all time, this Best Foreign Film Award winner inspired "The Birdcage" and stars Michel Serrault and Ugo Tognazzi as two partners torn between cross-dressing and chaos!

programme.title: Quackser Fortune Has a Cousin in the Bronx
programme.desc: A comedy of the human spirit about a highly independent young Irishman who triumphs over conformity.

programme.title: Tunnel Vision
programme.desc: "Tunnel Vision" is a riotous satire of TV, packed with outrageous sketches & biting humor that mercilessly skewers the absurdities of TV culture.

programme.title: FTA
programme.desc: In 1971, Jane Fonda and Donald Sutherland toured an anti-war comedy show across Southeast Asia, inspiring soldiers and angering military leaders.

programme.title: Sheila Levine Is Dead And Living In New York
programme.desc: The traumas confronting a young Jewish girl in search of life, happiness and a husband in the big city.

programme.title: Rhinoceros
programme.desc: Gene Wilder and Zero Mostel star in Eugene Ionesco's absurdist play about a French city where citizens begin to mysteriously turn into rhinoceroses.

programme.title: Monty Python Live (Mostly): One Down, Five To Go
programme.desc: Filmed on the final night of the run of ten sold out performances, live at London's O2 Arena, Monty Python Live (mostly) – One Down Five to Go sees the five surviving members together performing many of their classic sketches and much-loved songs.

programme.title: Monty Python: Before The Flying Circus
programme.desc: Before Monty Python, before the Flying Circus, before America, the Hollywood Bowl and the hordes of fans, there were just six young men who came together with an idea for a show – a show that would transform their lives and change comedy forever.

programme.title: Monty Python Live At Aspen
programme.desc: This reunion show features the five surviving members of Monty Python, with Graham Chapman in attendance in the form of his "ashes" being brought out in an urn. The Pythons look back at their work and receive an American Film Industry award.

programme.title: The Meaning Of Monty Python
programme.desc: This programme celebrates the 30th Anniversary of Monty Python's final film The Meaning of Life.

programme.title: Monty Python: The Meaning of Live
programme.desc: This film captures the most anticipated comeback show in comedy history. It follows the stars of Monty Python as they reform and stage a marathon ten shows at The O2, London.

programme.title: Monty Python Conquers America
programme.desc: This documentary, featuring new interviews with the Pythons and home-movie glimpses of fledging Python-mania, follows the troupe's long and winding road to the States, acknowledging the unsung heroes in the Python story.

programme.title: Parrot Sketch Not Included: 20 Years Of Monty Python
programme.desc: Steve Martin presents selected sketches from "Monty Python's Flying Circus (1969)". It's the well known sketches, though the parrot sketch is not included. Steve Martin has some funny comments on the Pythons.

programme.title: Yellowbeard
programme.desc: A 17th-century pirate in search of treasure. He's accompanied by his son, who has the location of the treasure tattooed on his head. It is a parody on the pirate movies of earlier days.

programme.title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
programme.desc: Toby (Adam Driver) enters a world of time jumping fantasy when he meets 'Don Quixote' (Jonathan Pryce), a delusional Spanish cobbler who believes Toby to be Sancho Panza. They embark on an epic adventure where dreams and reality intertwine.

programme.title: Eric Idle's What About Dick?
programme.desc: Only once in a lifetime there comes a cast like this Russell Brand, Billy Connolly, Tim Curry, Eric Idle, Eddie Izzard, Jane Leeves, Jim Piddock, Tracy Ullman and Sophie Winkleman - in a lowbrow comedy about highbrow people.

programme.title: American Friends
programme.desc: Stuffy academic gives it all up for love.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: In the style of KENTUCKY FRIED MOVIE, writer-director Robert Townsend lampoons Hollywood's perception of blacks--and racial stereotypes in general.

programme.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: Aren't You Embarrassed?
programme.desc: Sebastian Maniscalco returns home to Chicago to perform in front of a live sold-out audience in this all-new comedy event. With his inimitable delivery, he burns modern-day society through the lens of his old-world Italian-American upbringing.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon: a person or thing that proves to be defective, imperfect, or unsatisfactory. Isaac Lachmann is a lemon. His career is going nowhere. His girlfriend of ten years is leaving him. Isaac Lachmann now just watches as his life unravels.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) manages the ultimate balancing act between work and her adoring family in this comedy based on the bestseller by Allison Pearson.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: Two assistant managers of a corporate grocery store contend for a coveted promotion.

programme.title: Saved!
programme.desc: Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: There’s only one thing keeping aspiring executive Tim from corporate success. He must find the perfect guest to bring to his boss’s monthly dinner party, where the winner of the evening is the one who arrives with the biggest buffoon.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: Lester's life is far from perfect. As he makes a few changes in his life, the freer and the happier he gets. However, Lester is about to learn that the ultimate freedom comes at a price.

programme.title: Rambling Rose
programme.desc: A confused and over-sexed young woman is taken in by a respectable Southern family. She is warmly received but trouble begins when she cannot control her sexual desires.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: Tender Mercies
programme.desc: Winner of two Academy Awards®, TENDER MERCIES is a compassionate love story tracing the relationship between a burnt-out country western star and the young widow he meets in a small Texas motel.

programme.title: My Left Foot
programme.desc: Winner of two Academy Awards, including Best Actor Daniel Day-Lewis and Best Actress Brenda Fricker, this is the inspiring true story of a man who defied the odds to become a well-known author, artist, and activist.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor, set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed film chronicles the true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered a decades-long cover-up of child abuse within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Raging Bull
programme.desc: RAGING BULL is director Martin Scorsese's lacerating film biography of middleweight boxing champion Jake LaMotta, who was known during his brief reign as "the Bronx Bull."

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's relationship with a condemned man, this provocative examination of crime, punishment and redemption earned Susan Sarandon the 1995 Oscar for Best Actress and Sean Penn an Oscar nomination for Best Actor.

programme.title: Hannah And Her Sisters
programme.desc: Woody Allen wrote, directed and stars in this comedy/drama about the amorous affiliations of three sisters and the men in their lives. Story touches on such universal themes as life, death, love, adultery, religion and family relations.

programme.title: Midnight Cowboy
programme.desc: This Academy Award-winning Best Picture stars Dustin Hoffman and Jon Voight in standout, Oscar-nominated performances as a con man and a Texas hustler trying to survive on the tough streets of New York. The legendary John Schlesinger directs.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Sophie's Choice
programme.desc: Sophie is the survivor of Nazi concentration camps, who has found a reason to live with Nathan, a sparkling if unsteady American Jew obsessed with the Holocaust. They befriend Stingo, the movie's narrator, a young American writer new to New York City.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

programme.title: Boyhood
programme.desc: Filmed over twelve years with the same cast, Richard Linklater's acclaimed smash hit is a groundbreaking celebration of life. Stars Ethan Hawke and Patricia Arquette.

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: A day in the life of a college professor; recently widowed after a sixteen-year marriage.

programme.title: The Black Stallion
programme.desc: Teri Garr and Mickey Rooney star in this heartWarming Adventureture about a boy who forges a special friendship with a wild stallion after both are shipwrecked on a deserted island.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: MONSTER'S BALL is a hard-hitting Southern drama tempered by a story of powerful life-changing love.

programme.title: Blue Sky
programme.desc: Uprooting his family after being assigned to a remote testing facility in Alabama, nuclear engineer Hank Marshall is faced with a moral decision as an opponent of the atmospheric tests he’s asked to complete.

programme.title: The Iron Lady
programme.desc: OSCAR-winning Meryl Streep is Margaret Thatcher in this insightful and intimate portrait of the first and only female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

programme.title: The Woodsman
programme.desc: A child molester returns to his hometown after 12 years in prison.

programme.title: August: Osage County
programme.desc: Meryl Streep and Julia Roberts lead an all-star cast. A family crisis unites a dispersed group of siblings at the Oklahoma house they grew up in with the dysfunctional woman who raised them.

programme.title: On Golden Pond
programme.desc: Norman is a curmudgeon with an estranged relationship with his daughter Chelsea. At Golden Pond, he and his wife nevertheless agree to care for Billy, the son of Chelsea's new boyfriend, and a most unexpected relationship blooms.

programme.title: Radio Days
programme.desc: A nostalgic reminiscence about growing up in 1940s Queens, New York, mixing family vignettes with incidents about radio performers from that medium's golden age.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: Pieces of April
programme.desc: A head strong young woman, who has alienated her parents is forced to confront their troubled relationship when she learns that her mother, is dying of cancer.

programme.title: Broadway Danny Rose
programme.desc: A pathetic small-time personal agent, whose list of clients reads like a circus sideshow, tries to boost the career of a boozy, overweight '50s singer on the comeback trail.

programme.title: Love Field
programme.desc: A Dallas beautician and housewife is enthralled by President and Mrs. John F. Kennedy, and is like an excited schoolgirl at the thought of their visit to her hometown in November 1963.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: CHRISTINE is the story of an aspiring newswoman caught in the midst of a personal and professional life crisis. Between unrequited love, frustration at work, a tumultuous home, and self-doubt; she begins to spiral down a dark path.

programme.title: The Russians Are Coming, The Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: Alan Arkin and Jonathan Winters lead an all-star cast (Carl Reiner, Eva Marie Saint, Brian Keith, Theodore Bikel) in this outrageous comedy about a Russian submarine that runs aground off the New England coast.

programme.title: Afterglow

programme.title: Black Narcissus

programme.title: Great Expectations (1946)
programme.desc: A humble orphan boy in 1810s Kent is given the opportunity to go to London and become a gentleman, with the help of an unknown benefactor.

programme.title: Hunger Ward

programme.title: The Man Who Skied Down Everest
programme.desc: This Oscar-winning film features adventurer, poet, and world champion skier Yuichiro Miura in his attempt to ski down Mount Everest from its summit.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)

programme.title: China Strike Force

programme.title: Operation Condor

programme.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programme.desc: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

programme.title: Contract Killer
programme.desc: Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)

programme.title: Tai Chi Master [English Subtitled]

programme.title: The Foreigner

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Man Of Tai Chi
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves makes his directorial debut in this explosive martial arts drama that reunites him with legendary Matrix Trilogy fight choreographer Yuen Wo Ping and stuntman Tiger Chen.

programme.title: The Master (1991)
programme.desc: In this early movie from Hong Kong action-movie legend Jet Li, a student of kung fu comes to Los Angeles to help his former master.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Vengeance of an Assassin
programme.desc: An assassin escapes a battle and hides out in his childhood home. As he recovers, he realizes he has to fight faster and harder to survive.

programme.desc: Master stuntman Brian Ho (X-MEN: DAYS OF FUTURE PAST) stars in this action-packed thriller as undercover cop Billy Tong, who infiltrates the inner circle of a powerful gang in order to prove his loyalty to its leader

programme.title: Foggy Mountain
programme.desc: The film revolves around the story of Phi - a retired martial artist, longing for a peaceful life with a beautiful wife named Lanh.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: The King is Invincible

programme.desc: The martial-arts action film 10 Brothers of Shaolin tells the tale of ten specially trained fighters, five monks, five laymen, who have been taught their skills in order to protect Master Chu, who needs all the help he can.

programme.title: Ong Bak

programme.title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
programme.desc: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world.

programme.title: Journey To The West

programme.title: Revenge of the Ninja

programme.title: The Legend [English Subtitled]

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood

programme.title: Enter the Clones of Bruce

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler

programme.title: Shadow

programme.title: Iron Monkey

programme.title: Fist Of Legend [English-Language Version]

programme.title: Shaolin Drunk Monk

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: The American Ninja burst onto the screen in the fourth round of martial arts Action.

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon

programme.title: IP Man 4: The Finale

programme.title: IP Man: The Final Fight

programme.title: The Bodyguard from Beijing [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A corrupt businessman commits a murder and the only witness is the girlfriend of another businessman with close connections to the Chinese government.

programme.desc: The secret Red Lotus Flower Society is committed to the overthrow of the evil Manchu Emperor and his minions. One of his Governors is sent on a mission to retrieve a list of members of that secret society.

programme.title: Avengement

programme.desc: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: In this fantastical action film, martial arts legend Jackie Chan stars as a police inspector tracking down a deranged villain who is out to kidnap his daughter.

programme.title: JCVD
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme gets involved in a bank robbery with hostages situation and reflects about his life during it.

programme.title: The Order

programme.title: Fist of the Red Dragon
programme.desc: Young Beggar Su is addicted to opium and manipulated by a scheming imperial prince to fight against WFH and assassinate a righteous general.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing [English-Language Version]

programme.desc: Cagney, now a Lieutenant, re-teams with Lacey, who has retired from the force, to find a cache of firearms. Trouble arises when Marcus becomes a suspect & Mansfield has returned to torment the duo!

programme.desc: Cagney & Lacey are back & working on two cases! The first is a murder trial, in which Lacey has doubts about the suspect's guilt. Meanwhile, Cagney becomes involved with the father of her late neighbor.

programme.title: Total Recall

programme.title: Blacklight

programme.title: Braven

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.desc: After deadly terrorists abduct his niece at a soccer match, an ex-soldier with lethal fighting skills (Dave Bautista) wages a one-man war to save her and prevent mass destruction.

programme.title: Black Eagle

programme.title: Derailed

programme.title: Death Warrant

programme.title: Gallowwalkers

programme.title: Timecop

programme.title: The Assignment

programme.title: Armed Response

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle Leblanc, a man serving a life's sentence for killing his wife's murderer, must survive in a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment.

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a fashion designer who must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

programme.title: Get the Gringo

programme.title: The Bouncer

programme.title: Hunter Killer

programme.title: Swelter
programme.desc: Ten years after their casino heist, four escaped convicts trace their former partner to a desert town, where he is now a lawman with no memory of his criminal past.

programme.title: The Defender
programme.desc: Lance and his team are bodyguards for NSA's head sent by the president to a secret meeting outside Bucharest which is attacked. But Why?

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade

programme.desc: Women have been among the strongest pillars of Hitlerism from its very inception. If some historians underline the complicity between women and the government, others present them as victims of propaganda and Nazi Population Policy.

programme.title: Hitler's Children
programme.desc: A documentary looking into the lives of the descendants of the top Nazi officials who worked under Hitler's command.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Headquarters: The Wolf's Lair
programme.desc: Nazi delusions preserved in concrete ‚Äì a place shrouded in mystery and still a symbol of the horror of the Nazi regime. This documentary tells the story of clandestine construction of the Wolf's Lair.

programme.title: Hitler's Favourite Royal
programme.desc: Prince Charles Edward was Queen Victoria's youngest grandchild. Transformed overnight from a British Prince to a German Duke, his life was altered in ways he could never have imagined.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler, Himler, and the Occult
programme.desc: The link between Hitler, the esoteric mystical movement of the nineteenth century, and the Aryan mythology of the Waffen SS is finally established.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler’s wilderness years in Vienna and Munich.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and the Beer Hall Putsch
programme.desc: One of the great ironies of history that Hitler’s first assignment after the Great War was to help the Bavarian army to identify extremist political parties, then to infiltrate and report back.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Science
programme.desc: In the crucible of World War II, Germany's most brilliant scientists raced to create an arsenal of terrifying new weapons of mass destruction, even an atomic bomb.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Weapons
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the campaigns which led to his defeat, this film shows spectacular archive footage of Hitler's secret armory as it was being developed, tested and when it was too late, used in anger.

programme.title: Hitler's War Part 1: 1940-1943
programme.desc: This account of Adolf Hitler's rise to power in Germany — and the subsequent downfall of the Nazi regime — is told with real footage taken from the period.

programme.title: Defining Moments Of WWII In Colour: The Fall Of The Third Reich
programme.desc: World War II's pivotal events are revisited, highlighting dramatic battles between Hitler and the Allies, now in color.

programme.title: Killing Hitler: The True Story of the Valkyrie Plot
programme.desc: Driven by their hatred of Hitler and a desperate desire to keep the war out of Germany, Klaus von Stauffenberg and his co-conspirators hatched a plan that would have brought World War II to an end.

programme.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
programme.desc: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII - and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz.

programme.title: Kinderblock 66 - Return to Buchenwald
programme.desc: On April 11, 1945, Buchenwald was liberated. Nearly 1000 boys survived. On April 11, 2010, sixty-five years later, several of the surviving boys from block 66 returned to Weimar and to Buchenwald. This is their story.

programme.title: The Man Who Cracked the Nazi Code
programme.desc: 6 June 1944. D-Day. The biggest land and sea operation in history. The D-Day landings were only possible thanks to a socially-awkward, antimilitarist mathematician named Alan Turing and his field was the most fundamental branch of mathematics: logic.

programme.title: Nazi Quest for the Holy Grail
programme.desc: In the final days of the Second World War, American troops discovered a vast hoard of mysterious Nazi files hidden in a cave in Southern Germany. Buried deep in these secret documents were the details of one of the Third Reich’s most shadowy projects.

programme.title: Nazis on Trial: Nuremberg in Colour
programme.desc: After almost six years of the Second World War, Germany had surrendered unconditionally on May 8, 1945. Now Nuremberg, where the Nazi Party once celebrated arrogant rallies, was to become the scene of the party's reckoning before the law.

programme.title: Operation Paperclip: The Secret Recruitment

programme.title: Operation Valkyrie: The Plot to Assassinate Hitler

programme.title: Lifeline: Pearl Harbor's Unknown Hero
programme.desc: Narrated by actor Gary Sinise, 'Lifeline: Pearl Harbor's Unknown Hero' tells the story of how U.S. Navy sailor Joe George became an unlikely hero.

programme.title: Propaganda Swing - Dr. Goebbels' Jazz Orchestra

programme.title: Return To Tarawa: The Leon Cooper Story
programme.desc: Depicting a WWII veteran, Leon Cooper, as he returns to the Tarawa battle site after learning that many of his countrymen, who died in the battle, still lie where they fell sixty-six years later. Narrated by Ed Harris

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West

programme.title: The Grand Duel
programme.desc: A former sherrif helps a man who has been famed for murder

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks

programme.title: Black Killer

Oscar-winner Paul Newman (Hud, Nobody's Fool) stars as General Leslie Groves, the military man in charge of a massive project that will produce two weapons: "Fat Man" and "Little Boy." Dwight Schultz (The Temp, Star Trek: First Contact) is J. Robert Oppenheimer, the brilliant scientist attempting to bring the startling mission to fruition. And Bonnie Bedelia, John Cusack, Laura Dern, and Natasha Richardson co-star in this "stunning, profoundly moving" film (Michael Medved, Sneak Previews) that re-creates one of history's most compelling chapters; one that resulted in the mushroom-shaped specter that changed the world forever.

programme.title: Hart's War
programme.desc: War hero Col. McNamara is imprisoned in a German POW camp. As the camp's highest-ranking American officer, he commands his fellow inmates. Never giving up the fight to win the war, McNamara is planning, waiting for his moment to strike back at the enemy.

programme.title: Hyena Road
programme.desc: Three men, three different paths, caught in conflict but brought together to save lives: a highly skilled sniper who can’t think of his targets as human, an intelligence officer who has never killed while on duty.

programme.title: The Lucky Ones
programme.desc: A timely drama about life in America today, THE LUCKY ONES is a story of three soldiers on leave trying to make sense of their lives during an unexpected road trip across the United States.

programme.title: Hell Is For Heroes
programme.desc: It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

programme.title: Redemption Day
programme.desc: Having just returned home, decorated U.S. Marine Captain Brad Paxton's (Gary Dourdan) wife, Kate, is kidnapped by a terrorist group while working in Morocco. He is forced back into action for a daring and deadly operation to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
programme.desc: Astonishing revelations about a top-secret wing of the U.S. military come to light when a reporter encounters an enigmatic Special Forces operator on a mind-boggling mission.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Gregory Peck heads an all-star cast in this true re-enactment of the terrifying Korean War that brilliantly pulls the viewer inextricably into the crossfire that surrounds American foot soldiers.

programme.title: Eye In The Sky
programme.desc: When a child enters the kill zone of a drone operation targeting terrorists in Kenya, an international dispute is triggered that reaches the highest levels of British and US governments. A thrilling portrayal of the moral implications of modern warfare.

programme.title: Oh! What A Lovely War
programme.desc: The working-class Smiths change their initially sunny views on World War I after the three boys of the family witness the harsh reality of trench warfare.

programme.title: Assault On Va-33
programme.desc: Sean Patrick Flanery (The Boondock Saints) stars as Army Veteran Jason Hill. While on a VA hospital visit, terrorists infiltrate the building and take hostages. Hill is now outnumbered and the last line of defense against the armed insurgents.

programme.title: The Command
programme.desc: Colin Firth stars in the unforgettable true story of 23 sailors fighting for survival against impossible odds when a Russian sub sinks to the bottom of the Barents Sea in August 2000.

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: Two Czech soldiers parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi General Reinhard Heydrich, Hitler's second in command.

programme.title: Wolf Hound
programme.desc: In this thrilling WWII epic, a US pilot shot down over Germany must singlehandedly battle Nazi troops to thwart a doomsday plot involving a superbomb that can destroy whole cities.

programme.title: Hanoi Hilton
programme.desc: A group of POW'S, captives inside Hanoi's Hoa prison during the Vietnam War, endure some brutal lessons in the art of survival and find dignity in the bargain. A top-notch drama with a superb cast.

programme.title: Legion of Honor
programme.desc: Rebuffed in love and uncertain of life, Simon is the story of a young Englishman's physical and spiritual journey during Algeria's battle for independence from France.

programme.title: Recon
programme.desc: At the close of WWII, four American soldiers are sent on a reconnaissance mission led by an Italian man with indeterminate loyalties. Hunted by a mysterious sniper, they must fight to make it out alive.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

programme.title: There Be Dragons
programme.desc: Arising out of the horror of the Spanish Civil War, a candidate for canonization is investigated by a journalist who discovers his own estranged father had a deep, dark and devastating connection to the saint's life.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Three World War II veterans return home to small-town America to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed.

programme.title: The Life And Death Of Colonel Blimp
programme.desc: From the Boer War through World War II, a soldier rises through the ranks in the British military.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

programme.title: Sunray: Fallen Soldier
programme.desc: A war veteran calls on friends from his past to hunt down those responsible for the death of his daughter. Along the way, he learns more about himself than he anticipated as a violent crime syndicate unravels in his wake.

programme.title: Henry V
programme.desc: A young and uncertain monarch, King Henry defeats the French, but sadly learns that victory takes its toll in bloodshed.

programme.title: The Railway Man
programme.desc: Colin Firth stars as a former army officer who sets out on a mission of revenge to confront the man who tormented him while he was a prisoner at a Japanese labor camp during World War II.
Set in the countryside of the Province of Emilia in Italy, the story of two men, one a bastard born into a family of farm workers, the other an heir to a wealthy family of landowners.

programme.title: The Eight Hundred
programme.desc: This is the riveting tale of eight hundred Chinese soldiers from the onslaught of the Imperial Japanese Army just prior to World War II.

programme.title: All Quiet On The Western Front
programme.desc: A young soldier faces profound disillusionment in the soul-destroying horror of World War I.

programme.title: Battle of The Bulge: Winter War
programme.desc: Lt. Robert Cappa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers must defend a vital supply depot from being captured by attacking German soldiers.

programme.title: The Last Days of Patton
programme.desc: This film depicts the aging General's autumn years as a controversial ex-Nazi defender and desk-bound World War II historian. Following the close of World War II, General George S. Patton is seriously injured in a car accident and not expected to survive.

programme.title: Memorial Day
programme.desc: Matt Walker is an attorney and a Vietnam veteran. He attends a reunion with three of his war buddies, but soon after, one of the men kills himself and leaves a note asking Matt to contact his estranged son in Texas.

programme.title: Indivisible
programme.desc: Upon returning from serving in the U.S. Army, Chaplain Darren Turner faces a crisis that shatters his family and faith in God but through the help of his fellow soldiers, he returns to his faith and family.

programme.title: Story of G.I. Joe
programme.desc: At the close of WWII, Pulitzer Prize-winning war correspondent Ernie Pyle travels with the U.S. Army's Company C Division during their liberation of Italy.

programme.title: No Greater Love
programme.desc: No Greater Love explores a combat deployment through the eyes of an Army chaplain, as he and his men fight their way through a hellish tour in one of the most dangerous places in Afghanistan and then as they struggle to reintegrate home.

programme.title: Go Tell the Spartans
programme.desc: A savvy U.S. major (Burt Lancaster) reluctantly obeys an ill-advised order to send out a unit of South Vietnamese troops and American advisors to a peaceful, former French outpost. He fears it will draw the Viet Cong into the area – and he’s right!

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: Lauren Graham, Thomas Haden Church and Josh Wiggins star in 'Max,' a family film about a wayward teen who finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his older brother, a U.S. Marine who was killed on the Afghanistan frontlines.

programme.title: Reserved to Fight
programme.desc: Living among loved ones who don't yet understand how they have changed and suffering from a psychological disorder that is difficult to acknowledge, these young veterans grapple to find purpose and healing.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: War drama set during the end of World War II, the film tells the true story of General Bonner Fellers, and the decision that shaped the course of history for Japan and the world.

programme.title: The Battle of Jangsari
programme.desc: Based on the true story of forgotten heroes of the Korean War, a small, inexperienced battalion of student soldiers is tasked with liberating the strategic location of Incheon.

programme.title: Aviator
programme.desc: Stranded aboard, an American pilot is forced to work with the Colombian drug cartel, to escape the country and tend to his ailing son.
Jack O’Connell is “mesmerizing” (VANITY FAIR) as a British soldier accidentally abandoned on the streets of Belfast in 1971. Alone, he must survive the night within enemy lines.

programme.title: Rescue Dawn
programme.desc: In 1965, while bombing Laos, pilot Dieter Dengler crashes in the jungle. Dieter is arrested, tortured and sent to a prison camp, where he organizes an escape plan. A betrayal splits the group and Dieter finds that the jungle is the actual prison.

programme.title: Warhorse One
programme.desc: A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

programme.title: Foxhole
programme.desc: Unfolding over the span of 36 hours in three separate wars - The American Civil War, World War I, and Iraq - Foxhole follows five soldiers confined in a foxhole as they grapple with Morality, futility, and an increasingly volatile combat situation.

programme.title: Battle for Afghanistan
programme.desc: 1988-1989. The end of the Soviet-Afghan war. The USSR begins its withdrawal from Afghanistan. Soviet General Vasiliev's son - a pilot named Alexander gets kidnapped by the mujahideen after his airplane crashes.

programme.title: A War
programme.desc: Company commander Claus Pedersen and his men are stationed in Afghanistan. During a mission, the soldiers are caught in heavy crossfire and in order to save his men, Claus makes a decision that has grave consequences for him and his family back home.

programme.title: A Midnight Clear
programme.desc: As the end of World War II approaches, a group of American soldiers is assigned to watch activity amidst the stark snow-covered landscape of the French-German border and soon discover a battle-weary enemy as reluctant to fight as they are.

programme.title: USS Franklin: Honor Restored
programme.desc: Emotions run deep, still today, in the surviving men of the USS Franklin. The carrier, known as "The Ship That Wouldn't Die", survived a direct hit by a Japanese armor-piecing bomb just fifty miles off the coast of Japan in March 1945.

programme.title: The Boer War: 1899-1902
programme.desc: Journey back in time to a different age, when the sun never set on the British Empire and her armies were great. The Boer War was a turning point in British military history, revolutionizing tactics, battlefield strategy, equipment, and training.

programme.title: Project 949
programme.desc: The mysterious sinking, the causes, and the salvage operations are revealed of the K-141, Kursk. The Kursk was a Project 949A submarine of the Oscar-class. During the Cold War, The Soviet Navy had to face the challenge of NATO's powerful maritime fleets.

programme.title: Beyond the Call of Duty
programme.desc: Five Special Ops, Alpha Squad, is set on one final recon mission that turns into an all out war for survival against a wave of undead experiments.

programme.title: Medal Of Honor: The History
programme.desc: Narrated by Gary Sinise, this documentary showcases the medal itself and how it rose from a decoration no one wanted, to become the nation's highest honor.

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: A dramatization of the Battle of Isandlwana, where the British Army met its match against the Zulu nation.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: Back home in Texas after fighting in Iraq, a soldier refuses to return to battle despite the government mandate requiring him to do so.

programme.title: Image of Victory
programme.desc: Inspired by true events in 1948. Hassanin, an Egyptian filmmaker, is tasked with documenting a raid on the isolated kibbutz.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: With a German offensive imminently approaching, the company anxiously awaits their unknown fate. Based on the Tony award winning play.

programme.title: The Final Sacrifice
programme.desc: Aerial bombings and seething vengeful locals are the biggest risk to Axis forces stationed in northern Italy during the last days of World War II.

programme.title: Lost Horizon
programme.desc: A hardened soldier for hire risks everything to save lives, expose betrayal, and reclaim his humanity in a land torn by war.

programme.title: Hangmen Also Die
programme.desc: After the German administrator of Czechoslovakia is shot, his assassin tries to elude the Gestapo and struggles with his impulse to give himself up as hostages are executed.

programme.title: Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence
programme.desc: During WWII, a British colonel tries to bridge the cultural divides between a British POW and the Japanese camp commander in order to avoid bloodshed.

programme.title: Three Kingdoms
programme.desc: Based on Romance of the Three Kingdoms by Luo Guangzhong. It ranks as one of China's four most important pieces of literature. (2010)

programme.title: Passchendaele
programme.desc: The lives of a troubled veteran, his nurse girlfriend and a naive boy intersect first in Alberta and then in Belgium during the bloody World War I battle of Passchendaele.

programme.title: The Kill Team
programme.desc: This provocative, bold, and deeply moving documentary profiles Adam Winfield, a soldier-turned-whistleblower who returns from the battlefield to expose shocking war crimes that the U.S. Army will do anything to cover up.

programme.title: The Weight of Honor
programme.desc: Filmed over five years, THE WEIGHT OF HONOR follows caregivers of veterans who have been catastrophically wounded in America's longest war. The film reveals family dynamics, hardships, and now, the uncertainties that lie ahead.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Happy as a Cat
programme.desc: The famous writer Bernard Werber narrates this fantastic journey into the feline world. After being obsessed with ants, cats have become his new passion.

programme.title: Catnip Nation
programme.desc: Would you risk arrest for a cat? The heroes of Catnip Nation have. Ultimately, Catnip Nation is a tool for activists to unite and come forward to demand laws and/or policy on Trap Neuter Return, a decade's-old form of population control for feral cats.

programme.title: Chicken People (2016)
programme.desc: Chicken People is a funny and uplifting look at the world of show chickens and the people who love them.

programme.title: Follow Your Cat
programme.desc: Do you know your cat? When not purring on the living room sofa, do you know to where your pet roams?

programme.title: Catwalk: Tales from the Cat Show Circuit
programme.desc: Catwalk: Tales From the Cat Show Circuit follows a competitive season in the lives of two top cat fanciers, Shirley and Kim, and their prize-winning felines: Oh La La, the regal Red Persian, and Bobby, the rambunctious white Turkish Angora.

programme.title: Seniors: A Dogumentary
programme.desc: An old dog can teach you new tricks!

programme.title: The Dog Doc
programme.desc: A pioneer of integrative medicine, veterinarian Dr. Marty Goldstein attracts four-legged patients from around the world, providing holistic treatments for animals after other vets have given up hope.

programme.title: Rescuing Rex
programme.desc: Rescuing Rex follows the remarkable journey of the world's stray dogs and the animal lovers coming to their rescue.

programme.title: Old Friends: A Dogumentary
programme.desc: The paw-inspiring tale of the Old Friends Senior Dog Sanctuary, a place where love never grows old.

programme.title: Black Beauty Breed
programme.desc: The Rottweiler is one of the oldest dog breeds with a heritage that can be traced back to ancient Roman times. Loyal, highly intelligent and courageous, the modern Rottweiler is often misunderstood.

programme.title: Rescue Me: International
programme.desc: In this moving and informative documentary, the Rescue Me team goes to the United Kingdom to exam a local home-grown cat rescue and a larger national organization.

programme.title: Rescue Me: A Home 4 Spot
programme.desc: Explore the highs, lows and daily realities of running an urban animal rescue. This is the story of Diana England, a retired nail-stylist, who started her own dog rescue in Las Vegas, a "Home 4 Spot".

programme.title: American Mustang
programme.desc: A young girl discovers that America's wild horses are in danger of being wiped off the land they've called home for thousands of years, as American Mustang the Movie unveils the compelling story of the wild mustang.

programme.title: Forever Faithful
programme.desc: Forever Faithful is the story of one family's journey through canine cancer told through the eyes of their young daughter. The film follows her journey as she tries to understand both the causes of cancer and the advanced treatments available to her dog.

programme.title: Cat Daddies
programme.desc: A heartwarming collective portrait of eight unique men whose lives have been changed by their love for cats. Some of these men will navigate the unprecedented challenges of 2020 with the help of these feline friends.

programme.title: The Story of Lassie
programme.desc: For 50 years, she has represented all that is good about the enduring bonds between human beings and their dogs. She first leaped to stardom in the 1943 MGM film, Lassie Come Home.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: From the very first meeting, sparks fly between the H-Club members. Get ready for intense workouts, pumping hearts, and a whole lot of love!

programme.title: Soul of a Banquet
programme.desc: In this mouth-watering documentary, director Wayne Wang (The Joy Luck Club) profiles Cecilia Chiang, the matriarch of modern Chinese cooking, as she relates her fascinating history and cooks up a sumptuous, once-in-a-lifetime banquet.

programme.title: Noma: My Perfect Storm
programme.desc: René Redzepi is renowned as one of the world's best chefs. His restaurant NOMA was voted the best restaurant in the world four times. Take a look into his kitchen as he strives to achieve perfection and concoct bold, exciting dishes.

programme.title: Barbecue
programme.desc: Barbecue is about more than grilling a piece of meat. It’s a ritual performed religiously across the world. It's a path to salvation. It’s the pride of nations. And the stories told around the fires become a way to bring the world together.

programme.title: Crafting A Nation
programme.desc: The American craft beer industry began its rise during the worst economic crisis in America since the Great Depression.

programme.title: A Year in Burgundy
programme.desc: The film follows seven wine-making families in the Burgundy region of France through the course of a full year, and delves into the cultural and creative process of making wine, as well as its deep ties to the land.

programme.title: Lobster War: The Fight Over The World's Richest Fishing Grounds
programme.desc: Lobster War is an award-winning film about a climate-fueled conflict between the US and Canada over waters both countries have claimed since the end of the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Fifty Shades Of Rosé
programme.desc: From the south of France to Napa Valley, California; from Cape Town, South Africa to Shanghai, on China's central coast, Rosé has earned its place at the pinnacle of the world of wine. What secret recipe lies behind these pink bottles' success?

programme.title: A Year in Champagne
programme.desc: With renowned wine importer Martine Saunier as our guide, we get a rare glimpse behind the scenes into the real Champagne through six houses, from small independent makers to the illustrious houses of Gosset and Bollinger.

programme.title: For Grace
programme.desc: Curtis Duffy, one of the United States' most renowned chefs, builds a world-famous restaurant at a time of personal crisis. A documentary about food, family, balance and sacrifice.

programme.title: A Year in Port
programme.desc: With renowned wine importer Martine Saunier as our guide, we journey into Portugal's spectacular Douro Valley to explore the mystery and complexity of the world of port.

programme.title: Chef Flynn
programme.desc: A teen chef sets out to challenge the hierarchy of the culinary world after he transforms his living room into a supper club.

programme.title: Straight Up: Kentucky Bourbon
programme.desc: Kentucky's rise to undisputed Bourbon Capital of the world is a rich, detailed, and innovative story that displays how the state has continued to raise the level of whiskey making to unprecedented heights.

programme.title: Insatiable: The Homaro Cantu Story
programme.desc: Chef and inventor Homaro Cantu helped put Chicago on the culinary map and wanted to change the world. INSATIABLE takes you on a dizzying and thrilling ride with Cantu, in a story that moves from redemption and inspiration to tragedy and back again.

programme.title: Beers of Joy
programme.desc: Beers of Joy is a fascinating, entertaining, and savory journey into our world’s favorite magical elixir. Feast upon stunning visuals from across the globe as four people immerse themselves in their passion for beer.

programme.title: Julia Child's Kitchen Wisdom
programme.desc: Julia Child's Kitchen Wisdom is a heartfelt tribute to Julia Child's culinary legacy, featuring her favorite recipes and techniques through personal anecdotes and television clips.

programme.title: The Heat: A Kitchen Revolution
programme.desc: It takes a brazen personality to excel in the competitive sport of professional cooking. Meet seven women chefs at the forefront of a "revolution."

programme.title: The Fruit Hunters
programme.desc: The Fruit Hunters travels across culture, history, and geography to show how intertwined we are with the fruits we eat.

programme.title: Ingrediente: A Restaurant Uprooted
programme.desc: This documentary follows chef Drew Deckman who was forced to shutter his restaurant operations due to the pandemic. It's a hero’s story as he cooked everyday feeding his staff, 200 local fishermen, and their families every week.

programme.title: Veganism: Cooking for Tomorrow
programme.desc: Enrich your palette with some of the tastiest vegan dishes coming out of London with The Feel Good Cafe owner Idan Naor, social media superstar Clare Every (The Little London Vegan), and award-winning vegan chef Brett Cobley.

programme.title: Search for General Tso, The
programme.desc: This mouthwateringly entertaining documentary traces the surprising origins of the iconic Chinese-American dish, from Shanghai to Middle America and beyond.

programme.title: Somm
programme.desc: Four sommeliers attempt to pass the prestigious Master Sommelier exam, a test with one of the lowest pass rates in the world.

programme.title: Somm: Into the Bottle
programme.desc: The history, politics, pleasure, and BS of wine told through opening ten very different bottles.

programme.title: Somm 3
programme.desc: Three of the greatest legends in wine meet to drink rare wine.

programme.title: Somm: Cup Of Salvation
programme.desc: The next chapter in the acclaimed SOMM films, the Cup of Salvation dives into what wine truly means to human history and the land we inhabit.

programme.title: Caffeinated
programme.desc: Learn the story behind coffee, and the process by which it's created, and has shaped the lives of thousands.

programme.title: Hummus the Movie
programme.desc: Restaurateurs, musicians, politicians—everyone loves hummus. A story of faith, community, and growth is told through the lens of a dietary staple and superfood, hummus! This documentary shows how food can bring people together.

programme.title: Beer Wars (2009)
programme.desc: With her entertaining documentary, Anat Baron ushers viewers into the backrooms and breweries of the ultra competitive beer industry and reveals what it takes for independent brewers to compete with the corporate giants who dominate the business.

programme.title: Mondovino
programme.desc: A documentary on the impact of globalization on the world's different wine regions.

programme.title: Grand Cru
programme.desc: Burgundy’s winemaking legend Pascal Marchand faces his greatest challenges during the catastrophic 2016 season.

programme.title: Pizza, A Love Story
programme.desc: Marinara sauce runs red through the streets of New Haven in this surprising, delectable documentary which profiles three pizza restaurants -- Pepe, Sally's & Modern -- that together stand as the cornerstone of the town's Italian-American heritage.

programme.title: Barista
programme.desc: Five top baristas find themselves pushing the limits of coffee perfection to win the National Barista Championship - a surreal competition where even one mistake is far too many.

programme.title: Famous Nathan
programme.desc: Famous Nathan is the insider documentary about Nathan's Famous, the iconic Coney Island hot dog stand founded in 1916, told through exclusive clips, family archives and extensive interviews with dedicated friends and employees.

programme.title: Sour Grapes
programme.desc: An unassuming young man floods the American wine market with fake vintages valued in the millions in this humorous and suspenseful tale of an ingenious con on the eve of the 2008 stock market crash.

programme.title: Super Size Me
programme.desc: Winner at Sundance, director Morgan Spurlock's social experiment in fast-food gastronomy sees him attempting to subsist uniquely on food from the McDonald's menu for an entire month.

programme.title: Super Size Me 2: Holy Chicken!
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock reignites his battle with the food industry - this time from behind the register - as he opens his own fast food restaurant.

programme.title: In Organic We Trust
programme.desc: Our food system is broken. Is organic the answer? It's time to reveal the true meaning of organic and look beyond the label for solutions. Change is happening from the soil up.

programme.title: Fat, Sick & Nearly Dead (2011)
programme.desc: Overweight, loaded up on steroids and suffering from a debilitating autoimmune disease, Joe Cross was at the end of his rope and the end of his hope.

programme.title: Food Choices
programme.desc: This new ground-breaking documentary explores the impact that food choices have on people’s health, the health of our planet and on the lives of other living species. And also discusses several misconceptions about food and diet.

programme.title: King Corn (2012)
programme.desc: Engrossing and eye-opening, King Corn is a fun and crusading journey into the digestive tract of our fast food nation where one ultra-industrial, pesticide-laden, heavily-subsidized commodity dominates the food pyramid from top to bottom, corn.

programme.title: What's With Wheat
programme.desc: 'What's With Wheat?' is a hard-hitting investigation into the growing epidemic of wheat & gluten intolerance, and why after eating wheat for thousands of years, it has been linked to so many health problems.

programme.title: The End of Meat
programme.desc: The End of Meat is a groundbreaking documentary film envisioning a future where meat consumption belongs to the past.

programme.title: Tapped
programme.desc: Examines the role of the bottled water industry and its effects on our health, climate change, pollution, and our reliance on oil.

programme.title: At the Fork
programme.desc: Filmmaker and omnivore John Papola, together with his vegetarian wife Lisa, offer up a timely and refreshingly unbiased look at how farm animals are raised for our consumption.

programme.title: A Place at the Table
programme.desc: The next chapter on America's food crisis from the people that brought you FOOD, INC: 1 in 4 kids don't know where their next meal is coming from. Hunger is a growing epidemic in the US, and we can fix it. Jeff Bridges, Tom Colicchio star.

programme.title: Fat Fiction
programme.desc: Fat Fiction reveals how the United States government relied on questionable evidence to support one of the most damaging public health recommendations in the history of our country: the “low-fat diet.”

programme.title: Love Paleo
programme.desc: Doctors, nutritionists, authors, and entrepreneurs from four countries share why they choose to go against conventional health wisdom to promote paleo. The film also reflects on how they were profoundly transformed by the lifestyle beforehand.

programme.title: The Gateway Bug
