programme.desc: Bats are under the spotlight after being pointed to be the cause of the Covid19 crisis. This new documentary approaches the impact of this often viewed as dangerous animals by many people.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Amazing Journeys
programme.desc: Experience the world's greatest animal migrations from zebras in East Africa, to millions of red crabs on Christmas Island, to gray whales in Mexico's beautiful lagoons and monarch butterflies in the Mexican highlands.

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: Alaska: Spirit of the Wild
programme.desc: Witness a poetic story of survival in the harsh conditions of Alaska.

programme.title: Search for the Great Sharks
programme.desc: From the coast of California to the remote reaches of South and Western Australia, this film pursues blue sharks, whale sharks, and the notorious great white to allow viewers an up-close experience.

programme.title: The Disaster Diaries 2015
programme.desc: While we can't look into the future and foresee what may hit us next, we do know that each year brings its share of natural disasters that we often try, in vain, to anticipate, understand, and predict.

programme.title: The Disaster Diaries 2016
programme.desc: Is 2016 the tipping point towards climate and geological chaos? In the footsteps of the successful 2015, The Disaster Diaries, the 2016 edition is a new kind of natural disaster program.

programme.title: The Disaster Diaries 2017
programme.desc: The year 2017 was marked by several major Atlantic hurricanes (including Harvey, Irma, and Maria), flooding in Sri Lanka, two serious earthquakes in Mexico, and deadly forest fires in California and Portugal.

programme.title: A Volcano Odyssey
programme.desc: Follow the story of 65 millions years of evolution around a volcanic hotspot in the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: Adventures in Animation
programme.desc: Adventures in Animation introduces the "stars" of tomorrow, by taking viewers on a journey through the world of computer-generated virtual actors.

programme.title: Close the Divide
programme.desc: A gripping journey to bridge the divide on climate change, revealing how uniting diverse perspectives can spark innovative solutions to the planet's most pressing challenge.

programme.title: Passage to Mars
programme.desc: Incredible true story of a NASA arctic expedition designed to be the first Martian road trip on Earth becomes an epic two-year odyssey of survival. Voiceover from Buzz Aldrin.

programme.title: Killer Asteroid
programme.desc: When natural disasters threaten, we turn to science and technology to warn us to seek shelter or get out of the way. But can they face down the ultimate threat: speeding projectiles from the depths of space?

programme.title: Birth of a Black Hole
programme.desc: It was one of the greatest mysteries in modern science: a series of brief but extremely bright flashes of ultra-high energy light coming from somewhere out in space. What can we learn from the violent birth of a black hole?

programme.title: One More Orbit
programme.desc: A daring team of astronauts and aviators fly a high-speed Gulfstream jet around the earth faster than anyone ever has to set the pole-to-pole circumnavigation record, breaking the boundaries of what was previously thought possible.

programme.title: Pale Red Dot
programme.desc: On the hunt for other solar systems, scientists have discovered an Earth-sized planet orbiting the star nearest to our Sun, Proxima Centauri. It's an important test of whether we are alone in the universe.

programme.title: Amazon
programme.desc: Follow the breathtaking Amazon River from its source in the high Andes through the dense rain forest, and journey with two "medicine men" on a quest for new miracles.

programme.title: Autonomy
programme.desc: Malcolm Gladwell leads a documentary about self-driving vehicles, asking us: what is control and who do we become as we relinquish it to machines?

programme.title: Flight of the Butterflies
programme.desc: Scientist Fred Urquhart studies migration of the monarch butterfly for 40 years.

programme.title: Jupiter Enigma
programme.desc: What can the giant planet Jupiter tell us about the birth of our solar system five billion years ago? Drawing on new findings from NASA’s Juno mission, scientists are peering into Jupiter’s stormy heart to reveal the very origins of our solar system.

programme.title: Maleika
programme.desc: Maleika, a cheetah mother and her six cubs, share their lives with director Matto Barfuss.

programme.title: The Instrumental Chemist
programme.desc: The Instrumental Chemist features the remarkable life of chemist, inventor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Arnold O. Beckman. His brilliantly designed instruments enabled scientists to answer old questions faster and more accurately.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. It is the underpinning of the ecosystem, the foundation upon which the animals and plants of the north depend.

programme.title: Saving Jaws
programme.desc: Biologist OCEAN RAMSEY (“Shark Whisper") credits her connection with sharks to years of research, but others feel it’s something more. Join Ocean and a team of biologists as they travel the globe trying to halt their looming extinction.

programme.title: Miss Snake Charmer
programme.desc: Miss Snake Charmer contestants are not your typical high school beauty queens. The teens must show they are more than just pretty faces-that they have the guts and grit to win America's toughest beauty pageant.

programme.title: In the Mind of Plants
programme.desc: Can plants sense touch, feel pain, dream, and even remember? Some scientists are convinced plants have surpassed animals on their evolutionary paths.

programme.title: First to the Moon
programme.desc: In 1968, NASA sent three men farther and faster than anyone had gone before. This is the story of how Astronauts Frank Borman, Jim Lovell, and Bill Anders changed history on the flight of Apollo 8.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: The Nightmare
programme.desc: Five percent of the world's population have had the experience of awaking paralyzed while a supernatural entity climbs onto their chest suffocating them, inducing a level of fear that is beyond imagination.

programme.title: The Last Reef
programme.desc: The Last Reef is an uplifting, inspirational experience capturing one of nature's more vibrant and diverse wonderlands. These biodiversity hot spots are as vital to our lives as the rainforests.

programme.title: Juice: How Electricity Explains The World
programme.desc: Over a three-year period, we traveled 60,000 miles to interview 40 people from seven countries on five continents to tell the human story of electricity and explain why power equals power.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Run
programme.desc: In a land of dangers, plant-eating animals are always at risk, and never more so than at the time of their birth; out on the open they are vulnerable and there are few places to hide. But luckily some are born to run...

programme.title: Idaho The Movie
programme.desc: Idaho, the Movie is a one-hour television documentary featuring the well known and hidden treasures of Idaho. An elemental theme carries viewers on a tour of the state's mountains, rivers, deserts, landscapes, lakes and more.

programme.title: Climate Warriors
programme.desc: CLIMATE WARRIORS presents people who show resistance against the devastating effects of climate change. They show that we need a fast transition in order to save the environment and keep human rights in balance in favor of peace.

programme.title: The Wonder of it All
programme.desc: Buzz Aldrin and others discuss their experiences on the moon and the importance of Apollo missions.

programme.title: The Cove
programme.desc: A team of activists, filmmakers, and freedivers expose a deadly secret hidden in a remote cove in Taiji, Japan.

programme.title: Giant Otters
programme.desc: The fur trade continues to threaten the South American otter, despite its status as an endangered species.

programme.title: Fortress of the Bears
programme.desc: "Fortress of the Bears" enters a world shaped by bears, trees, and salmon, and explores the delicate balance of their interconnected lives.

programme.title: Elsa's Legacy: The Born Free Story
programme.desc: More than 50 years have passed since the publication of Born Free -- the book, and then a film, that changed forever the way we think about wildlife. What has happened to lions since this story?

programme.title: Superfish: Bluefin Tuna
programme.desc: Narrated by David Attenborough. It is a giant among fish, yet few have filmed it in the wild. Rick Rosenthal sets off to uncover the secrets of the legendary bluefin tuna, while documenting its place in the grand scheme of the vast marine ecosystem.

programme.title: To the Moon - From Dream to Reality
programme.desc: Between 1969 and 1972, twelve men walked on the surface of the moon. It was seen as the first chapter in the ambitious journey of space exploration.

programme.title: The Malaysian Snake Guardian
programme.desc: Not only snakes but the utmost wild creatures and exuberant jungle share life and planet earth.

programme.title: The Birds of Winter
programme.desc: Winter approaches Northern Europe and marks the beginning of the Great Journey.

programme.title: The Magic Forest of Spain
programme.desc: There is a magical place in central Spain, 80 kilometers away from Madrid, where everything is enveloped by an old forest.

programme.title: Red Sea
programme.desc: Explore the impressive underwater landscapes and fascinating species of one of the biggest wonders on our planet. Filmed in stunning 4K, this nautical journey features many of the sea creatures that have made the coral reefs their home.

programme.title: The Woman Who Loves Giraffes
programme.desc: In 1956, 23-year-old biologist Anne Innis Dagg made an unprecedented solo journey to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild.

programme.title: Saving Atlantis
programme.desc: Saving Atlantis focuses on the loss of coral reef ecosystems around the world, and the impact of that decline on the communities that depend on them, on a global journey that celebrates the majesty and mystery of coral habitats.

programme.title: Space Junk
programme.desc: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration.

programme.title: Avalanche: Man vs. Earth (2011)
programme.desc: Tumbling snow can be a massively destructive force, but is this destruction avoidable? With scientific understanding growing all the time, is it possible to gain the upper hand and control this awesome power of nature?

programme.title: Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa
programme.desc: Join a band of trekkers as they journey through rugged terrain and extreme conditions to look out from Africa's highest point in David Breashears' mountain adventure, Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Swim
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface.

programme.title: Dolphins
programme.desc: Examines the lives of dolphins in beautiful tropical locales, their remarkable intelligence, and their relationships with some unique humans who are close to them.

programme.title: Wild Gibraltar
programme.desc: Wild Gibraltar is a wildlife feast featuring the varied and colourful animals which inhabit the border between Africa and Europe.

programme.title: Earth in 1000 Years
programme.desc: There are signs that Earth's great stores of ice on Greenland and Antarctica are starting to melt in the wake of rising sea temperatures. Scientists are looking back at past geological ages to understand the influence of ocean currents and other factors.

programme.title: Hurricane on the Bayou
programme.desc: Hurricane on the Bayou takes viewers on a breathtaking tour of one of the most vibrant places in America, the Louisiana bayou and the city of New Orleans, a place overflowing with life, music and natural beauty.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Magic in the Air
programme.desc: Hummingbirds, the tiniest of birds, qualify as some of the toughest and most energetic creatures in the world.

programme.title: The World From Above
programme.desc: Looking down on the world from above, one might see the incredible diversity of landscapes.

programme.title: Mystery of the Nile
programme.desc: On Christmas day of 2003, Pasquale Scaturro and a team of explorers set out on an epic quest to become the first to complete a full descent of the world's greatest river, the Blue Nile and the Nile, from source to sea.

programme.title: Mystery of the Northern Lights
programme.desc: Mystery of the Northern Lights explores the greatest mysteries of the aurora borealis. Using pioneering scientific experiments, experts uncover the secrets of this awe-inspiring phenomena.

programme.title: World's Smallest Woman: Meet Jyoti
programme.desc: Twenty-six-year-old Jyoti is the smallest woman in the world.

programme.title: Long Gone Wild
programme.desc: The killer whale is once again under siege, hunted for sale into the exploding marine theme park industry. An in-depth look at the case against captivity, the Whale Sanctuary Project, and covert missions in search of orcas held captive.

programme.title: Sharks: Monster of the Media
programme.desc: Dive into the world of sharks. Coined as monsters by the media, experience these behemoth majestic creatures in their natural habitat and learn about the threat of extinction to nearly one in four shark species and why they need our help.

programme.title: Welcome to the Cave of Wonders
programme.desc: A visual documentary that strives to show a glimpse into one of the most beautiful creations on earth from its unfathomable beginning millions of years ago to what it has become today.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: Through several interlocking stories, Mysteries of the Great Lakes will take you on a journey through the greatest lake system in the world, and showcase the amazing geography, ecology, science, and history of the region.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: An Original DUCKumentary
programme.desc: There are 120 species of duck, but most of us don't know these creatures at all. Follow a wood duck family as a male and female create a bond, migrate together, nurture and protect their chicks, and head to their wintering grounds.

programme.title: Snow Monkeys
programme.desc: In the frigid valleys of Japan's Shiga Highlands, a troop of snow monkeys raise their families in a complex society where each knows their place.

programme.title: Siberian Tiger Quest
programme.desc: Chris Morgan has tracked large predators in some of the wildest and remote places on Earth. He now embarks on his greatest challenge - to find and film the Siberian tiger living wild and free in Russia's far Eastern forests.

programme.title: La Soufrière
programme.desc: Herzog takes a film crew to the island of Guadeloupe when he hears that the volcano on the island is going to erupt. Everyone has left, except for one old man who refuses to leave. Herzog catches the eeriness of an abandoned city.

programme.title: Bear-Like
programme.desc: Follow a bear-family in its struggle for survival in the harsh wilds of Alaska, witness tense scenes of conflict, and discover the untamed lives of these wild creatures.

programme.title: Solar Odyssey
programme.desc: Join an unprecedented journey into space to learn more about the Sun, a heavenly body that has a direct impact on the Earth’s spatial environment.

programme.title: Island of the Penguins
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals, and their young overcrowd the beaches.

programme.title: Desert Kings
programme.desc: In ‘Desert Kings’ we follow the story of sub-adult Kalahari lions. This is a story of fighting for survival, death and hope. Who will survive the next two summers?

programme.title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Bees
programme.desc: The future of our food resources depends on the western honey bee. One third of our food supply depends directly on pollination from bees. This is the story of a worldwide ecological disaster that has been waiting to happen for several generations.

programme.title: Cyborgs: Human Machines
programme.desc: Technology has improved our lives in so many ways. Trans-humanists are fusing their bodies with digital implants to increase their abilities and expand their senses. How is life going to change for us all if some people have supernatural powers?

programme.title: Azure Dust: Inside Chernobyl's Exclusion Zone
programme.desc: The Exclusion Zone - a 1,000 square mile area around the site of the Ukraine 1986 nuclear power plant meltdown. Take a tour of the radiation zone and meet people who live and work in the shadow of the worst man-made environmental disaster in history.

programme.title: Wild Ocean
programme.desc: Plunge into an underwater feeding frenzy, an epic struggle for survival where whales, sharks, dolphins, seals, gannets and billions of fish collide with mankind during one of nature's greatest migration spectacles.

programme.title: To Be First: The Quest For Yangmolong
programme.desc: Follow a climbing expedition as they make three attempts to summit one of the last unclimbed peaks on earth.

programme.title: Fukushima: Robots in Hell
programme.desc: On the 11th of March 20t11, an earthquake and a tsunami led to to the most serious nuclear accident of the century. On the heels of explosions, radioactivity levels reached record highs.

programme.title: A Taste Of Whale
programme.desc: It is the 'Grind' season again - Faroe Islanders' ritual slaughter of pilot whales. Two proud whalers are on one side, two young and passionate Sea Shepherd activists on the other. A Taste of Whale invites you to see what meat-eating is truly about.

programme.title: It's Quieter in the Twilight
programme.desc: Fighting outdated technology and time, Voyager's flight-team pursues humankind's greatest exploration.

programme.title: Sharks, Scavengers of the Seas
programme.desc: Before being an earthly paradise with enchanting colours, the lagoon of New Caledonia is above all a paradise for sharks. But not just any sharks: they are used to being considered as fearsome predators, they are essentially opportunistic scavengers.

programme.title: Apollo 16: The Men, The Moon
programme.desc: After 25 years the untold human side of the Apollo 16 moon mission is now made available to the public, as the crew members finally reveal their riveting experience.

programme.title: Birth of Speed
programme.desc: Two mature and experienced Cheetahs are both raising cubs. The only difference is their age. ‘The Birth of Speed’ follows them on their challenge of raising cubs in this unexpected landscape.

programme.title: New Life: Born to Hunt
programme.desc: Baby animals beguile with their innocent charm. But while some remain harmless, others have a deep-rooted instinct. It may take weeks or months of training to hone their skills, but in every corner of the globe predators emerge.

programme.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Six million metric tons of plastic wind up in the world's ocean every year. Unlike other refuse, plastic can stay in the water forever without breaking down. How is this deadly killer affecting the world's oceans, and how will it affect humanity?

programme.title: Sight: The Story Of Vision
programme.desc: An in depth look at the science, medicine, and technology of vision and individuals who are battling blindness. Narrated by Elton John.

programme.title: Oasis Earth
programme.desc: Ever imagine what it feels like to look at Earth from space? Join the crew of the space shuttle Endeavour and take a thrilling journey to experience the beauty in awesome High Definition of our planet from 150 miles above Earth.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Embark on a journey through the depths of the ocean, the beautiful savannah and the majestic forest to discover amazing creatures and the characteristics they have developed to evolve and adapt to their environment.

programme.title: Atlas of a Changing Earth
programme.desc: This award-winning MagellanTV original explores alarming changes to Earth's features and climate and reveals a vision of slowing environmental change.

programme.title: Leave it to Beavers
programme.desc: The fascinating story of beavers in North America - their history, near extinction, and current comeback, as conservationists regard beavers as overlooked tools when it comes to reversing the effects of global warming and water shortages.

programme.title: Flight of the Aquanaut
programme.desc: Flight of the Aquanaut is set against startling undersea vistas and tells a gripping tale of a diver's voyage into danger. Equipped with a self-propelled, one-atmosphere "hard suit," the aquanaut sweeps viewers along on a dramatic science adventure.

programme.title: Malaria: The Serial Killer
programme.desc: Even in this age of modern medicine, malaria kills twice as many people as AIDS. Despite this vast death count, progress in the fight against this disease is marked with relative indifference. Why is this?

programme.title: N.E.D: No Evidence of Disease
programme.desc: Six cancer surgeons inspire hope and a fighting spirit in their patients by blending medicine with music in a rock band.

programme.title: planet e.: Operation Earth Climate
programme.desc: Humankind is heating up the planet. In nature, volcanoes can create cooling blankets. Should we copy something like that artificially and cool the climate with technology?

programme.title: Guy Martin: Last Flight of the Vulcan Bomber
programme.desc: British TV host Guy Martin helps restore the last airworthy Avro Vulcan bomber to prepare it for a 1,000-mile farewell tour of Great Britain.

programme.title: Rainman Twins
programme.desc: This is the untold story of the only identical twin autistic savant sisters known to exist. Over a span of 50 years, Flo and Kay have memorized the world around them. You’ll never forget them…and they’ll never forget you.

programme.title: Super Hummingbirds
programme.desc: With high-speed camerawork and breakthrough science, we enter the world of hummingbirds. Their lives move faster than the eye can see, and they possess superpowers that enable them to fly backwards, upside-down, and float in mid-air.

programme.title: The Living Sea
programme.desc: From the tropical waters of Palau in the South Pacific, to the barreling waves of Oahu's North Shore and Nova Scotia's major tidal swings, The Living Sea celebrates the beauty, power and importance of the ocean.

programme.title: The New Fire
programme.desc: Nuclear engineers are developing next-generation reactors, which they hope will provide clean and safe solutions for the world's future energy needs.

programme.title: The Voyage of Curiosity
programme.desc: Its goal is to find out whether life could have existed on Mars, and whether the planet is safe enough for humans. For NASA scientists, landing on Mars required technologies never before used. Curiosity's journey was going to be complicated and dangerous.

programme.title: The Angel's Secret
programme.desc: Many know its name; few have seen it. Once present throughout Europe, the angel shark is now critically endangered and finds itself struggling off the coast of the Canary Islands. As unique as it is extraordinary, this species is full of secrets...

programme.title: Conquest of Everest Revisited 1952-2003
programme.desc: This documentary covers the famous and successful expedition of the Everest conquest by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary, the first climbers to reach its peak.

programme.title: Elite Formations: The Story of the Red Arrows
programme.desc: Explore the beginnings of powered flight and the exponential development during the 20th century of precision engineering, lighting speed and human ingenuity.

programme.title: Bowling for Columbine
programme.desc: Michael Moore's "Bowling For Columbine" takes a somewhat humorous and oft-times serious look at firearms abuse in the U.S. Moore sets out to discover why Americans are so obsessed with their guns, which time and time again lead to violence.

programme.title: Is the Man Who Is Tall Happy?
programme.desc: From the director of Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind comes this series of brilliant animated interviews with legendary linguist, philosopher and activist Noam Chomsky.

programme.title: The Youth Governor
programme.desc: The Youth Governor is the story of the candidacy, campaign, and election of the 72nd California Youth Governor.

programme.title: Sicko
programme.desc: Documentary from Michael Moore exploring the profit-based healthcare system in the US, and how it fares against its counterparts in Canada, the UK, and France where medical care is free.

programme.title: The Times Of Harvey Milk
programme.desc: A documentary of the successful career and assassination of San Francisco's first elected gay city supervisor.

programme.title: Baader Meinhof Komplex
programme.desc: A look at Germany's terrorist group, The Red Army Faction (RAF), which organized bombings, robberies, kidnappings, and assassinations in the late 1960s and '70s.

programme.title: The World According to Amazon
programme.desc: An investigation into the workings of Amazon and its philosophy through insider interviews with business owners, employees and a former founding executive, to reveal the sky-high ambitions of the company run by the world’s first centi-billionaire.

programme.title: The Wobblies
programme.desc: Founded in 1905, the Industrial Workers of the World, known as the Wobblies, organized workers to demand fair pay, safer conditions, and rights, in a story that still resonates with today's battles against corporate greed.

programme.title: In the Crosshairs: The Killing That Changed America
programme.desc: Black Panthers leader Huey Newton is charged in the Capital Crime of murdering a white cop. Will systemic racism in the judicial system prevent him from getting a fair trial? The shocking verdict becomes a Landmark Case.

programme.title: The Brink
programme.desc: Reckless police inspector Tung (Zhang Jin) is on a mission to crack down on criminal Shing's (Shawn Yue) gold smuggling scheme, yet fails to arrest him. As Tung continues his manhunt, he discovers Shing's involvement with triad boss Blackie (Yasuaki Kurata), who hides on a casino cruise ship on the high seas. Shing has been involved in a power struggle within the smuggling ring, and is forced to kill his adopted father. He also loses his share of gold smuggling to Blackie. To get even, Shing appears on the cruise, while Tung is there to hunt for him.

programme.title: How to Survive a Plague
programme.desc: Journalist-turned-filmmaker David France unveils the courageous story of the activists and scientists who fought to stop HIV from becoming a death sentence.

programme.title: No End In Sight
programme.desc: A comprehensive look at the Bush Administration's conduct of the Iraq war and its occupation of the country.

programme.title: The Reagan Show
programme.desc: Told solely through archival footage and set against the backdrop of the Cold War, THE REAGAN SHOW presents the pageantry, absurdity and charisma of a prolific actor's defining role: Leader of the Free World.

programme.title: The 44th President: In His Own Words
programme.desc: Comprised of two interviews with President Barack Obama conducted both before and after the 2016 Presidential election, The 44th President: In His Own Words is the President's first-hand account of his time in office.

programme.title: Nationtime
programme.desc: Narrated by Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte, "Nationtime" is a report on the National Black Political Convention held in Gary, Indiana in 1972.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 9/11
programme.desc: An expose which reflects upon what has happened to America since the events of September 11, 2001 touches upon the personal relationship between President George W. Bush and the family of terrorist Osama bin Laden.

programme.title: The Panama Papers
programme.desc: An explosive, global story, with immediate and ongoing consequences that strikes at the heart of the biggest themes of our times; income inequality, whistleblowers, and corrupt power-brokers manipulating world governments and big business.

programme.title: The Man Who Saved The World
programme.desc: The Man Who Saved the World tells the gripping true story of Stanislav Petrov - a man who single-handedly averted a fullscale nuclear world war but now struggles to get his life back on track… before it is too late.

programme.title: Taxi To The Dark Side
programme.desc: Alex Gibney exposes the haunting details of the USA's torture and interrogation practices during the War in Afghanistan.

programme.title: The Plot Against America
programme.desc: The special looks beyond the headlines and goes into the heart of our country to ask the question, is America safe?

programme.title: In the Name of Democracy
programme.desc: A feature documentary about the remarkable case of Lt. Ehren Watada, the first officer in the U.S. Army to refuse to deploy to Iraq on moral grounds. The film delves into the lead up to and U.S. entry into the Iraq war, and features Lt. Watada, his par...

programme.title: Rigged: The Voter Suppression Playbook
programme.desc: America's democracy is threatened. Narrated by Jeffrey Wright, Rigged tells the story of how the principle of "one person, one vote" is being compromised, and how American citizens are fighting back.

programme.title: Use of Force: The Policing of Black America
programme.desc: A documentary that delves into the fatal encounters between police and people of color in America.

programme.title: Destierros
programme.desc: Border mechanisms that act on migrants are multiple. From shelter to shelter, boarding on trains, migrants aim up north across Mexico to reach the United States and Canada.

programme.title: The Fight
programme.desc: Inside the ACLU, five scrappy lawyers battle against the Trump administrationís historic assault on civil liberties ñ from separating families at the border, to rolling back transgender, reproductive, and voting rights.

programme.title: Free Angela and All Political Prisoners
programme.desc: The dramatic true story of college professor Angela Davis and how her social activism implicated her in a botched kidnapping attempt, landing her on the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted list.

programme.title: Desert One
programme.desc: Using new archival sources and unprecedented access, documentarian Barbara Kopple reveals the story behind one of the most daring rescues in modern US history: a secret mission to free hostages of the 1979 Iranian revolution.

programme.title: Lost In America
programme.desc: The world's wealthiest country has 4.2 million homeless teenagers. Director Rotimi Rainwater along with the help of celebrities and politicians who have been homeless themselves, take a large scale issue down to a very personal level.

programme.title: The Man Who Drove with Mandela
programme.desc: How did South Africa come to be the first country in the world to embody LGBT rights in their post-apartheid Constitution? It was in large part due to the unsung hero Cecil Williams, whose moving life story is told in the feature documentary.

programme.title: Safeguard: An Electoral College Story
programme.desc: A nonpartisan documentary exploring how the U.S. Electoral College works, what could change, and how democracy can balance majority rule with minority rights.

programme.title: The Creepy Line
programme.desc: A behind the scenes look at free media services, like Google and Facebook, whose manipulative effects are undermining democracy with user's free will.

programme.title: Gabby Giffords Won't Back Down
programme.desc: The extraordinary story of former Arizona Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, her relentless fight to recover following an assassination attempt in 2011, and her new life as one of the most effective activists in the battle for gun violence prevention.

programme.desc: Take a look at two of the most hard hitting battles of the second world war in the pacific.Hear from some of the veterans that served their country and the horror stories they lived through during the battles in Okinawa and Guadalcanal.

programme.title: Remember Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: The personal stories of veterans and citizens who witnessed the attack on the American Pacific Fleet in Pearl Harbor on Dec. 7, 1941.

programme.title: Perfect 36: When Women Won the Vote
programme.desc: A chronicle of the debate about women's suffrage in the U.S., and the dramatic vote in 1920, which ratified the 19th amendment.

programme.title: World of Tanks and Commanders
programme.desc: This documentary follows the tank's evolution from WWI to the present, emphasizing the remarkable Tank Commanders and their pivotal role.

programme.title: D-Day - 80th Anniversary
programme.desc: In 1944, Operation Overlord, liberated France and Western Europe in D-Day. A new documentary explores this pivotal event.

programme.title: Dick Winters: Hang Tough
programme.desc: Honor one of World War 2's most respected combat leaders, Major Richard D. Winters of Easy Company, taking a look at his life and career.

programme.title: Johnstown Flood
programme.desc: Here is the story of the tragic 1889 disaster which claimed more than 2,200 lives. Pennsylvania's South Fork Dam exploded and unleashed a 40-foot wall of water. The flood devastated the valley below under the force of a 20-million-ton tidal wave.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Hour by Hour
programme.desc: The accident at Chernobyl released at least 100 times more radiation than the atomic bombs dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. An incalculable number of Europeans still hold the scars from what happened that disastrous night in Chernobyl.

programme.title: Silent Wings - The American Glider Pilots of WWII
programme.desc: Silent Wings - The American Glider Pilots of WWII reveals the critical role gliders played in World War II offensives. Thousands of lives were saved and battles won because of their efforts. This film features gliders from both sides of the battle.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Irish pilot Brendan "Paddy" Finucane, at 21, became the youngest Wing Commander in the RAF, a celebrated World War II fighter ace.

programme.title: Gettysburg: The Final Measure of Devotion
programme.desc: The Battle of Gettysburg is considered a major turning point in the Civil War. This film explores Abraham Lincoln's role as commander in chief and Lee's invasion of the North. Battle sequences are from The 150th Gettysburg Anniversary Reenactment.

programme.title: A Century in the Sky
programme.desc: On the 17th December 1903 the Wright brothers changed the world forever - Kitty Hawk in North Carolina was the location for the first powered flight, ushering in a Century in the Sky, shaping and transforming all aspects of modern life.

programme.title: Martin Luther King Jr: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: He was an extraordinary leader, with vision and ambition. He would fight tirelessly until his last days against injustice. By fighting for his dreams and against injustice, he powerfully impacted generations and he changed the world.

programme.title: They Survived Together
programme.desc: A 2022 EMMY WINNER. The true story of the Neiger family's miraculous escape from certain death by the Nazis during World War II.

programme.title: Pistol Packin' Mama: The Missions Of A B-17
programme.desc: 5 crew members of Betty Boop/Pistol Packin' Mama relate what it was like in the grim early days of daylight bombing. Members of the 390th Bomb Group, they led their squadron and sometimes the entire 8th Air Force into action.

programme.title: Urartu: The Forgotten Kingdom
programme.desc: Urartu is one of the most mysterious states in the history of the ancient world. This documentary will help us recollect its history and to get acquainted with its unique background and developed culture, economy, astronomy and religious life.

programme.title: Death from Above: Air Combat Vietnam War
programme.desc: Decades after it ended the Vietnam War might seem like a remote affair. In fact it was an enormous conflict, the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious.

programme.title: Loreto: The Mystery of The Holy House
programme.desc: A documentary investigation into one of the most fascinating mysteries of Christianity. How was the Holy House of the Virgin Mary transported from its original location in Nazareth, Palestine, to the town of Loreto on Italy's Adriatic coast?

programme.title: War at Sea: Naval Aviation
programme.desc: The idea of uniting the aircraft and the ship is a simple one but this simple idea has been the subject of great technical innovation, has led to decisive military success, and has found itself the focus of increasing controversy.

programme.title: London Under Nazi Siege: WWII Britain
programme.desc: At the height of the second world war the Nazis knew that the British were their fiercest enemy. They had tried to capture Britain by land and sea but decided that it was by sky that they would make send their evil message.

programme.title: Alone Across The Arctic
programme.desc: Acclaimed explorer Adam Shoalts brings a canoe, his full repertoire of wilderness survival skills on an extraordinary trek across approximately 4,000 kilometres of the remote North. The intrepid Shoalts aims to cross the breadth of the northernmost wilds

programme.title: Hidden Turkey
programme.desc: Hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg, Hidden Turkey allows the audience to immerse themselves in Turkey's evolving story and enduring culture. Among the locations visited: Istanbul, Cappadocia, Antakya, Antalya and Laodicea.

programme.title: Hidden Canary Islands
programme.desc: Hidden Canary Islands is a one-hour television special hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg, exploring all eight Spanish islands: El Hierro, Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria, La Gomera, La Graciosa, Lanzarote, La Palma, and Tenerife.

programme.title: Hidden Poland
programme.desc: This one-hour special hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg gives viewers a look at Poland's enduring culture. Watch Peter take a hot air balloon ride over the 13th century Czocha Castle and glide across the Tatra Mountains.

programme.title: Ancient Angkor
programme.desc: Join us as we venture through the jungles of Cambodia to bring face to face with the cryptic mysteries of the temples of Angkor Wat.

programme.title: Chaos On The Bridge
programme.desc: Acting legend William Shatner takes viewers inside the creation of Star Trek: The Next Generation, the bold attempt in 1986 to recreate the success of the original television series, in which Shatner played Captain James T. Kirk.

programme.title: Get A Life!
programme.desc: Directed by William Shatner, based on his hugely popular book, in which he examines the cultural phenomena of Star Trek, its fan-following, and his own role within it.

programme.title: The Captains
programme.desc: The original Captain Kirk, William Shatner, travels around the globe to interview the elite group of actors (Patrick Stewart, Chris Pine, Scott Bakula, Avery Brooks and more) who have portrayed the role of Enterprise Captain.

programme.title: What We Left Behind: Looking Back at Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Ira Steven Behr explores the legacy of Star Trek: Deep Space Nine (1993).

programme.title: Beam Me Up, Sulu
programme.desc: In 1985, Star Trek's George Takei joins fans to make a student film, revealing the kindness, diversity and inclusion at the show's core.

programme.title: Man vs Snake
programme.desc: A middle-aged man, Tim McVey, attempts to reclaim his 1984 world record on Nibbler, the first billion-point video game.

programme.title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
programme.desc: Robert Englund has become one of the most revolutionary horror icons of our generation. This intimate portrait captures the man behind the NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET franchise and features interviews with Englund, Lin Shaye, Eli Roth, Tony Todd and more.

programme.title: Room 237
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's classic film, 'The Shining,' gets a riveting and in-depth exploration of its hidden meanings, dazzling puzzles, and even conspiracy theories.

programme.title: Lost Soul: The Doomed Journey of Richard Stanley's Island of Dr. Moreau
programme.desc: The filming of the ill-fated 1996 THE ISLAND OF DR. MOREAU is a sensational story of what could have been a science fiction masterpiece but which became a huge creative and financial disaster; the story of the outsider artist versus Hollywood machine.

programme.title: Bruce Lee, The Legend
programme.desc: The official Golden Harvest tribute to the Master of the Martial Arts Film, Bruce Lee.

programme.title: His Name Was Jason
programme.desc: Jason Voorhees has carved his place into American pop culture and is one of the most recognizable cinematic killers in horror history. Now see how it all happened!

programme.title: Skin: A History of Nudity in the Movies
programme.desc: A film on the history of nudity in movies examining the changes in morality that led to the use of nudity in films while emphasizing the political, sociological and artistic changes that shaped this rich history.

programme.title: Filmworker
programme.desc: Leon Vitali gave up his acting career to toil in obscurity as Stanley Kubrick's devoted aide-de-camp. A singular perspective on the creative genius.

programme.title: Film, The Living Record of Our Memory
programme.desc: This documentary argues for the importance of film preservation through the voices of archivists, curators, technicians, and filmmakers.

programme.title: Fiddler's Journey to the Big Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Jeff Goldblum, "Fiddler's Journey to the Big Screen" explores Norman Jewison's quest to recreate Jewish life in Tsarist Russia and transform the beloved stage hit into a wide-screen cinematic epic.

programme.title: Marc Jacobs & Louis Vuitton
programme.desc: An A-list of luminaries celebrate the designer behind the Louis Vuitton brand, which dominates the world's fashion scene: the exceptional Marc Jacobs.

programme.title: The YouTube Effect
programme.desc: In this eye-opening documentary, Alex Winter presents a thoughtful, troubling look at YouTube, a site with humble origins that has gone on to change how we experience the world.

programme.title: Game Changers
programme.desc: As Jeopardy marks its 50th anniversary, including 30 years with Alex Trebek, take a look at the phenomenon of game shows, the iconic hosts and personalities, the contestants and the triumphs and controversies.

programme.title: Scream, Queen! My Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: Actor Mark Patton shares his story of being a closeted gay man while starring in "A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge."

programme.title: The Jeff Koons Show
programme.desc: Former stockbroker Jeff Koons set out to be the world's greatest living artist. Alison Chernick's documentary explores his dazzling career, celebrity status, and the phenomenon of Koons through interviews, insights, and his own bold declarations.

programme.title: When the Beat Drops
programme.desc: Drop into the electric and subversive underground dance scene known as bucking, boldly pioneered in the clubs of the Deep South.

programme.title: GLOW: The Story of the Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling
programme.desc: This heartfelt documentary chronicles the rise and fall of the first-ever all-female pro-wrestling show through the stories of those who lived it.

programme.title: Afternoon of a Faun: Tanaquil Le Clercq
programme.desc: A mesmerizing portrait of legendary ballerina Tanaquil Le Clercq, muse to George Balanchine and Jerome Robbins, whose career was cut short by polio.

programme.title: Love, Gilda
programme.desc: In her own words, comedienne Gilda Radner looks back and reflects on her life and career.

programme.title: We Can Be Heroes
programme.desc: A group of neurodivergent, queer, and self-proclaimed "nerdy" teenagers find a special space for self-discovery at a live action role-play (LARP) summer camp in upstate New York. From Tribeca Films.

programme.title: Code of the Freaks
programme.desc: In an unprecedented look inside the disabled community, “Code of the Freaks” gives the mic to some of Hollywood's most incensed and ignored critics.

programme.title: By Sidney Lumet
programme.desc: In a never-before-seen interview filmed in 2008, legendary filmmaker Sidney Lumet discusses his life & career.

programme.title: Best Worst Movie
programme.desc: Years after the making of TROLL 2, the film's grown-up child star pays a hilarious, offbeat homage to lovers of bad movies and the people that make them.

programme.title: Running Off to the Circus: Paul Auster on Film
programme.desc: A career-spanning feature-length interview with legendary author and director Paul Auster.

programme.title: Love, Antosha
programme.desc: A portrait of late actor Anton Yelchin, 'Love, Antosha' explores his successes and struggles through his journals, photography, original music, and interviews with his colleagues, including Chris Pine, Kristen Stewart, and Jennifer Lawrence.

programme.title: Bruce Lee: The Way of the Warrior
programme.desc: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend.

programme.title: Misery Loves Comedy

programme.title: Z Channel: A Magnificent Obsession
programme.desc: Xan Cassavetes' film explores the euphoric rise and tragic descent of Z Channel, Los Angeles’ first pay cable service and its virtuosic film programmer Jerry Harvey.

programme.title: Can You Bring It Bill T. Jones and D-Man in the Waters
programme.desc: "Can You Bring It" follows the creation of Bill T. Jones's tour de force ballet D-Man in the Waters, a landmark of the AIDS crisis.

programme.title: Dave Stevens: Drawn To Perfection
programme.desc: Dave Stevens made The Rocketeer and reintroduced the world to 50's pin-up model Bettie Page. While creating his unique corner of importance in comic book and illustration art, he showed the world what it's like to pursue the life of a creative individual.

programme.desc: Set in Uganda, two unlikely friends from opposite sides of the world come together over a love for Chuck Norris. With sheer determination, they team up to create their own explosive movies, catapulting Wakaliwood to worldwide stardom.

programme.title: Daughters of the Sexual Revolution: The Untold Story of the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
programme.desc: The behind-the-scenes story of how the original Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders became a controversial pop culture phenomenon at the height of the Sexual Revolution.

programme.title: Long, Lonesome Highway: The Story Of Michael Parks
programme.desc: Long Lonesome Highway is the story of the greatest performer that you've likely never heard of.

programme.title: Fiddler: Miracle Of Miracles
programme.desc: Fiddler is the first in-depth documentary film that chronicles the life and themes of this iconic offering of American culture.

programme.title: Cosplay Universe
programme.desc: Cosplay Universe follows the journey of the world's top cosplayers while addressing the psychology behind this transformative art form.

programme.title: Roger Corman: The Pope of Pop Cinema
programme.desc: The king of B-movies tells his story through his impressive filmography and explores the roots of pop culture.

programme.title: Street Gang: How We Got to Sesame Street

programme.title: Princess Grace Of Monaco
programme.desc: Grace Kelly's transformation from Hollywood star to Monaco's princess, breaking royal barriers.

programme.title: On Broadway

programme.title: In the Footsteps of Christian Louboutin
programme.desc: This film opens the doors to the work of a unique creator always on the move. He reveals himself as a free and passionate alchemist who imagines shoes as real works of art.

programme.title: Cats of Malta

programme.title: George: The Story of George Maciunas & Fluxus

programme.title: The Queen (1968)

programme.title: The DUST Files: Black Voices in Sci-Fi

programme.title: Desert Racer: The Official Authorized Documentary
programme.desc: Documentary explores Steve McQueen's motorcycle racing passion, featuring son Chad's recreation of his Desert Racer bike. Narrated by Charley Boorman.

programme.title: Building a Decade: Minecraft

programme.title: Being Canadian

programme.title: Andy Warhol's Factory People: Inside The Sixties Silver Factory
programme.desc: Andy Warhol's aluminum foil-covered Silver Factory becomes the hot bed of avant-garde creativity in Sixties New York City.

programme.title: Wordplay
programme.desc: Filmmaker Patrick Creadon pays tribute to crossword puzzles with this in-depth look at The New York Times' long-time crossword puzzle editor Will Shortz and his loyal fan base.

programme.title: Banksy Most Wanted
programme.desc: An in depth look into one of the art world's biggest unanswered mysteries -- who is Banksy?

programme.title: Murder Rap: Inside The Biggie and Tupac Murders
programme.desc: The inside story behind the Biggie and Tupac murder investigations is laid bare using police case files, taped confessions never before shown on film.

programme.title: We Kill For Love
programme.desc: We Kill for Love goes in search of the forgotten world of the direct-to-video erotic thriller, a genre that once dominated late night TV and video stores and revealing the heart and soul of a forgotten and often maligned film movement.

programme.title: American Homeboy
programme.desc: Pachuco and cholo culture sprouted from American soil in response to wartime sentiment, social alienation, and government discrimination only to become a pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Stealing Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Shortly after Charlie Chaplin's death, his body disappeared from its grave. After being left initially with no clues - only outrageous rumors - the robbers finally made contact with the family and started a tense, but often comedic game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Love the Beast
programme.desc: Eric Bana casts himself in his perfect role: exploring the meaning of a 25-year-long relationship with his first car, The Beast.

programme.title: The 50 Best Horror Movies You've Never Seen
programme.desc: Fifty lesser-known horror flicks hailed by critics and genre fans as "absolute must-sees" are given the spotlight with fun, engaging commentary from journalists, directors, actors and critics in a countdown like no other. Stalkers, monsters, slashers, ...

programme.title: The Iron Sheik - The Maim Event
programme.desc: The story of one hot night in Alabama as an Independent Pro Wrestling Show rolls into town with its cast of high flying characters in faded tights.

programme.title: William & Kate: The First 40 Years
programme.desc: Explore William and Kate's journey from their meeting in 2001 to becoming a respected royal couple.

programme.title: Dior and I
programme.desc: Dior and I brings the viewer inside the storied world of the Christian Dior fashion house with a privileged, behind-the-scenes look at the creation of Raf Simons’ first haute couture collection as its new artistic director.

programme.title: Truman & Tennessee
programme.desc: This documentary explores Truman Capote and Tennessee Williams' lives, work, and friendship, blending archival footage, iconic film clips, and voiceovers by Jim Parsons and Zachary Quinto to celebrate their art, wit, and lasting cultural impact.

programme.title: Be Natural: The Untold Story of Alice Guy-Blaché
programme.desc: This documentary rewrites film history, revealing for the first time the full life and work of cinema's first female pioneer Alice Guy-Blaché.

programme.title: In Search of Dracula
programme.desc: Christopher Lee traces the roots of the Dracula legend back to their horrifying historical origins.

programme.title: Born to Fly: Elizabeth Streb vs. Gravity
programme.desc: Trace the evolution of Elizabeth Streb's movement philosophy as she pushes herself and her performers from the ground to the sky.

programme.title: Body Parts
programme.desc: An examination of how the nude female body is hypersexualized, under attack, and exploited on- and offscreen in Hollywood.

programme.title: Walking on Water
programme.desc: Christo, the world's biggest installation artist, sets out to realize “The Floating Piers," a dahlia-yellow walkway atop Italy's Lake Iseo.

programme.title: 102 Minutes That Changed America
programme.desc: Discover rarely seen and heard archives that document the 102 minutes between the first attack on the World Trade Center to the collapse of the second tower.

programme.title: 15 Septembers Later
programme.desc: Featuring interviews with key political figures including President George W Bush, Vice President Dick Cheney, Donald Rumsfeld, Rudolph Giuliani, Michael Bloomberg, and media heavy hitters Dan Rather, Tom Brokaw, Matt Lauer and Matthew Broderick.

programme.title: Harriet Tubman: They Called Her Moses
programme.desc: This compelling documentary narrated by Alfrelynn Roberts features expert interviews with leading scholars.

programme.title: Calamity Jane: Legend of the West
programme.desc: From the Great Plains of the American West to the Rocky Mountains, from Apache Reservations to the suburbs of Deadwood, she could be seen bringing up the rear in convoys of pioneers or riding with desperados. Meet Martha Canary, alias Calamity Jane.

programme.title: The Alamo: A True Story of Courage
programme.desc: On March 6, 1836 the 13-day siege of the Alamo ended. Among the dead were three men destined to become martyrs and heroes: David Crockett, James Bowie and William B. Travis. Though considered a "small affair" at the time by victorious Mexican commander...

programme.title: The Passions of Howard Hughes
programme.desc: Howard was business, but not all business... The Passions of Howard Hughes is a fascinating look at how power, possessions, and personality created a lifetime of passionate affairs with the most desirable women in the world.

programme.title: America and Lewis Hine
programme.desc: America and Lewis Hine is an award-winning documentary narrated by Jason Robards, Jr. and Maureen Stapleton, which portrays the life and times of America’s pioneer social photographer, Lewis Hine, who recorded the development of industrial America.

programme.title: Expo - Magic of the White City
programme.desc: Narrated by Gene Wilder, "Expo - Magic of the White City" immerses viewers in one of the most unforgettable events in American history, the Chicago World's Fair of 1893.

programme.title: The Ringling Bros: Kings of the Circus
programme.desc: Their story is as amazing as the circus itself - how five poor boys from Baraboo, Wisconsin became "kings of the circus... when the circus was king."

programme.title: Nixon in the Den

programme.title: Rise and Fall: The World Trade Center
programme.desc: Through a unique architectural and engineering lens, this special takes a chronological look at the conception, construction and destruction of the World Trade Center towers.

programme.title: 13 Seconds: The Kent State Shootings

programme.title: Civil War: Left for Dead
programme.desc: The inspiring stories of two courageous Union soldiers who command troops in many of the deadliest battles of the Civil War, reenacted. Pain, destruction and suffering cannot conquer the infallible war hero Oscar Jackson in "Left for Dead."

programme.title: Underground Railroad: The William Still Story
programme.desc: William Still was one of the most important, yet largely unheralded heroes of the Underground Railroad. Still was determined to get as many runaways as he could to "Freedom's Land," smuggling them across the US border to Canada.

programme.title: 9/11: Four Flights
programme.desc: Four flights--American 11, United 175, American 77, and United 93--took off the morning of September 11, 2001 unaware of the life-changing events to follow and fate that would forever intertwine them.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis: The Legacy
programme.desc: Experience this groundbreaking film, the story of the greatest sea disaster in U.S. Navy History, told for the first time by only the men who lived it.

programme.title: Proudly We Served: The Men of the USS Mason
programme.desc: This is the thrilling true story of the USS Mason and its crew, the only African-American sailors to take a U.S. Navy warship into battle during World War II. They challenged the segregation of the U.S. Military, fought the Nazi U-boats, and won.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down: The Untold Story

programme.title: Flying Fortress: History of the B-17 Bomber

programme.title: Agents Unknown

John Murphy, then an elite adviser, analyst, and operative for the Army, CIA, and South Vietnamese intelligence services, reveals the gray areas of critical on-the-ground intelligence work, where trust is hard-won and easily lost.

programme.title: America's Secret War
programme.desc: Uncover the history of secret military operations waged by the CIA in Laos during the Vietnam War to stop the spread of communism.

programme.title: Forgotten Heroes: The Robert Hartsock Story

programme.title: Portraits From Ground Zero
programme.desc: A firefighter searching for the body of his life-long friend; a teenage girl mourning her stepfather; a Franciscan friar ministering to the dead.

programme.title: 9/11: Inside Air Force One

programme.title: America in World War II

programme.title: The First Ladies: Jackie Kennedy
programme.desc: Jacqueline Kennedy became America's First Lady in 1961, admired for her style and intellect, becoming an icon.

programme.title: The Jewish Journey: America
programme.desc: The Jewish Journey: America explores what it meant to be part of a tight-knit Jewish community and make the heartbreaking choice to leave family behind, whether for economic opportunity or to escape persecution.

programme.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
programme.desc: From 1955 to 1975 the war in Vietnam was unprecedented and relentless. It was like no war ever fought before. This was a new kind of warfare and for once the US was out of its depth. In this documentary, we take an intimate look at Nam.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Murder Mines and Mayhem
programme.desc: The enemy in Vietnam was known as "Charlie." Strategy was "bold, tough and crafty." Preferring to avoid open conflict and fight from ambush or infiltrate civilian populations whilst spreading confusion and terror by murder, mines and mayhem.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Unaccompanied, Unarmed and Unafraid
programme.desc: As troops on the ground took part in armed combat it is said that the aviators had one of the riskiest jobs. These planes flew over combat targets acting as the eyes of the army. It was the perilous job of flying over the most hostile territories.

programme.title: King of Kings: Chasing Edward Jones
programme.desc: A European filmmaker searches for the truth about her grandfather, the most famous Policy Kings of all times, who rose to the heights of financial and political prominence in Chicago in the 30s and 40S, despite discrimination.

programme.title: Never Surrender: The Ed Ramsey Story
programme.desc: A story of heroism, and reconciliation. Lt. Edwin P. Ramsey made history as the last mounted horse cavalry charge in U.S. military history. Refusing to surrender, he joined the Filipino resistance and commanded 40,000 guerilla warriors.

programme.title: Westinghouse: An American Icon
programme.desc: This feature documentary is a biography of America's greatest industrialist, George Westinghouse.

programme.title: The Wheelchair President

programme.title: Betrayed: Surviving an American Concentration Camp

programme.title: War on Witches

programme.title: JFK: The Ultimate Conspiracy

programme.title: JFK's Women: The Scandals Revealed
programme.desc: John F. Kennedy, the charismatic president. However, with all that charm came a hidden life of reckless sexual adventure. He had a confirmed affair with Marilyn Monroe, and at least five of his endeavors posed a potential threat to national security.

Both were directed by Ray Kellogg, a special effects specialist and second unit director who would eventually work on some of Hollywood's biggest pictures, including Cleopatra and The Green Berets. In 1959, though, it was all about Gila monsters and revved up teens. If there's a schlock Hall of Fame, this one deserves its own wing!

programme.title: Georgia Rule

programme.title: Grizzly Man

programme.title: Generation 9/11

programme.title: Stolen Seas

programme.title: The Sheik
programme.desc: THE SHEIK is the amazingly entertaining story of the man that lived the American Dream by assuming the persona of the supreme villain. Filmed extensively between 2006 until 2013. This is a touching story about the unlikely revival of a former wrestling...

programme.title: Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief

programme.title: Canary

programme.title: Mister Organ

programme.title: Burn

programme.title: Jesus Camp
programme.desc: The youngest foot soldiers for the Lord are shown in their native environment in this documentary.

programme.title: In Balanchine's Classroom

programme.title: In Case of Emergency

programme.title: Born to Be

programme.title: The Life And Death Of Patient Zero
programme.desc: In 1980s, Gaetan Dugas contracted what was termed gay cancer. He was demonized for his promiscuity

programme.title: Blind Ambition
programme.desc: Four Zimbabwean men form their country's first Wine Tasting Olympics team.

programme.title: Samsara

programme.title: Mission: JOY Finding Happiness in Troubled Times

programme.title: The World Before Your Feet
programme.desc: Matt Green has been walking every block of every street in New York City.

programme.title: The Real Top Guns

programme.title: Logan's Syndrome

programme.title: Up Heartbreak Hill

programme.title: After the Murder of Albert Lima

programme.title: 17 And Life Doesn't Wait

programme.title: The Village Detective: a song cycle

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Paper Route

programme.title: The Mole Agent

programme.title: Touching the Void

programme.title: Top Gear: The Worst Car in the History of the World: Special

programme.title: The Bad Nun

programme.title: Hush

programme.title: Til Death Do Us Part

programme.title: American Horror House

programme.title: Hellmouth
programme.desc: From the twisted mind of writer Tony Burgess comes a stunning, spectacular ode to classic horror and fantasy.

programme.title: Hansel vs. Gretel

programme.title: Heir of the Witch

programme.title: Cheat

programme.title: The Eden Theory

programme.title: The Family

programme.title: The Poughkeepsie Tapes

programme.title: Rock-a-Doodle

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon

programme.title: 10 Years

programme.title: A Hologram For The King

programme.title: Collision

programme.title: The Flowers of War

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
